  effective_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this adjustment record became effective in the data warehouse for historical tracking.']
  eob_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether an EOB was generated and sent to the member for this adjustment.']
  financial_period varchar [note: 'The financial accounting period (e.g., 2023-Q4, 2023-12) to which this adjustment is allocated for financial reporting.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The fiscal year to which this adjustment is allocated for financial reporting purposes.']
  fraud_case_number varchar [note: 'The case number assigned by the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) when fraud is suspected.']
  fraud_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment is related to suspected or confirmed fraud, waste, or abuse.']
  general_ledger_account varchar [note: 'The general ledger account code to which this adjustment amount is posted for financial accounting.']
  group_code varchar [note: 'Code indicating the party responsible for the adjustment amount: CO (Contractual Obligation), PR (Patient Responsibility), OA (Other Adjustment), PI (Payer Initiated).']
  hcc_impact_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment affects HCC coding and risk scores for Medicare Advantage or ACA plans.']
  hedis_measure_code varchar [note: 'The HEDIS measure code affected by this adjustment if applicable.']
  initiator_type varchar [note: 'The type of party that initiated or requested the adjustment.']
  interest_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Interest amount paid to provider for delayed payment or adjustment processing as required by state prompt pay laws.']
  interest_rate decimal(5,4) [note: 'The interest rate applied when calculating interest on delayed payments.']
  internal_comments varchar [note: 'Internal comments for claims processing staff regarding the adjustment, not shared externally.']
  line_item_number varchar [note: 'The specific line item number on the claim to which this adjustment applies. Null if adjustment applies to entire claim.']
  line_of_business varchar [note: 'The line of business (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid) associated with the claim being adjusted.']
  medical_necessity_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment is related to medical necessity determination.']
  member_notification_date date [note: 'The date on which the member was notified of the adjustment via Explanation of Benefits (EOB) or other communication.']
  method varchar [note: 'The method by which the adjustment was applied (automated system rule, manual intervention, or semi-automated).']
  mlr_reporting_category varchar [note: 'The MLR reporting category to which this adjustment should be allocated for ACA MLR calculation.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes providing additional context or explanation for the adjustment.']
  original_billed_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The original amount billed on the claim before this adjustment was applied.']
  original_check_number varchar [note: 'The check or EFT reference number of the original payment being adjusted.']
  original_payment_date date [note: 'The date of the original claim payment that is being adjusted.']
  other_payer_paid_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The amount paid by another payer in a COB scenario that affects this adjustment.']
  overpayment_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment corrects an overpayment on the original claim.']
  patient_responsibility_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Portion of the adjustment amount that is the patient\'s financial responsibility (copay, coinsurance, deductible).']
  penalty_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Penalty amount assessed as part of the adjustment for regulatory non-compliance or contract violations.']
  place_of_service_code varchar [note: 'Two-digit code identifying the location where the service was rendered (e.g., 11=Office, 21=Inpatient Hospital, 23=Emergency Room).']
  plan_type varchar [note: 'The type of benefit plan (medical, pharmacy, dental, vision) to which this adjustment applies.']
  posted_date date [note: 'The date on which the adjustment was posted to the financial ledger.']
  pricing_methodology varchar [note: 'The pricing methodology used to calculate the adjusted amount.']
  priority varchar [note: 'Priority level assigned to the adjustment for processing and resolution.']
  procedure_code varchar [note: 'The CPT or HCPCS procedure code associated with the service line being adjusted.']
  procedure_modifier varchar [note: 'Two-character modifier code(s) appended to the procedure code to provide additional information about the service.']
  processed_date date [note: 'The date on which the adjustment was processed by the claims system.']
  processing_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the adjustment was processed in the claims system.']
  product_type varchar [note: 'The insurance product type (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP) associated with the claim being adjusted.']
  provider_notification_date date [note: 'The date on which the provider was notified of the adjustment via remittance advice or other communication.']
  quality_measure_impact_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment impacts quality measure reporting (HEDIS, Stars).']
  quantity decimal(10,2) [note: 'Quantity value associated with the adjustment when applicable (e.g., number of units adjusted).']
  reason_code varchar [note: 'Standard code identifying the specific reason for the claim adjustment. Maps to CARC codes used in 835 remittance advice.']
  reason_description varchar [note: 'Detailed textual description explaining the reason for the claim adjustment.']
  recoupment_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment represents a recoupment (recovery of previously paid funds).']
  recoupment_method varchar [note: 'The method used to recover overpaid funds when recoupment is applicable.']
  regulatory_reporting_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment must be included in regulatory reporting (e.g., MLR, state filings).']
  remark_code varchar [note: 'Supplemental code providing additional information or clarification about the adjustment reason. Used in conjunction with CARC.']
  remittance_advice_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether a remittance advice (835 transaction) was generated and sent to the provider for this adjustment.']
  revenue_code varchar [note: 'Four-digit code used on institutional claims (UB-04) to identify the type of service or accommodation provided.']
  reversal_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment reverses a previous adjustment.']
  risk_adjustment_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment impacts risk adjustment calculations (HCC, RAF scores).']
  sequence_number varchar [note: 'Sequential number indicating the order of adjustments applied to a claim when multiple adjustments exist.']
  service_from_date date [note: 'The start date of the service period for the claim line being adjusted.']
  service_line_adjustment_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the adjustment applies to a specific service line (true) or the entire claim (false).']
  service_to_date date [note: 'The end date of the service period for the claim line being adjusted.']
  service_type varchar [note: 'The type of healthcare service associated with the claim line being adjusted.']
  source varchar [note: 'The source or origin that initiated the adjustment (e.g., auto-adjudication, manual review, appeal, audit).']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The name of the source system that generated or recorded this adjustment (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).']
  stars_measure_code varchar [note: 'The Medicare Stars measure code affected by this adjustment if applicable.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current processing status of the adjustment record.']
  subrogation_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment is related to subrogation recovery from a third party.']
  subrogation_recovery_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The amount recovered through subrogation that resulted in this adjustment.']
  system_generated_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment was automatically generated by the claims system versus manually entered.']
  timely_filing_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment is due to timely filing limit violations.']
  timely_filing_limit_days varchar [note: 'The number of days allowed for timely filing under the applicable policy when timely filing is the adjustment reason.']
  transaction_control_number varchar [note: 'The EDI transaction control number from the 835 remittance advice associated with this adjustment.']
  type_code varchar [note: 'Classification code indicating the category of adjustment applied to the claim (e.g., financial, administrative, clinical, COB).']
  underpayment_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this adjustment corrects an underpayment on the original claim.']
  units_of_service decimal(10,2) [note: 'The number of units of service provided for the claim line being adjusted.']

  Note: 'Records adjustments applied to a claim after initial adjudication, including adjustment reason codes, amount adjustments, and effective dates.'
}

Table claim.payment_allocation {
  payment_allocation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for each claim payment allocation record. Primary key for the claim payment allocation entity.']
  batch_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the payment batch or cycle in which this allocation was processed. Used for batch reconciliation and payment tracking.']
  capitation_plan_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to contract.capitation_plan. Business justification: Capitated payments allocate to specific capitation plans that define per-member-per-month rates. Finance reconciles claim activity against capitation budgets monthly to track utilization and risk.']
  claim_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the parent claim to which this payment allocation belongs. Links payment allocation to the original claim submission.']
  journal_entry_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Every claim payment must post to general ledger via journal entries. Finance team reconciles claim payments to GL daily for accurate financial reporting and regulatory compliance.']
  member_profile_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the health plan member for whom services were rendered and payment is being allocated. Links payment to member account.']
  original_allocation_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the original claim_payment_allocation_id if this record is an adjustment, reversal, or correction of a prior allocation. Null for original allocations.']
  payable_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.payable. Business justification: Claim payments to providers create accounts payable entries. AP team processes these for cash disbursement, vendor reconciliation, and cash flow forecasting.']
  payment_batch_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the payment batch or cycle in which this allocation was processed. Used for batch reconciliation and payment tracking.']
  payment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to billing.billing_payment. Business justification: Claim payments are allocated from billing payment batches. Payment operations require tracking which billing payment transaction funded each claim payment for reconciliation and cash application.']
  program_payment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to government.program_payment. Business justification: Claim payments are allocated from government program payments (capitation, FFS, supplemental). Finance reconciles claim-level payments to CMS remittances and capitation funding daily.']
  provider_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the healthcare provider receiving this payment allocation. May represent rendering, billing, or servicing provider depending on payment routing rules.']
  shared_payment_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the payment transaction from which this allocation is derived. Links allocation to the source payment batch or remittance.']
  subscriber_id varchar [note: 'Health plan subscriber identification number as it appears on the member\'s insurance card. May differ from internal member_id.']
  subscriber_member_profile_id varchar [note: 'Health plan subscriber identification number as it appears on the member\'s insurance card. May differ from internal member_id.']
  accounting_period varchar [note: 'Financial accounting period (month/year) to which this payment allocation is assigned for financial reporting. Format typically YYYY-MM or period name.']
  adjustment_reason_code varchar [note: 'Standard code explaining why the paid amount differs from the billed amount. Provides transparency on payment adjustments and denials.']
  adjustment_reason_description varchar [note: 'Human-readable explanation of the adjustment reason code. Provides detailed context for payment variance.']
  adjustment_sequence_number varchar [note: 'Sequential number indicating the order of adjustments to the original payment allocation. First adjustment is 1, second is 2, etc. Null for original allocations.']

  allocation_status varchar [note: 'Current processing status of the payment allocation. Tracks lifecycle from initial allocation through posting to provider account and final reconciliation.']
  allocation_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the payment allocation indicating whether it is a standard payment, adjustment to prior payment, reversal, recoupment of overpayment, or supplemental payment.']
  allowed_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Maximum amount the health plan will pay for this service based on contracted rates, fee schedules, or regulatory limits. Also known as eligible amount or approved amount.']
  apc_code varchar [note: 'APC code assigned to outpatient hospital services for payment grouping under Medicare\'s Outpatient Prospective Payment System (OPPS).']
  audit_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this payment allocation was selected for post-payment audit or medical record review. True if audited.']
  billed_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Original amount billed by the provider for this claim line. Represents the provider\'s charge before any payer adjustments or contractual allowances.']
  bundled_payment_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation is part of a bundled payment arrangement where multiple services are paid as a single episode. True if bundled, false if unbundled.']
  capitation_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the provider is paid under a capitation arrangement rather than fee-for-service. True if capitated, false if FFS.']
  check_number varchar [note: 'Check or warrant number if payment was made by paper check. Used for payment reconciliation and audit trail.']
  claim_frequency_code varchar [note: 'Single-digit code indicating whether claim is original, replacement, void, or adjustment. Used to manage claim resubmissions and corrections.']
  claim_line_number varchar [note: 'Sequential line number within the claim identifying the specific service line to which this payment allocation applies. Used to distinguish multiple services on a single claim.']
  claim_paid_date date [note: 'Date when payment was issued for the claim. Used for prompt payment compliance and financial reporting.']
  claim_processed_date date [note: 'Date when the claim was adjudicated and payment decision was made. Used for turnaround time reporting and prompt payment compliance.']
  claim_received_date date [note: 'Date when the claim was originally received by the health plan. Used for prompt payment compliance and turnaround time calculations.']
  claim_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the claim form type indicating whether services were rendered by professional providers (CMS-1500), institutional facilities (UB-04), dental, pharmacy, or vision providers.']
  cob_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Amount paid or expected to be paid by another insurance carrier when member has multiple coverage. Used to coordinate benefits between primary and secondary payers.']
  cob_payer_sequence varchar [note: 'Numeric sequence indicating the order of payment responsibility when multiple payers exist (1=primary, 2=secondary, 3=tertiary). Used for COB processing.']
  coinsurance_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Member\'s share of costs calculated as a percentage of the allowed amount after deductible is met. Represents cost-sharing between member and plan.']
  contractual_adjustment_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Difference between billed amount and allowed amount based on provider contract terms. Represents the write-off amount per contractual agreement.']
  copay_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Fixed dollar amount the member pays for a covered service as defined in the benefit plan. Typically collected at time of service.']
  corrected_claim_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation is for a corrected or resubmitted claim. True if claim was corrected after initial submission.']
  cost_center varchar [note: 'Cost center or department code for internal cost allocation and management reporting. Used for operational expense tracking.']
  deductible_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Portion of the allowed amount applied to the member\'s annual deductible. Member is responsible for this amount before plan benefits begin.']
  discount_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Additional discount applied to the claim beyond standard contractual adjustments. May include prompt payment discounts or special negotiated rates.']
  drg_code varchar [note: 'DRG code assigned to inpatient hospital stays for payment grouping. Used for prospective payment system calculations under Medicare and many commercial contracts.']

  fee_schedule_name varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the fee schedule used to determine payment rates for this allocation. May reference Medicare fee schedule, state Medicaid schedule, or custom contracted schedule.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'Fiscal year to which this payment allocation is assigned for financial reporting and budgeting purposes.']
  fraud_review_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this payment allocation was flagged for fraud, waste, or abuse review. True if referred to Special Investigations Unit (SIU).']
  general_ledger_account varchar [note: 'General ledger account code to which this payment allocation is posted for financial accounting. Used for expense categorization and financial statement preparation.']
  group_number varchar [note: 'Employer or group policy number under which the member is covered. Used for group billing and reporting.']
  hedis_reportable_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this service is reportable for HEDIS quality measures. True if service contributes to HEDIS numerator or denominator.']
  interest_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Interest paid to provider for late payment beyond regulatory or contractual timeframes. Calculated based on state prompt payment laws.']
  line_of_business varchar [note: 'Business segment or product line under which the member is covered. Determines applicable regulations, payment rules, and reporting requirements.']
  medical_loss_ratio_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this payment allocation is included in Medical Loss Ratio calculations for ACA rebate requirements. True if included in MLR numerator.']
  medicare_secondary_payer_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether Medicare is the secondary payer due to other primary coverage (employer group health plan, liability, workers comp, etc.). True if MSP applies.']
  member_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the health plan member for whom services were rendered and payment is being allocated. Links payment to member account.']
  member_responsibility_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Total amount the member owes for this claim line, including deductible, coinsurance, copay, and any non-covered amounts. Represents patient liability.']
  network_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the provider is in-network or out-of-network for the member\'s plan. Determines applicable payment rates and member cost-sharing levels.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or comments related to this payment allocation. May include special handling instructions, exception explanations, or audit findings.']
  npi varchar [note: 'Ten-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the healthcare provider receiving payment. Standard identifier for HIPAA transactions.']
  paid_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Actual amount paid by the health plan to the provider for this claim line. May differ from allocated_amount if allocation includes member responsibility or other adjustments.']
  par_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the provider has a participating contract with the health plan. True if provider is contracted, false if non-contracted.']
  payment_rate decimal(15,4) [note: 'Per-unit payment rate applied to calculate the paid amount. Derived from fee schedules, contracted rates, or regulatory payment methodologies.']
  payment_source_system varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the source system that generated this payment allocation (Facets, QNXT, HealthRules, etc.). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.']
  penalty_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Penalty amount assessed for late payment or other contractual violations. May be required by state regulations or provider contracts.']
  percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the total payment allocated to this specific claim line. Used when payment is distributed proportionally across multiple lines.']
  place_of_service_code varchar [note: 'Two-digit code identifying the location where services were rendered (office, hospital, home, etc.). Affects payment rates and coverage determination.']
  pricing_methodology varchar [note: 'Method used to calculate payment for this claim line. Indicates whether payment is based on fee schedule, percentage of charges, per diem, case rate, DRG, APC, capitation, or other methodology.']
  primary_payer_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this health plan is the primary payer for this claim. True if primary, false if secondary or tertiary payer in COB scenarios.']
  procedure_code varchar [note: 'CPT, HCPCS, or other standard procedure code identifying the service rendered. Used for payment allocation and utilization analysis.']
  procedure_code_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the procedure code system used. Identifies whether code is CPT (physician services), HCPCS (supplies/equipment), ICD-10-PCS (inpatient procedures), CDT (dental), NDC (pharmacy), or revenue code (facility).']
  procedure_modifier_1 varchar [note: 'First procedure code modifier providing additional information about the service performed. Affects payment calculation and medical necessity determination.']
  procedure_modifier_2 varchar [note: 'Second procedure code modifier providing additional information about the service performed.']
  procedure_modifier_3 varchar [note: 'Third procedure code modifier providing additional information about the service performed.']
  procedure_modifier_4 varchar [note: 'Fourth procedure code modifier providing additional information about the service performed.']
  product_type varchar [note: 'Type of health insurance product (HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, etc.). Affects network requirements, payment methodologies, and member cost-sharing.']
  quality_measure_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this service is relevant for quality measurement programs (HEDIS, Stars, CAHPS, etc.). True if quality-reportable.']
  reconciliation_date date [note: 'Date when this payment allocation was successfully reconciled with provider accounts and financial systems. Null if not yet reconciled.']
  reconciliation_status varchar [note: 'Status indicating whether this payment allocation has been reconciled with provider accounts and financial systems. Tracks reconciliation lifecycle.']
  reconsideration_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this payment allocation was adjusted following provider request for reconsideration. True if reconsidered.']
  remark_code varchar [note: 'Standard code providing additional information or instructions related to the payment allocation. Supplements adjustment reason codes with procedural guidance.']
  remark_description varchar [note: 'Human-readable explanation of the remark code. Provides additional context or instructions to the provider.']
  remittance_advice_number varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the remittance advice document (835 transaction) that contains this payment allocation. Links allocation to provider payment notification.']
  revenue_code varchar [note: 'Four-digit code used on institutional claims (UB-04) to identify the type of accommodation, ancillary service, or billing calculation. Used for facility payment allocation.']
  reversal_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation represents a reversal of a previous payment. True if reversal transaction.']
  risk_adjustment_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this claim contributes to risk adjustment calculations for Medicare Advantage or ACA marketplace programs. True if risk-adjustable.']
  service_date_from date [note: 'Start date of the service period for which payment is being allocated. For single-day services, matches service_date_to.']
  service_date_to date [note: 'End date of the service period for which payment is being allocated. For single-day services, matches service_date_from.']
  subrogation_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this payment allocation is subject to subrogation recovery from a third party liable for the member\'s injury or illness. True if subrogation applies.']
  tin varchar [note: 'Nine-digit Tax Identification Number (EIN or SSN) of the provider entity receiving payment. Used for tax reporting and payment reconciliation.']

Table claim.cob_detail {
  cob_detail_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the coordination of benefits detail record.']
  claim_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the claim associated with this coordination of benefits detail.']

COB rules differ based on government program eligibility status for primary/secondary payer determination.']

  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the coordination of benefits detail record was created in the system.']

  service_category varchar [note: 'Broad category of healthcare service provided that determines the applicable classification system (inpatient, outpatient, emergency, etc.).']

  source varchar [note: 'Source or method by which the classification was assigned (automated grouper, manual review, override, appeal decision).']
  surgical_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the claim includes a surgical procedure, affecting DRG/APC classification pathway.']
  timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise timestamp when the DRG or APC classification was assigned to the claim.']
  transfer_drg_payment_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'Adjusted DRG payment amount for transfer cases, calculated based on per diem rates.']
  transfer_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the claim represents a transfer case, which may result in adjusted DRG payment.']
  type varchar [note: 'Type of payment classification system applied to the claim (Diagnosis-Related Group, Ambulatory Payment Classification, Healthcare Resource Group, Resource Utilization Group, Enhanced Ambulatory Patient Group).']
  value_based_purchasing_adjustment decimal(12,2) [note: 'Payment adjustment (positive or negative) based on hospital performance on quality measures under the VBP program.']

  Note: 'Reference table mapping inpatient claim diagnoses to Diagnosis‑Related Group (DRG) or Ambulatory Payment Classification (APC) categories.'
}

  line_of_business varchar [note: 'Classification of the insurance product line under which the claim and payment are processed (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Marketplace).']
  member_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the health plan member associated with the claim for which this payment is scheduled. Links payment to member eligibility and benefits.']
  member_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the health plan member associated with the claim. Used for payment reconciliation and member communication.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this payment schedule record was last modified. Used for tracking changes and data currency.']
  offset_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Amount deducted from the scheduled payment to recover prior overpayments or other obligations owed by the payee.']
  offset_claim_number varchar [note: 'Claim number of the original claim from which overpayment is being recovered through this offset. Provides audit trail for recoupment.']
  offset_reason_code varchar [note: 'Standard code indicating the reason for payment offset (e.g., prior overpayment recovery, recoupment, third-party liability).']
  original_scheduled_date date [note: 'The initial date on which this payment was originally scheduled before any modifications or rescheduling occurred. Maintains audit trail of schedule changes.']
  payee_tax_id varchar [note: 'Federal Tax Identification Number of the payee entity. Required for IRS reporting and payment processing compliance.']
  payee_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the recipient entity type receiving this scheduled payment (e.g., healthcare provider, member for reimbursement, facility, third-party vendor).']
  payment_address_line_1 varchar [note: 'First line of the mailing address where payment check or correspondence should be sent. Primary street address component.']
  payment_address_line_2 varchar [note: 'Second line of the payment mailing address for suite numbers, apartment numbers, or additional address details.']
  payment_adjustment_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Total amount of adjustments applied to the scheduled payment amount. Represents the difference between scheduled and actual payment amounts.']
  payment_adjustment_reason_code varchar [note: 'Standard code indicating the reason for payment adjustment (e.g., offset, recoupment, coordination of benefits, prior overpayment recovery).']
  payment_adjustment_reason_description varchar [note: 'Detailed text description explaining the reason for the payment adjustment. Provides context beyond the standard reason code.']
  payment_city varchar [note: 'City name component of the payment mailing address.']
  payment_confirmation_number varchar [note: 'Confirmation number provided by the payment processor upon successful payment processing. Used for payment verification and inquiry.']
  payment_country_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO country code for the payment mailing address. Supports international payment processing.']
  payment_currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO currency code indicating the currency in which the payment will be disbursed (e.g., USD for US Dollars).']
  payment_method_code varchar [note: 'Code indicating the payment instrument or mechanism to be used for disbursement (e.g., ACH for Automated Clearing House, EFT for Electronic Funds Transfer, CHECK for paper check).']
  payment_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes providing additional context, instructions, or special handling requirements for this scheduled payment.']
  payment_notification_email varchar [note: 'Email address to which payment notification and remittance advice should be sent. Used for electronic payment communication.']
  payment_notification_phone varchar [note: 'Phone number for payment notification and inquiry. Used for payee contact regarding payment status and issues.']
  payment_priority varchar [note: 'Priority level assigned to this scheduled payment for processing queue management (e.g., urgent for prompt payment compliance, normal for standard processing).']
  payment_run_date date [note: 'The date on which the payment processing batch was executed. Represents the business date of the payment cycle.']
  payment_sequence_number varchar [note: 'Sequential number indicating the order of this payment installment within the overall payment schedule (e.g., 1 for first payment, 2 for second payment).']
  payment_state varchar [note: 'Two-letter state or province code for the payment mailing address. Uses standard USPS state abbreviations.']
  payment_status varchar [note: 'Current status of this scheduled payment installment indicating its position in the payment lifecycle from scheduling through final disbursement or cancellation.']
  payment_terms varchar [note: 'Description of the payment terms and schedule agreed upon for this claim (e.g., Net 30, installment plan details, payment frequency).']
  payment_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the payment indicating whether it represents a full claim payment, partial payment, installment in a series, advance payment, or final settlement.']
  payment_zip_code varchar [note: 'Five or nine-digit postal code for the payment mailing address. Supports both standard and ZIP+4 formats.']
  plan_code varchar [note: 'Unique code identifying the specific health plan under which the member is enrolled and the claim is being paid.']
  remaining_balance decimal(15,2) [note: 'Outstanding balance remaining to be paid on the claim after this scheduled payment. Used for tracking payment completion status.']
  remittance_advice_number varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the remittance advice document (835 transaction) associated with this payment. Links payment to detailed claim-level remittance information.']
  reversal_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The monetary amount reversed from the original payment. May be partial or full reversal of the payment.']
  reversal_date date [note: 'The date on which the payment was reversed. Populated when a processed payment is voided and funds are recovered.']
  reversal_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this payment has been reversed after initial processing. Used for payment correction and recoupment tracking.']
  reversal_reason_code varchar [note: 'Code indicating the reason why the payment was reversed (e.g., overpayment identified, duplicate payment, fraud detection).']
  scheduled_payment_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The monetary amount scheduled to be paid in this installment. Represents a portion or full amount of the total claim payment obligation.']
  scheduled_payment_date date [note: 'The date on which this payment installment is scheduled to be processed and disbursed to the provider or member.']
  service_end_date date [note: 'The ending date of the service period for which the claim payment is being made. Used for payment period tracking and reporting.']
  service_start_date date [note: 'The beginning date of the service period for which the claim payment is being made. Used for payment period tracking and reporting.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Name of the source claims administration system from which this payment schedule record originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).']
  source_system_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of this payment schedule record in the source claims administration system. Used for data reconciliation and traceability.']
  subrogation_case_number varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the subrogation case associated with this payment. Links payment to third-party liability recovery efforts.']
  subrogation_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this payment is subject to subrogation recovery from a third party liable for the members injury or illness.']
  total_claim_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Total approved payment amount for the entire claim. The sum of all scheduled payment installments should equal this amount.']
  total_installments varchar [note: 'Total number of payment installments planned for this claim. Used to track payment schedule completion.']

  Note: 'Schedule of anticipated claim payments, including due dates, installment amounts, and payment method.'
}

  npi varchar [note: 'National Provider Identifier assigned to the member if they are also a healthcare provider. Used for provider-member relationship tracking.']

  retention_period_years varchar [note: 'Number of years this identifier must be retained according to regulatory and business requirements before it can be purged.']

  state_id varchar [note: 'State-issued identification number such as driver\'s license or state ID card number used for identity verification and fraud prevention.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of the identifier indicating whether it is actively in use, suspended, or terminated. Supports identifier lifecycle management.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when the identifier was terminated or became invalid. Null if identifier is still active.']

  verification_status varchar [note: 'Status of identifier verification indicating whether the identifier has been validated against authoritative sources.']

Uses ANSI X12 1069 Maintenance Type Code.']

Table member.address {

  po_box_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the address is a post office box rather than a physical street address.']
  primary_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this is the primary or default address for the member.']
  received_date date [note: 'Date when the address information was received from the member, employer, or other source.']
  residential_commercial_indicator varchar [note: 'Classification indicating whether the address is a residential or commercial location.']

  seasonal_start_month varchar [note: 'Month number (1-12) when seasonal address becomes active each year.']

  standardization_date date [note: 'Date when the address was last validated and standardized against postal authority standards.']
  standardized_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the address has been validated and standardized against USPS or other postal authority standards.']
  state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter state or province code (e.g., CA, NY, TX) following USPS standards.']
  state_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the state or province where the address is located.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of the address record indicating whether it is active, inactive, pending verification, or undeliverable.']
  time_zone varchar [note: 'Time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago).']

  transaction_type varchar [note: 'Type of transaction that created or modified this address record (add, change, delete, correction).']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the address indicating its purpose or usage (e.g., home, mailing, billing, work).']

  verification_status varchar [note: 'Status indicating whether the address has been verified against postal authority databases.']

  Note: 'Historical address records for a member, including address type, start/end dates, and geocode.'

  last_update_date date [note: 'The date when this contact record was last modified or updated.']

  time_zone varchar [note: 'The time zone associated with this contact location, used for scheduling communications and respecting contact hours (e.g., America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles).']

  validation_source varchar [note: 'The system or entity that performed the validation of this contact information (e.g., USPS CASS, email verification service, member portal).']
  validation_status varchar [note: 'The verification status of this contact information (verified, unverified, failed, pending, not applicable). Indicates whether the contact has been confirmed as accurate.']
  zip_code varchar [note: 'The postal ZIP code for the member\'s address. May include 5-digit or 9-digit (ZIP+4) format.']

  Note: 'Phone, email, and other contact channels for a member with preference flags and validation status.'
}

  redisclosure_notice varchar [note: 'Notice provided to the member that information disclosed under this consent may be subject to redisclosure and may no longer be protected.']
  regulatory_requirement varchar [note: 'The specific regulatory requirement or legal mandate that necessitates this consent.']

  revoked_date date [note: 'The date on which the member revoked or withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been revoked.']

  right_to_revoke_notice varchar [note: 'Text of the notice provided to the member regarding their right to revoke consent and the process for doing so.']
  sale_of_phi_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this consent authorizes the sale of the member\'s Protected Health Information. Requires specific authorization under HIPAA. True if authorized, false otherwise.']
  scope varchar [note: 'Defines the scope or extent of information covered by the consent. Specifies what data or activities the consent applies to.']
  signature_captured boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a member signature was captured for this consent. True if signature obtained, false otherwise.']
  signature_date date [note: 'The date on which the member signed the consent authorization.']
  signature_type varchar [note: 'The type of signature captured for the consent authorization.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The source system or application from which the consent record originated.']
  special_category_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this consent involves specially protected health information such as mental health, substance abuse, or HIV/AIDS records. True if special category, false otherwise.']
  state_specific_requirements varchar [note: 'Description of any state-specific consent requirements that apply to this consent record.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of the consent record indicating whether the consent is in effect, revoked, or expired.']
  third_party_disclosure_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the member has consented to disclosure of their information to third parties. True if allowed, false otherwise.']
  transaction_id varchar [note: 'Unique transaction identifier for the consent event. Used for audit and reconciliation purposes.']
  treatment_conditioning_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether treatment, payment, enrollment, or eligibility is conditioned on providing this consent. True if conditioned, false otherwise.']
  type varchar [note: 'The category or type of consent provided by the member. Defines the scope and purpose of the consent.']
  user_agent varchar [note: 'Browser or application user agent string captured when consent was provided electronically. Used for audit purposes.']
  verification_frequency_months varchar [note: 'The frequency in months at which this consent should be re-verified with the member. Null if no periodic verification required.']
  version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the consent form or agreement presented to the member. Tracks changes to consent language over time.']
  witness_name varchar [note: 'Name of the witness who attested to the member providing consent. Null if no witness required.']

  Note: 'Records of member consents for data sharing, marketing, and electronic communications.'
}

  rating_area varchar [note: 'Geographic rating area used for premium calculation. Defined by state insurance departments for ACA-compliant plans.']
  reason_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code indicating the reason or trigger for the member event. Examples include marriage, birth, job change, relocation, or open enrollment.']
  reason_description varchar [note: 'Detailed text description explaining the reason for the member event. Provides context beyond the standardized reason code.']
  retry_count varchar [note: 'Number of times the system attempted to process this event. Used for monitoring system reliability and identifying problematic transactions.']
  reversal_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this event reverses a previous event. Used for correction processing and audit trails.']
  risk_score decimal(10,4) [note: 'The member\'s risk adjustment score based on HCC coding. Used for Medicare Advantage payment calculations and risk stratification.']
  service_area_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the geographic service area for the member\'s plan. Used for network assignment and provider access.']
  source varchar [note: 'The system or channel through which the member event was initiated or received. Critical for audit trails and source system reconciliation.']
  source_record_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the record in the source system. Used for traceability and reconciliation with source systems.']
  source_system_name varchar [note: 'Name of the source system that originated this event. Used for data lineage and system integration tracking.']
  special_enrollment_period_end_date date [note: 'The end date of the Special Enrollment Period. Used to validate timely enrollment and compliance with ACA regulations.']
  special_enrollment_period_start_date date [note: 'The start date of the Special Enrollment Period triggered by a qualifying life event. Used for enrollment window validation.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current processing status of the member event. Indicates whether the event has been validated, approved, and applied to member records.']
  student_status_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the dependent member is a full-time student. May extend eligibility beyond standard age limits.']
  submitted_by_user_name varchar [note: 'Name of the user who submitted or recorded the member event. Used for audit trails and operational support.']
  subsidy_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The amount of premium tax credit or subsidy applied to the member\'s coverage. Applicable for marketplace and government-subsidized plans.']
  subsidy_eligibility_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the member is eligible for premium subsidies or tax credits. Used for marketplace enrollment and financial reconciliation.']
  timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the member event was recorded in the system. Includes time zone information for accurate sequencing.']
  tobacco_user_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the member uses tobacco products. Used for premium rating and wellness program eligibility.']
  type_code varchar [note: 'Code representing the type of member event that occurred. Categorizes the nature of the operational change affecting the member.']
  wellness_program_participation_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the member is participating in employer-sponsored wellness programs. May affect premium discounts.']

  Note: 'Operational events affecting a member (e.g., life event, plan change request, status transition).'
}

Table member.group_agreement {
  group_agreement_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the group_agreement association']
  agreement_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the master contractual agreement']
  group_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the employer group or member group being covered under this agreement']
  member_group_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key to member.member_group']
  contribution_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Specific contribution amount or premium applicable to this group under this agreement']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when this group-agreement relationship becomes effective, marking when the employer group is covered under this specific agreement']
  enrollment_status varchar [note: 'Current status of this group-agreement relationship']
  group_rate_tier varchar [note: 'Rate tier classification assigned to this specific group under this agreement, determining pricing and reimbursement levels']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when this group-agreement relationship ends or was terminated']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Contract between member_group and agreement. It captures the specific terms, rates, and enrollment parameters that apply when a particular employer group is covered under a provider or payer agreement. Each record links one member_group to one agreement with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship, such as group-specific rate tiers, contribution amounts, and effective dates.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, employer groups (member_groups) can be covered under multiple provider or payer agreements simultaneously or over time (e.g., different agreements for different service categories, geographic regions, or renewal periods). Conversely, a single master agreement (especially association plans, multi-employer trusts, or network agreements) can cover multiple employer groups with group-specific rate tiers, contribution levels, and effective dates. The business actively manages these group-agreement relationships as distinct operational entities with their own lifecycle, rates, and terms.'
}

Table member.program_enrollment {
  enrollment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the member_program_enrollment association']

  completion_date date [note: 'The date when the member completed or exited the program. Explicitly identified in detection phase as relationship data.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this enrollment record was created.']
  enrollment_date date [note: 'The date when the member was enrolled into the program. Explicitly identified in detection phase as relationship data.']

  outcome_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Quantitative score measuring the member\'s health outcomes or program effectiveness for this specific enrollment. Explicitly identified in detection phase as relationship data. Used for quality reporting and program effectiveness analysis.']
  participation_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the member\'s participation in the program. Explicitly identified in detection phase as relationship data. Values: Active, Inactive, Completed, Withdrawn, Suspended.']
  referral_source varchar [note: 'Source of the referral for this enrollment (e.g., PCP, specialist, claims analytics, member self-referral).']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this enrollment record was last updated.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the enrollment relationship between a member and a care or wellness program. It captures the member\'s participation lifecycle including enrollment dates, participation status, assigned care coordinators, and outcome metrics. Each record links one member to one program with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship, supporting care management operations, quality reporting (HEDIS/Stars), and program effectiveness analysis.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, members routinely enroll in multiple concurrent programs (e.g., a diabetic member may be enrolled in Diabetes Management, Wellness Coaching, and Medication Adherence programs simultaneously), and each program serves thousands of members. Care management teams actively manage these enrollments as operational entities, tracking enrollment dates, participation status, assigned care coordinators, and outcome metrics for each member-program combination to support quality reporting (HEDIS/Stars) and program effectiveness analysis.'
}

Table provider.quality_metric {
  quality_metric_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the quality metric record. Primary key for the quality metric entity.']
  cms_measure_id varchar [note: 'The CMS-assigned identifier for this quality measure, used in Medicare quality reporting programs.']
  contract_id varchar [note: 'The unique identifier for the CMS contract or internal provider contract associated with this quality metric (e.g., Medicare Advantage contract number).']
  performance_metric_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to contract.performance_metric. Business justification: Quality metrics track provider performance against contractual performance metrics. Value-based care teams use this to calculate quality bonuses and contract compliance for pay-for-performance program']
  plan_id varchar [note: 'The unique identifier for the health plan or benefit plan associated with this quality metric.']
  product_plan_id varchar [note: 'The unique identifier for the health plan or benefit plan associated with this quality metric.']
  profile_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the provider to whom this quality metric applies. Links to the provider entity.']
  program_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to shared.program. Business justification: Quality metrics are tracked within specific quality improvement programs (HEDIS, Stars). Quality reporting teams use this to aggregate provider performance by program for regulatory submissions.']
  provider_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the provider to whom this quality metric applies. Links to the provider entity.']
  specialty_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Links quality metrics to specialty reference table. Quality metrics are often stratified by specialty. The specialty STRING attribute can be replaced with FK to specialty reference table.']
  accreditation_program varchar [note: 'The accreditation or quality program under which this quality metric is reported: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), URAC, Joint Commission, CMS Star Ratings, other, or not applicable.']
  age_stratification varchar [note: 'The age group or stratification for which this quality metric is reported (e.g., 18-44, 45-64, 65+, pediatric, adult).']
  audit_date date [note: 'The date when the quality metric data was audited by an external auditor (e.g., NCQA-certified HEDIS auditor).']
  audit_status varchar [note: 'The audit status of this quality metric submission: not audited, audit scheduled, audit in progress, audit passed, audit failed, or audit findings pending.']
  auditor_name varchar [note: 'The name of the auditing organization or individual who performed the quality metric audit.']
  benchmark_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'The benchmark or target performance rate for this quality measure, established by the payer, regulatory body, or industry standard.']
  case_mix_index decimal(5,4) [note: 'The case mix index representing the average complexity and resource intensity of the provider\'s patient population for this quality measure.']
  certification_status varchar [note: 'The certification status of the quality metric submission: certified (meets all requirements), provisional (conditional approval), not certified, certification expired, or certification pending.']
  confidence_interval_lower decimal(5,2) [note: 'The lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for the quality metric rate, indicating statistical precision.']
  confidence_interval_upper decimal(5,2) [note: 'The upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for the quality metric rate, indicating statistical precision.']
  county_name varchar [note: 'The county name where the provider is located, used for geographic quality analysis and network adequacy reporting.']
  data_collection_method varchar [note: 'The specific method used to collect the data for this quality metric: administrative data processing, medical record review, patient-reported outcomes, provider-reported data, automated EHR extraction, or other.']
  data_quality_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'A composite score (0-100) representing the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the data used to calculate this quality metric.']
  data_source varchar [note: 'The primary data source used to calculate this quality metric: administrative claims, electronic health record (EHR), hybrid (combination of claims and medical record), survey, registry, or other.']
  denominator decimal(18,2) [note: 'The count of eligible members or events for the quality measure (e.g., total number of members eligible for the service).']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date when this quality metric record became effective and valid for use in reporting and analysis.']
  exclusions decimal(18,2) [note: 'The count of members or events excluded from the denominator due to valid clinical or administrative reasons as defined by the measure specification.']
  facility_type varchar [note: 'The type of healthcare facility if the provider is a facility: acute care hospital, critical access hospital, ambulatory surgery center, skilled nursing facility, home health agency, hospice, dialysis center, imaging center, laboratory, other, or not applicable.']
  gender_stratification varchar [note: 'The gender stratification for which this quality metric is reported: male, female, all genders, other, or not applicable.']
  geographic_region varchar [note: 'The geographic region or market area where the provider practices and for which this quality metric is reported.']
  health_equity_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this quality metric is designated as a health equity measure, focusing on reducing disparities in care (true if health equity measure, false otherwise).']
  improvement_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the provider\'s performance on this measure has improved compared to the prior measurement period (true if improved, false otherwise).']
  incentive_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The dollar amount of quality-based incentive payment earned by the provider for achieving this quality metric performance level.']
  incentive_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this quality metric performance makes the provider eligible for quality-based incentive payments or bonuses (true if eligible, false otherwise).']
  language_stratification varchar [note: 'The primary language stratification for which this quality metric is reported, used for health equity and access analysis.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this quality metric record was last updated or modified.']
  lob varchar [note: 'The line of business or product type for which this quality metric is reported: commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, marketplace, dual eligible, individual, or group.']
  measure_category varchar [note: 'HEDIS domain category for the quality measure: effectiveness of care, access/availability of care, experience of care, utilization, health plan descriptive information, or measures reported using electronic health records.']
  measure_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code identifying the specific quality measure being reported (e.g., HEDIS measure code, CMS star rating measure code).']
  measure_name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the quality measure (e.g., Breast Cancer Screening, Diabetes HbA1c Control).']
  measure_steward varchar [note: 'The organization responsible for developing and maintaining the quality measure specification (e.g., NCQA, CMS, AMA-PCPI).']
  measure_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the quality measure by type: process measures (actions performed), outcome measures (health status results), structure measures (capacity and systems), patient experience measures (satisfaction and engagement), efficiency measures (cost-effectiveness), or intermediate outcome measures (clinical indicators).']
  measure_version varchar [note: 'The version number or year of the quality measure specification used to calculate this metric (e.g., HEDIS 2023, CMS v5.0).']
  measurement_period_end_date date [note: 'The end date of the measurement period for which the quality metric was calculated.']
  measurement_period_start_date date [note: 'The start date of the measurement period for which the quality metric was calculated (typically calendar year or reporting year).']
  national_average_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'The national average performance rate for this quality measure across all reporting providers, used for comparative analysis.']
  network_tier varchar [note: 'The network tier classification of the provider for which this quality metric applies: tier 1 (highest value), tier 2, tier 3, preferred, standard, out of network, or not applicable.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or comments regarding this quality metric, including data quality issues, special circumstances, or explanatory information.']
  npi varchar [note: 'The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the healthcare provider.']
  nqf_number varchar [note: 'The National Quality Forum endorsement number for this quality measure, if applicable.']
  numerator decimal(18,2) [note: 'The count of members or events that meet the quality measure criteria (e.g., number of members who received the recommended service).']
  penalty_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The dollar amount of financial penalty or withhold applied to the provider due to substandard performance on this quality metric.']
  penalty_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this quality metric performance results in a financial penalty or withhold for the provider (true if penalty applied, false otherwise).']
  percentile_rank decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentile rank of the provider\'s performance on this quality measure compared to all providers in the comparison population (0-100 scale).']
  performance_status varchar [note: 'Classification of the provider\'s performance relative to the benchmark: exceeds benchmark, meets benchmark, below benchmark, not applicable, or insufficient data.']
  prior_period_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'The provider\'s performance rate for this quality measure in the immediately preceding measurement period, used for trend analysis.']
  product_type varchar [note: 'The specific health plan product type: Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS), High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Special Needs Plan (SNP), Dual Eligible SNP (D-SNP), Chronic Condition SNP (C-SNP), Institutional SNP (I-SNP), Private Fee-For-Service (PFFS), or other.']
  provider_type varchar [note: 'The type of provider entity: individual practitioner, group practice, facility, hospital, ancillary provider, or other.']
  public_reporting_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this quality metric is included in public reporting (e.g., CMS Plan Finder, provider directories) or is for internal use only (true if publicly reported, false otherwise).']
  race_ethnicity_stratification varchar [note: 'The race and ethnicity stratification for which this quality metric is reported, used for health equity analysis.']
  rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'The calculated performance rate for the quality measure, expressed as a percentage (numerator divided by denominator minus exclusions, multiplied by 100).']
  rate_change decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage point change in the provider\'s performance rate compared to the prior measurement period (current rate minus prior period rate).']
  record_status varchar [note: 'The current status of this quality metric record: active (current and valid), inactive (no longer in use), archived (historical), pending review (awaiting validation), or superseded (replaced by newer record).']
  reporting_entity varchar [note: 'The name of the health plan, provider organization, or entity responsible for reporting this quality metric.']
  reporting_year varchar [note: 'The calendar year for which the quality metric is being reported to regulatory bodies or for internal performance tracking.']
  risk_adjustment_factor decimal(5,4) [note: 'The risk adjustment factor applied to this quality metric to account for differences in patient population health status and complexity.']
  sample_size varchar [note: 'The number of members or cases included in the sample used to calculate this quality metric (for measures using sampling methodology).']
  score decimal(5,2) [note: 'The standardized quality score assigned to the provider based on the measure rate, often normalized or weighted according to program specifications (e.g., CMS Star Rating score).']
  social_determinants_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this quality metric incorporates social determinants of health factors in its calculation or risk adjustment (true if SDOH-adjusted, false otherwise).']
  star_rating decimal(2,1) [note: 'The star rating assigned to the provider for this quality measure, typically on a scale of 1 to 5 stars (with half-star increments allowed), used in CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings.']
  state_code varchar [note: 'The two-letter US state code where the provider is located and for which this quality metric applies.']
  statistical_significance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the difference between the provider\'s performance and the benchmark is statistically significant (true if significant, false otherwise).']
  submission_date date [note: 'The date when the quality metric data was submitted to the regulatory body, accreditation organization, or internal quality department.']
  submission_status varchar [note: 'The status of the quality metric submission: draft, submitted, accepted, rejected, resubmission required, or finalized.']
  suppression_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this quality metric result has been suppressed from public reporting due to small sample size, privacy concerns, or data quality issues (true if suppressed, false otherwise).']
  suppression_reason varchar [note: 'The reason why this quality metric result was suppressed: small sample size (below minimum threshold), privacy protection, data quality issue, not applicable, or other.']
  tin varchar [note: 'The 9-digit Tax Identification Number for the provider organization or individual.']
  zip_code varchar [note: 'The ZIP code of the provider\'s primary practice location for which this quality metric is reported.']

  Note: 'Quality performance metrics captured for each provider, such as HEDIS scores, outcome measures, and star ratings.'
}

Table provider.network_participation {
  network_participation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the provider_network_participation association']
  contract_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the legal contract document governing this provider\'s participation in this plan\'s network']
  product_plan_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the health insurance product plan in which the provider participates']
  profile_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the provider profile participating in the plan network']
  provider_profile_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key to provider_profile']
  acceptance_status varchar [note: 'Current status of whether the provider is accepting new patients under this specific plan']
  contract_end_date date [note: 'Date when the provider\'s contract with UnitedHealthCare expires or terminates. [Moved from provider_profile: This should be renamed to termination_date and moved to the association. A provider\'s contract end date varies by plan - this is participation-specific, not provider-specific.]']
  contract_start_date date [note: 'Date when the provider\'s contract with UnitedHealthCare became effective. [Moved from provider_profile: This should be renamed to effective_date and moved to the association. A provider has different contract start dates for different plans - this is participation-specific, not provider-specific.]']
  contract_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the contractual arrangement with the provider. [Moved from provider_profile: Contract type may vary by plan. A provider might have a capitated contract with one plan and fee-for-service with another. This belongs to the participation relationship.]']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this participation record was created in the system']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when the provider\'s participation in this specific plan network becomes effective']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this participation record']
  network_tier varchar [note: 'Tier level assigned to the provider within this specific plan\'s network hierarchy, determining member cost-sharing levels']
  participation_status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the provider\'s participation in this specific plan network']
  reimbursement_rate_schedule varchar [note: 'Identifier or reference to the fee schedule or reimbursement methodology applied to this provider for services rendered under this plan']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when the provider\'s participation in this specific plan network ends or is terminated']

  Note: 'This association product represents the participation contract between a healthcare provider and a health insurance product plan. It captures the terms, conditions, and status of each provider\'s participation in each plan\'s network. Each record links one provider to one plan with attributes that define the specific participation arrangement including network tier placement, reimbursement terms, effective dates, and acceptance status.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, providers participate in multiple plan networks simultaneously (a cardiologist may be in-network for Medicare Advantage, Commercial PPO, and Medicaid plans), and each plan has thousands of participating providers. Network participation is an actively managed operational entity with specific contract terms, tier assignments, reimbursement schedules, and acceptance statuses that vary by provider-plan combination. Claims adjudication, member cost-sharing calculations, and provider directory services all depend on this participation relationship.'
}

Table eligibility.verification_response {
  verification_response_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for verification_response']
  benefit_package_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the benefit plan under which the member is covered.']
  payer_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the insurance payer that issued the response.']
  verification_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to eligibility.verification. Business justification: Verification response records pertain to a specific verification; linking directly removes duplicated identifiers and ensures referential integrity.']

  coverage_type varchar [note: 'Category of benefit coverage applicable to the request.']

  preventive_service_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this benefit is classified as a preventive service that must be covered without cost sharing under ACA.']
  prior_authorization_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether prior authorization is required before the service is covered under this cost sharing arrangement.']
  product_type varchar [note: 'Type of health plan product (HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, Medicare Advantage, etc.).']
  reduction_level varchar [note: 'Indicates the level of cost sharing reduction for ACA marketplace plans (73%, 87%, 94% actuarial value variants, or standard).']
  referral_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a referral from a primary care physician is required for this service to be covered under this cost sharing arrangement.']
  service_category_code varchar [note: 'Code representing the specific service category within the benefit type (e.g., emergency room, specialist visit, generic drug, brand drug).']
  service_category_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the service category.']
  source_record_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of this cost sharing record in the source system, used for traceability and reconciliation.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the source system from which this cost sharing data originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).']
  state_mandated_benefit_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this benefit is mandated by state insurance regulations.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of this cost sharing record (active, inactive, pending approval, or superseded by a newer version).']
  telehealth_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this cost sharing applies to telehealth or virtual care services.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when this cost sharing arrangement is no longer effective. Null indicates the arrangement is currently active.']
  visit_limit_count varchar [note: 'Maximum number of visits or services allowed per plan year for this benefit type before different cost sharing or coverage rules apply.']
  visit_limit_period varchar [note: 'Time period over which the visit limit count applies (e.g., per year, per lifetime).']
  waived_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether cost sharing is waived for this benefit type and service category (e.g., preventive services under ACA).']
  waiver_reason_code varchar [note: 'Code indicating the reason cost sharing is waived (e.g., preventive service, emergency service, specific program).']

  Note: 'Details of deductibles, copays, coinsurance, and out‑of‑pocket maximums for each benefit type within a plan.'
}

  source_system_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for this enrollment window in the source system.']

  state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter state code if the enrollment window is state-specific (e.g., \'CA\', \'TX\', \'NY\').']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the enrollment window (e.g., Draft, Scheduled, Active, Closed, Extended, Cancelled).']
  subsidy_eligible boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether enrollments during this window are eligible for premium subsidies or cost-sharing reductions.']
  subsidy_type varchar [note: 'Type of subsidy available for enrollments during this window (e.g., Premium Tax Credit (PTC), Cost-Sharing Reduction (CSR), Low Income Subsidy (LIS), Medicaid, Children\'s Health Insurance Program (CHIP), Employer Contribution).']
  termination_allowed boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether members may terminate coverage during this window.']
  verification_method varchar [note: 'Method used to verify eligibility or qualifying events for this enrollment window (e.g., Self-Attestation, Document Upload, Third-Party Verification, Manual Review).']
  waitlist_enabled boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether a waitlist is enabled if enrollment cap is reached.']
  window_code varchar [note: 'Short alphanumeric code used to reference the enrollment window in operational systems and reporting.']
  window_name varchar [note: 'Business-friendly name or label for the enrollment window (e.g., \'2024 Annual Open Enrollment\', \'Q1 New Hire Window\').']
  window_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the enrollment window indicating the regulatory or business context (e.g., Annual Open Enrollment (AOE), Special Enrollment Period (SEP), Medicare Annual Election Period (AEP), Initial Enrollment Period (IEP), Qualifying Life Event (QLE)).']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User ID or name of the person who created this enrollment window record.']

  Note: 'Defined open and close dates (including special enrollment periods) during which members may enroll or change plans.'
