Table product.rate_schedule_type {
  rate_schedule_type_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the rate schedule type classification. Primary key for the rate schedule type entity.']
  aca_compliant_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rate schedule type adheres to ACA rating requirements including age curve restrictions (3:1 ratio), tobacco use factors (1.5:1 ratio), and prohibited rating factors.']
  actuarial_certification_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether an actuarial certification is required for rates developed under this schedule type, typically required for filed rates and ACA-compliant products.']
  actuarial_value_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Actuarial value percentage representing the average share of covered healthcare expenses paid by the plan under this rate schedule type, used for ACA metal tier classification.']
  adjusted_community_rating_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rate schedule uses adjusted community rating where base community rates are modified by permissible factors such as age, tobacco use, geography, and family composition.']
  administrative_load_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of premium allocated to administrative expenses, commissions, and profit margin in this rate schedule type.']
  age_band_structure varchar [note: 'Structure of age bands used in age-based rating (single-year increments, five-year bands, ten-year bands, custom bands, or not applicable if age rating is not used).']
  age_rating_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether premium variation based on age is permitted under this rate schedule type, subject to regulatory constraints (e.g., ACA 3:1 age ratio limit).']
  approved_states varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of state postal codes where this rate schedule type has been approved for use (e.g., \'CA,NY,TX,FL\').']
  aptc_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether rates under this schedule type are eligible for federal Advanced Premium Tax Credits on ACA marketplaces.']
  category varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the rate schedule type indicating the primary rating methodology category (demographic factors, geographic factors, group characteristics, composite approach, experience-based, community-rated, adjusted community-rated, or custom).']
  cms_approved_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rate schedule type has been approved by CMS for use with Medicare Advantage, Part D, or federally facilitated marketplace products.']
  code varchar [note: 'Short alphanumeric code representing the rate schedule type for system processing and integration (e.g., AGE_BAND, GEO_AREA, GROUP_SIZE, COMPOSITE, TIER).']
  commission_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Standard broker or agent commission percentage included in rates under this schedule type.']
  community_rating_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rate schedule uses pure community rating where all members in a geographic area pay the same rate regardless of health status, age (except ACA-permitted factors), or other characteristics.']
  composite_rating_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rate schedule uses composite rating where a single blended rate applies to all covered members regardless of age, family status, or other demographic factors.']
  contribution_strategy_factor_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether employer contribution level (percentage of premium paid by employer) is used as a rating factor in this schedule type.']
  cost_sharing_reduction_variant varchar [note: 'Cost-sharing reduction variant for ACA marketplace silver plans (standard, 73% AV, 87% AV, 94% AV for low-income enrollees, or not applicable).']
  created_date date [note: 'Date on which this rate schedule type record was initially created in the system.']
  credibility_threshold decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum credibility factor (0.00 to 1.00) required for experience rating, indicating the statistical reliability of the group\'s claims experience for rate-setting purposes.']
  description varchar [note: 'Detailed explanation of the rate schedule methodology, including how premiums are calculated and what factors are considered in the rating structure.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date on which this rate schedule type becomes active and available for use in premium calculations.']
  exchange_certified_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rate schedule type is certified for use with ACA health insurance exchange/marketplace products.']
  experience_rating_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether premium rates can be adjusted based on the group\'s historical claims experience (typically allowed for large groups, restricted for small groups under ACA).']
  family_tier_structure varchar [note: 'Structure of family coverage tiers used in rating (two-tier: employee/family; three-tier: employee/employee+spouse/employee+children/family; four-tier: employee/employee+spouse/employee+children/family; five-tier or six-tier for more granular structures; composite for single blended rate; or not applicable).']
  geographic_granularity varchar [note: 'Level of geographic detail used for rating purposes (state-level, rating area, county, ZIP code, Metropolitan Statistical Area, multi-state region, or not applicable).']
  geographic_rating_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether premium variation based on geographic location (rating areas, ZIP codes, counties) is permitted under this rate schedule type.']
  group_size_rating_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether premium variation based on employer group size (number of enrolled employees or eligible employees) is permitted under this rate schedule type.']
  group_size_threshold_max varchar [note: 'Maximum group size (number of employees) for which this rate schedule type applies, often 50 for small group or unlimited for large group markets.']
  group_size_threshold_min varchar [note: 'Minimum group size (number of employees) for which this rate schedule type applies, often 1 for small group or 51 for large group markets.']
  industry_class_rating_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether premium variation based on employer industry classification (SIC or NAICS codes) is permitted under this rate schedule type.']
  last_modified_by varchar [note: 'User ID or name of the person who most recently modified this rate schedule type record.']
  last_modified_date date [note: 'Date on which this rate schedule type record was most recently updated.']
  lob varchar [note: 'Line of business to which this rate schedule type applies (commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, individual market, small group, large group, Administrative Services Only, government programs, or exchange/marketplace).']
  manual_rate_basis varchar [note: 'Basis for calculating manual rates in this schedule type (Per Member Per Month, Per Employee Per Month, per contract, per subscriber, per covered life, or not applicable).']
  market_segment varchar [note: 'Specific market segment for which this rate schedule type is designed (individual, small group 1-50, large group 51+, jumbo group 1000+, government programs, exchange/marketplace, or off-exchange).']
  maximum_age varchar [note: 'Maximum age for which this rate schedule type applies, often capped at 64 for ACA-compliant plans (65+ transitions to Medicare) or unlimited for certain products.']
  metal_tier varchar [note: 'ACA metal tier classification if this rate schedule type is specific to exchange products (Bronze 60% AV, Silver 70% AV, Gold 80% AV, Platinum 90% AV, Catastrophic, or not applicable for non-exchange products).']
  minimum_age varchar [note: 'Minimum age for which this rate schedule type applies, typically 0 for dependent coverage or 18 for individual coverage.']
  minimum_enrollment_count varchar [note: 'Minimum number of enrolled members required for a group to qualify for this rate schedule type.']
  minimum_premium_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Minimum total premium amount required for a group to qualify for this rate schedule type, often used for small group minimum premium requirements.']
  name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the rate schedule type methodology (e.g., Age-Banded Rating, Geographic Area Rating, Group Size Rating, Composite Rating, Tiered Rating).']
  participation_rate_factor_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether employee participation rate (percentage of eligible employees enrolling) is used as a rating factor in this schedule type.']
  pooling_point_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Dollar threshold above which individual large claims are pooled and excluded from experience rating calculations to protect against catastrophic claim volatility.']
  pre_existing_condition_exclusion_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether pre-existing condition exclusions are permitted under this rate schedule type (prohibited for ACA-compliant plans, may be allowed for grandfathered or excepted benefit plans).']
  product_type varchar [note: 'Type of health insurance product to which this rate schedule applies (Health Maintenance Organization, Preferred Provider Organization, Exclusive Provider Organization, Point of Service, High Deductible Health Plan, Indemnity, Medicare Advantage, Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug, Prescription Drug Plan, Special Needs Plan, Dual Eligible SNP, Chronic Condition SNP, Institutional SNP, or Medicaid Managed Care).']
  raf_applicable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Risk Adjustment Factor scoring is applied in this rate schedule type, typically used for Medicare Advantage and ACA marketplace plans.']
  rate_adjustment_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which rates under this schedule type can be adjusted (monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, annually, every two years, only at renewal, or not applicable for guaranteed rates).']
  rate_cap_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum percentage by which rates can increase at renewal under this schedule type, if a rate cap mechanism is in place.']
  rate_development_method varchar [note: 'Primary actuarial method used to develop rates under this schedule type (manual rate from book rates, experience-rated from group claims, blended manual and experience, prospective projection, retrospective adjustment, or custom methodology).']
  rate_filing_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether rates under this schedule type must be filed with and approved by state insurance departments or CMS before use.']
  rate_guarantee_period_months varchar [note: 'Number of months for which rates under this schedule type are guaranteed without change, typically 12 months for annual contracts or 24 months for multi-year agreements.']
  rate_review_threshold_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage increase threshold that triggers regulatory rate review (e.g., 10% annual increase under ACA rate review provisions).']
  rate_stability_mechanism varchar [note: 'Mechanism used to stabilize rates and manage volatility (rate cap limiting increases, rate collar with min/max bounds, experience refund for favorable claims, retrospective premium adjustment, or none).']
  rating_methodology varchar [note: 'Specific methodology used to determine premium rates within this schedule type (age bands, geographic rating areas, group size factors, industry classification, participation rates, employer contribution levels, composite rates, tier structures, experience modification, manual rates, or custom factors).']
  regulatory_approval_date date [note: 'Date on which regulatory approval was granted for this rate schedule type by the applicable state insurance department or CMS.']
  regulatory_approval_number varchar [note: 'State insurance department or CMS approval number or SERFF tracking number for this rate schedule type, if regulatory filing was required.']
  renewal_rating_method varchar [note: 'Method by which rates are adjusted at renewal (guaranteed renewable with rate class adjustments only, conditionally renewable with individual adjustments, optionally renewable, non-renewable, or not applicable).']
  risk_adjustment_method varchar [note: 'Method used for risk adjustment in rate calculations (Hierarchical Condition Category, prescription drug-based, concurrent model, prospective model, none, or custom methodology).']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the rate schedule type (active and in use, inactive, pending regulatory approval, temporarily suspended, retired/discontinued, or draft/under development).']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date on which this rate schedule type is discontinued and no longer available for new business or renewals.']
  tobacco_rating_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether premium surcharges for tobacco use are permitted under this rate schedule type, subject to regulatory limits (e.g., ACA 1.5:1 tobacco ratio).']
  tobacco_surcharge_max_ratio decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum allowable ratio for tobacco use surcharges (e.g., 1.50 represents a 50% surcharge limit under ACA regulations).']
  trend_factor_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Annual medical cost trend percentage applied in rate projections for this schedule type, reflecting expected healthcare cost inflation.']
  underwriting_class varchar [note: 'Underwriting approach associated with this rate schedule type (guaranteed issue with no health questions, medical underwriting with health screening, simplified issue with limited questions, or not applicable).']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version number of this rate schedule type configuration, incremented with each modification to support change tracking and audit history.']
  waiting_period_days varchar [note: 'Maximum waiting period in days before coverage becomes effective under this rate schedule type, capped at 90 days for ACA-compliant group plans.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User ID or name of the person who created this rate schedule type record.']

  Note: 'Classification of rate schedule methodology (e.g., age‑band, geographic, group size).'
}

  prior_authorization_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this attribute requires Prior Authorization (PA) or pre-certification before services can be rendered and covered.']
  product_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the health plan product to which this attribute applies. Links to the parent product catalog entry.']
  quantity_limit varchar [note: 'The maximum quantity or number of services, visits, or units covered under this attribute within a specified time period.']

  regulatory_reference varchar [note: 'Citation or reference to the specific regulation, statute, or guidance that mandates or governs this attribute (e.g., ACA Section 1302, 42 CFR 422.100).']
  service_category varchar [note: 'The category of healthcare service to which this attribute applies (e.g., inpatient, outpatient, emergency, preventive, specialty, pharmacy, behavioral_health, durable_medical_equipment).']
  source varchar [note: 'The source or origin of the attribute definition (e.g., product management, actuarial, compliance, sales, external vendor).']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this attribute was sourced (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthEdge HealthRules, Oracle Health Insurance).']
  star_rating_domain varchar [note: 'The CMS Star Rating domain or category to which this attribute contributes (e.g., Staying Healthy, Managing Chronic Conditions, Member Experience, Drug Safety).']
  state_mandate_code varchar [note: 'Code or identifier for state-specific insurance mandates that require this attribute (e.g., state-mandated benefits, coverage requirements).']
  status varchar [note: 'The current lifecycle status of the product attribute (Active, Inactive, Pending approval, Deprecated, Archived).']
  step_therapy_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this attribute requires step therapy protocols, where members must try lower-cost treatments before higher-cost alternatives are covered.']
  transparency_in_coverage_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this attribute must be included in Transparency in Coverage machine-readable files for price transparency compliance.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The unit of measure for numeric attribute values (e.g., days, dollars, percentage, visits, months). Null for non-numeric attributes.']
  validation_rule varchar [note: 'Business rule or validation logic applied to this attribute to ensure data quality and compliance (e.g., regex pattern, range check, cross-attribute dependency).']
  value varchar [note: 'The value assigned to the attribute key. Stored as string to support flexible data types (numeric values, text, dates, boolean flags).']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version number of this product attribute configuration, incremented with each modification to support change tracking and audit history.']
  waiting_period_days varchar [note: 'The number of days a member must wait after enrollment before this attribute or benefit becomes active (e.g., maternity waiting period, pre-existing condition waiting period).']

  Note: 'Flexible key‑value pairs for extensible plan characteristics not covered by fixed columns.'

  is_mandatory boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this criteria must be satisfied for eligibility (true) or is optional/conditional (false). Mandatory criteria are required for all applicants.']
  is_visible_to_member boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this criteria should be displayed to members in eligibility communications, plan documents, or self-service portals (true) or is for internal use only (false).']

  maximum_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'Maximum numeric value for range-based criteria (e.g., maximum age of 64 for non-Medicare plans, maximum income for Medicaid eligibility).']

  minimum_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'Minimum numeric value for range-based criteria (e.g., minimum age of 18 for adult plans, minimum income threshold for subsidy eligibility).']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this criteria. Ensures criteria remain current with regulatory and business changes.']
  priority_order varchar [note: 'Numeric order in which this criteria should be evaluated within a rule set. Lower numbers are evaluated first to optimize rule processing.']
  regulatory_authority varchar [note: 'Governing body or regulatory authority that mandates or influences this eligibility criteria (e.g., CMS for Medicare, State DOI for state-specific requirements, ACA for marketplace plans).']
  regulatory_reference varchar [note: 'Specific regulation, statute, or policy reference that defines or requires this eligibility criteria (e.g., \'42 CFR 435.119\' for Medicaid income standards, \'ACA Section 1312\' for QHP eligibility).']
  state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter state code where this criteria applies, if criteria is state-specific (e.g., \'CA\' for California Medicaid income thresholds). Null for national criteria.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the eligibility criteria. Active criteria are available for use in eligibility rules; inactive or retired criteria are historical only.']
  superseded_by_criteria_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the eligibility_criteria_id that replaces this criteria when it is retired or updated. Maintains criteria lineage and version history.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit of measurement for numeric criteria values (e.g., years for age, dollars for income, percent for Federal Poverty Level (FPL), employees for employer size).']
  usage_count varchar [note: 'Number of active eligibility rules that currently reference this criteria. Indicates criteria importance and impact of changes.']
  validation_rule varchar [note: 'Business rule or expression used to validate criteria values during configuration or rule setup (e.g., \'minimum_value < maximum_value\', \'effective_date < expiration_date\').']
  value_format varchar [note: 'Format specification or pattern for valid criteria values (e.g., \'MIN-MAX\' for ranges, \'ISO-3166\' for country codes, \'FIPS\' for county codes).']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier for this criteria definition to track changes over time (e.g., \'1.0\', \'2.1\'). Supports criteria versioning and change management.']

  Note: 'Reference data defining criteria such as age ranges, income brackets, or employer size that drive eligibility_rule evaluation.'
}

  cost_center varchar [note: 'The cost center or business unit associated with this premium for internal reporting.']
  cost_sharing_reduction_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the member is eligible for cost-sharing reductions under ACA.']
  coverage_effective_date date [note: 'The date when insurance coverage begins for this premium period.']
  coverage_level varchar [note: 'The level of coverage provided (Individual, Family, Group, etc.).']
  coverage_termination_date date [note: 'The date when insurance coverage ends for this premium period, if applicable.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'The ISO 4217 currency code for the premium amount (e.g., USD).']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date when this premium amount becomes effective.']
  employee_contribution_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The portion of premium paid by the employee through payroll deduction or direct payment.']
  employer_contribution_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The portion of premium paid by the employer on behalf of the employee.']
  enrollment_source varchar [note: 'The source or channel through which the member enrolled (Open Enrollment, Special Enrollment, etc.).']
  exchange_rate decimal(15,6) [note: 'The currency exchange rate applied if premium is calculated in a non-base currency.']
  family_tier varchar [note: 'The coverage tier indicating who is covered under the policy (Employee Only, Family, etc.).']
  family_tier_factor decimal(10,6) [note: 'The multiplier applied to base premium based on family tier coverage.']

  geographic_rating_factor decimal(10,6) [note: 'The geographic area rating factor applied based on member location.']
  grace_period_end_date date [note: 'The end date of the grace period after which coverage may be terminated for non-payment.']
  grace_period_start_date date [note: 'The start date of the grace period for late premium payment.']
  group_discount_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Premium discount applied based on group size or favorable claims experience.']
  hcc_score decimal(10,4) [note: 'The member\'s HCC risk score reflecting chronic conditions and expected healthcare costs.']
  invoice_date date [note: 'The date the premium invoice was generated.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this premium record was last modified.']
  line_of_business varchar [note: 'The insurance product line or market segment for this premium (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid).']
  marketplace_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the plan was purchased through a federal or state health insurance marketplace.']
  medical_loss_ratio decimal(5,4) [note: 'The ratio of claims and quality improvement expenses to premium revenue, used for ACA rebate calculations.']
  member_age varchar [note: 'The age of the member at the time of premium calculation, used for age-based rating.']
  member_gender varchar [note: 'The gender of the member. Note: ACA prohibits gender-based rating for most plans.']
  member_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the member associated with this premium calculation.']
  member_responsibility_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The total amount the member is responsible to pay (employee contribution minus subsidies).']
  member_zip_code varchar [note: 'The ZIP code of the member\'s primary residence, used for geographic rating.']
  metal_tier varchar [note: 'The ACA metal tier classification for individual and small group plans (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Catastrophic).']
  mlr_rebate_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Rebate amount owed to member or group if MLR thresholds are not met.']
  payment_channel varchar [note: 'The channel through which the premium payment was submitted (Web Portal, Mobile App, Phone, etc.).']
  payment_due_date date [note: 'The date by which the premium payment is due.']
  payment_received_date date [note: 'The date when the premium payment was received.']
  payment_status varchar [note: 'The current payment status of the premium (Pending, Paid, Overdue, Grace Period, etc.).']
  plan_code varchar [note: 'The internal code identifying the specific benefit plan design.']
  plan_name varchar [note: 'The marketing or display name of the benefit plan.']
  product_line varchar [note: 'The product line classification for internal reporting and analytics.']
  rate_basis varchar [note: 'The unit basis for premium calculation (PMPM - Per Member Per Month, PEPM - Per Employee Per Month, etc.).']
  rate_effective_date date [note: 'The effective date of the rate table used for this premium calculation.']
  rate_version varchar [note: 'The version identifier of the rate table used for premium calculation.']
  rating_area varchar [note: 'The geographic rating area code used for premium calculation under ACA rules.']
  rating_method varchar [note: 'The methodology used to calculate premium rates (Community Rated, Experience Rated, Age Banded, etc.).']
  refund_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The amount refunded to the member or group due to overpayment or cancellation.']
  refund_date date [note: 'The date when the premium refund was processed.']
  reinsurance_premium_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Premium amount ceded to reinsurance carriers for risk transfer.']
  retroactive_adjustment_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Premium adjustment amount applied retroactively due to coverage changes, corrections, or reconciliations.']
  retroactive_adjustment_reason varchar [note: 'The reason for the retroactive premium adjustment.']
  retroactive_period_end_date date [note: 'The end date of the period affected by the retroactive adjustment.']
  retroactive_period_start_date date [note: 'The start date of the period affected by the retroactive adjustment.']
  revenue_recognition_date date [note: 'The date when the premium revenue is recognized in financial statements.']
  risk_adjustment_factor decimal(10,6) [note: 'The risk adjustment factor based on member health status and HCC scores, used primarily in Medicare Advantage.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The source system from which this premium record originated (Facets, QNXT, HealthRules, etc.).']
  source_system_id varchar [note: 'The unique identifier for this premium record in the source system.']
  status varchar [note: 'The current status of the premium record (Active, Pending, Cancelled, etc.).']
  stop_loss_premium_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Premium amount for stop-loss insurance coverage in self-funded arrangements.']
  subsidy_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Government subsidy or premium tax credit amount applied to reduce member premium (e.g., ACA APTC).']
  subsidy_eligible_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the member is eligible for premium subsidies or tax credits.']
  tax_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Tax amount applied to the premium (e.g., state premium tax, federal fees).']
  tax_rate decimal(5,4) [note: 'The tax rate percentage applied to calculate premium taxes.']
  tobacco_surcharge_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Additional premium charged for tobacco use, where permitted by state law.']
  tobacco_use_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the member uses tobacco products, affecting premium surcharges.']
  total_premium_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The total calculated premium amount for the billing period after all adjustments, surcharges, and discounts.']
  wellness_discount_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Premium discount applied for participation in wellness programs.']
  write_off_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The premium amount written off as uncollectible.']
  write_off_date date [note: 'The date when the premium amount was written off.']

  Note: 'Calculated premium amount for a member or group for a billing period, based on plan rates, rating factors, and member attributes.'
}

Table billing.premium_rate {
  premium_rate_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the premium rate record. Primary key for the premium rate master table.']
  agreement_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Premium rates are established in group/employer agreements. Rating department sets rates per contract terms, and billing applies these rates when generating member invoices.']
  benefit_design_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to government.benefit_design. Business justification: Government program premium rates are directly tied to approved benefit designs (Medicare Advantage plans, Medicaid managed care). Rating engine uses this to calculate compliant premiums.']
  billing_rule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to billing.billing_rule. Business justification: Premium rates are governed by billing rules that define calculation methods, discounts, and other rate-related business logic. This FK links rates to their governing rules.']
  rate_schedule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to shared.rate_schedule. Business justification: Premium rates are derived from regulatory-approved rate schedules that specify pricing by demographic factors. Underwriting and billing use these to ensure compliant rate application across all polici']
  aca_compliant_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this rate complies with ACA requirements, including essential health benefits, actuarial value, and rating rules.']
  actuarial_value decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of total average costs for covered benefits that the plan will cover, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.70 for 70% actuarial value).']
  actuary_credential varchar [note: 'Professional actuarial credential of the certifying actuary, such as Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA), Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS), or Member of the American Academy of Actuaries (MAAA).']
  actuary_name varchar [note: 'Name of the credentialed actuary responsible for developing and certifying this rate, used for regulatory filings and audit purposes.']
  administrative_cost_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of premium allocated to administrative costs, used in rate development and Medical Loss Ratio (MLR) calculations, expressed as a decimal.']
  age_band varchar [note: 'Age range bracket used for age-based premium rating, typically expressed as ranges such as 18-24, 25-29, 30-34, or 65+.']
  benefit_design_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the specific benefit design configuration associated with this rate, linking rates to benefit structures.']
  commission_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of premium allocated for broker or agent commissions, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 for 5% commission).']
  composite_rate_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this is a composite rate (true) or an age-banded rate (false). Composite rates are single rates regardless of age.']
  contribution_requirement_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The minimum percentage of premium that the employer must contribute for the group to qualify for this rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.50 for 50%).']
  county_code varchar [note: 'County FIPS code for county-level rating granularity where applicable, used in geographic rating methodologies.']

  geographic_adjustment_factor decimal(6,4) [note: 'Factor applied to adjust rates based on geographic cost variations, reflecting differences in healthcare costs across regions.']
  grandfathered_plan_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this rate applies to a grandfathered plan under ACA, which is exempt from certain ACA requirements.']
  hcc_score decimal(8,4) [note: 'HCC risk score used in Medicare Advantage risk adjustment to adjust premium rates based on member diagnoses and health conditions.']
  industry_code varchar [note: 'NAICS or SIC industry classification code used for industry-based rating adjustments in experience-rated or composite-rated groups.']
  lob varchar [note: 'The line of business to which this rate applies, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Individual, or Group coverage.']
  maximum_premium_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'Maximum premium amount cap for this rate, used in rate capping scenarios or regulatory maximum premium requirements.']
  medical_trend_factor decimal(6,4) [note: 'Factor representing expected medical cost trend used in rate development, reflecting anticipated increases in healthcare costs.']
  metal_level varchar [note: 'ACA metal level classification indicating the actuarial value of the plan: Bronze (60%), Silver (70%), Gold (80%), Platinum (90%), or Catastrophic.']
  minimum_group_size varchar [note: 'The minimum number of eligible employees or members required for this rate to apply, used in group rating methodologies.']
  minimum_premium_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'Minimum premium amount required for this rate to apply, used in group rating to ensure minimum revenue thresholds.']
  mlr_reporting_category varchar [note: 'MLR reporting market segment category for this rate, used in ACA MLR rebate calculations and reporting to CMS.']

  participation_requirement_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The minimum percentage of eligible employees that must enroll for the group to qualify for this rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 for 75%).']
  pharmacy_trend_factor decimal(6,4) [note: 'Factor representing expected pharmacy cost trend used in rate development, reflecting anticipated increases in prescription drug costs.']
  plan_type varchar [note: 'Type of health plan for which the rate applies, including Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), Point of Service (POS), High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), or Special Needs Plan (SNP) variants.']
  plan_version_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Premium rates must track specific plan versions as benefits and cost-sharing change over time. Ensures correct historical rating for renewals and retroactive adjustments.']
  pooling_point_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'Dollar amount threshold above which individual claims are pooled and excluded from experience rating calculations to protect against catastrophic claims.']

  rate_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'The premium rate amount for the specified rating factors. This is the base rate used in premium calculations.']
  rate_approval_date date [note: 'The date on which the rate filing was approved by the regulatory authority, allowing the rates to be used.']

  rate_cell_identifier varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the specific rate cell combining all rating factors, used for precise rate lookup in premium calculation systems.']
  rate_created_date date [note: 'Date when this rate record was initially created in the system, used for audit and data lineage purposes.']
  rate_development_date date [note: 'Date when the actuarial rate development and analysis was completed for this rate schedule.']
  rate_discount_factor decimal(6,4) [note: 'Discount factor applied to reduce the base rate for favorable risk characteristics, volume discounts, or promotional pricing.']

Table billing.cycle {
  cycle_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the billing cycle record. Primary key for the billing cycle entity.']
  billing_rule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to billing.billing_rule. Business justification: Billing cycles are governed by billing rules that define cycle frequencies, grace periods, and other cycle-related business logic. This FK links billing cycles to their governing rules.']
  grace_period_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to billing.grace_period. Business justification: Billing cycles have grace periods. Need to link to the grace period policy for the cycle. Cannot remove grace_period_days or grace_period_end_date as they are cycle-specific calculated values.']

  member_count varchar [note: 'Total number of members covered during this billing cycle, used for PMPM calculations and reporting.']

  payment_received_date date [note: 'The date when payment for this billing cycle was received and posted to the account.']
  payment_status varchar [note: 'Current payment status of the billing cycle indicating whether it is paid in full, partially paid, unpaid, overdue, refunded, or written off.']
  pepm_rate decimal(15,2) [note: 'The premium rate charged per employee per month for this billing cycle. Used in group billing calculations.']
  pmpm_rate decimal(15,2) [note: 'The premium rate charged per member per month for this billing cycle. Used in capitation and individual billing calculations.']

  reinsurance_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Reinsurance payment or recovery amount associated with this billing cycle, used to offset high-cost claims.']
  retroactive_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this billing cycle includes retroactive adjustments for prior periods due to eligibility changes or rate corrections.']
  retroactive_period_end_date date [note: 'The end date of the period for which retroactive adjustments are being applied in this billing cycle.']
  retroactive_period_start_date date [note: 'The start date of the period for which retroactive adjustments are being applied in this billing cycle.']
  revenue_recognition_date date [note: 'The date when premium revenue for this billing cycle is recognized in financial statements according to GAAP revenue recognition principles.']
  risk_adjustment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Risk adjustment payment or charge applied to this billing cycle based on member health status and HCC scores, used in Medicare Advantage and ACA plans.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this billing cycle data originated (Facets, QNXT, HealthRules, Oracle Health Insurance, SAP S/4HANA).']
  source_system_id varchar [note: 'The unique identifier for this billing cycle in the source operational system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.']
  start_date date [note: 'The date when the billing cycle period begins. Used to determine coverage period for premium calculation.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the billing cycle indicating whether it is active, closed, pending processing, cancelled, or suspended.']
  subscriber_count varchar [note: 'Total number of primary subscribers (policyholders) in this billing cycle, excluding dependents.']

  line_of_business varchar [note: 'The line of business or product type associated with the billing account under hold (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Individual, Administrative Services Only).']
  next_review_date date [note: 'The scheduled date for the next review of the hold status.']
  payment_issue_type varchar [note: 'The specific type of payment issue that caused the hold (e.g., insufficient funds, payment reversal, chargeback, grace period).']
  placed_by_department varchar [note: 'The department or business unit that initiated the hold (e.g., Billing Operations, Compliance, Fraud Investigation, Customer Service).']

  premium_type varchar [note: 'The type of premium calculation method used for the billing account under hold (e.g., Per Member Per Month, Per Employee Per Month, flat rate, tiered).']

  product_code varchar [note: 'The specific health plan product code associated with the billing account under hold.']

  regulatory_report_date date [note: 'The date when the hold was reported to regulatory authorities.']
  regulatory_reporting_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the hold must be reported to regulatory authorities (e.g., state insurance departments, CMS).']
  related_claim_number varchar [note: 'The claim number associated with the billing hold, if the hold is related to a specific claim issue.']
  released_by_user_name varchar [note: 'The name of the user who released the hold on the billing account.']
  released_date date [note: 'The date when the hold was released or resolved.']
  released_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time when the hold was released or resolved.']
  resolution_notes varchar [note: 'Detailed notes documenting the actions taken and outcome of the hold resolution process.']
  retroactive_adjustment_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the hold is related to a retroactive adjustment to billing or coverage.']
  retroactive_effective_date date [note: 'The effective date of the retroactive adjustment that triggered the hold.']

  write_off_risk_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the hold poses a risk of requiring a financial write-off.']

  Note: 'Hold records placed on billing accounts due to disputes, eligibility issues, or compliance flags.'

  approver_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the individual who approved the retroactive adjustment.']
  aso_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the policy is an Administrative Services Only arrangement where the employer assumes financial risk.']
  audit_trail_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes documenting the audit trail, decision rationale, or additional context for the retroactive adjustment.']
  billing_account_number varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the billing account to which the retroactive adjustment is applied.']
  business_unit varchar [note: 'Business unit or division responsible for the policy or account being adjusted retroactively.']
  capitation_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the retroactive adjustment involves capitation payments to providers based on member enrollment.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Additional free-text comments or notes providing context or explanation for the retroactive adjustment.']
  cost_center varchar [note: 'Cost center or department code associated with the retroactive adjustment for internal financial tracking.']
  coverage_end_date date [note: 'Effective end date of coverage for the member or policy being adjusted retroactively.']
  coverage_start_date date [note: 'Effective start date of coverage for the member or policy being adjusted retroactively.']
  coverage_tier varchar [note: 'Level of coverage indicating who is covered under the policy, such as employee only, employee plus spouse, or family coverage.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO currency code for the monetary amounts in this adjustment, typically USD for United States Dollar.']
  dispute_date date [note: 'Date when a dispute was filed regarding the retroactive adjustment.']
  dispute_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the retroactive adjustment is under dispute or has been contested by the member or employer.']
  dispute_resolution_date date [note: 'Date when the dispute regarding the retroactive adjustment was resolved.']
  employer_name varchar [note: 'Legal name of the employer or group sponsor for group health insurance policies being adjusted.']
  enrollment_change_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the retroactive adjustment involves a change in member enrollment or coverage status.']
  error_code varchar [note: 'System error code if the retroactive adjustment encountered processing errors or validation failures.']
  error_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of any error encountered during processing of the retroactive adjustment.']
  funding_arrangement varchar [note: 'Type of funding arrangement for the group policy, such as fully insured or Administrative Services Only (ASO).']
  general_ledger_account varchar [note: 'General ledger account code to which the retroactive adjustment is posted for financial accounting.']
  grace_period_end_date date [note: 'End date of the grace period during which premium payments were accepted before coverage termination.']
  grace_period_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the retroactive adjustment is related to premium payments made during a grace period.']
  group_number varchar [note: 'Identifier for the employer or group account associated with the policy being adjusted, applicable for group health plans.']
  invoice_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of the original invoice being adjusted retroactively.']
  line_of_business varchar [note: 'Business segment or product line to which the adjusted policy belongs, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage, or Medicaid.']
  market_segment varchar [note: 'Market segment classification for the policy being adjusted, such as individual, small group, or large group.']
  member_count_adjusted varchar [note: 'Corrected number of covered members after applying the retroactive adjustment, reflecting enrollment changes.']
  member_count_original varchar [note: 'Number of covered members during the original billing period before the retroactive adjustment.']
  member_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the health plan member whose coverage or premium is being adjusted retroactively.']
  notification_date date [note: 'Date when notification of the retroactive adjustment was sent to affected parties.']
  notification_method varchar [note: 'Method used to notify affected parties about the retroactive adjustment, such as email, postal mail, or member portal.']
  notification_sent_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether notification of the retroactive adjustment was sent to the member, employer, or broker.']
  original_billing_period_end_date date [note: 'End date of the original billing period being adjusted retroactively.']
  original_billing_period_start_date date [note: 'Start date of the original billing period being adjusted retroactively.']
  original_invoice_date date [note: 'Date when the original invoice was issued for the billing period being adjusted.']
  original_premium_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The original premium amount that was billed for the affected billing period before the retroactive adjustment.']
  original_rate decimal(15,4) [note: 'The original premium rate applied during the billing period before the retroactive adjustment.']
  payment_received_date date [note: 'Date when the premium payment related to the retroactive adjustment was received.']
  payment_reference_number varchar [note: 'Unique reference number for the payment transaction related to the retroactive adjustment.']
  pepm_adjusted decimal(15,2) [note: 'Adjusted per employee per month premium rate after applying the retroactive correction.']
  pepm_original decimal(15,2) [note: 'Original per employee per month premium rate before the retroactive adjustment, used in employer group billing.']
  plan_type varchar [note: 'Type of health plan structure such as Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), or High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP).']
  pmpm_adjusted decimal(15,2) [note: 'Adjusted per member per month premium rate after applying the retroactive correction.']
  pmpm_original decimal(15,2) [note: 'Original per member per month premium rate before the retroactive adjustment, commonly used in capitation and group billing.']
  policy_amendment_number varchar [note: 'Reference number for the policy amendment that triggered the retroactive adjustment.']
  policy_number varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the insurance policy to which this retroactive adjustment applies.']
  product_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the specific health insurance product or plan type being adjusted.']
  product_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the health insurance product or plan associated with the retroactive adjustment.']
  rate_change_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage change in the premium rate from the original to the adjusted rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5% increase).']
  rate_filing_effective_date date [note: 'Effective date of the approved rate filing that triggered the retroactive rate change adjustment.']
  reconciliation_status varchar [note: 'Status of the reconciliation process for the retroactive adjustment with financial systems and accounts receivable.']
  region_code varchar [note: 'Geographic region code where the policy or member is located, used for regional reporting and analysis.']
  regulatory_filing_number varchar [note: 'Reference number for regulatory rate or form filing that authorized the retroactive adjustment.']
  reinstatement_date date [note: 'Date when coverage was reinstated following a termination, applicable for reinstatement adjustments.']
  requestor_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the user who initiated or requested the retroactive adjustment.']
  requestor_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the individual who requested the retroactive adjustment.']
  revenue_impact decimal(15,2) [note: 'Financial impact of the retroactive adjustment on recognized premium revenue for the affected period.']
  reversal_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this retroactive adjustment reverses a previous adjustment transaction.']
  state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter US state code where the policy is issued or the member resides, relevant for state-specific regulatory compliance.']
  system_source varchar [note: 'Source system or application that generated or processed the retroactive adjustment transaction.']
  tax_id_number varchar [note: 'Federal Tax Identification Number for the employer or group sponsor, used for tax reporting and billing purposes.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when the policy or member coverage was terminated, relevant for termination reversal adjustments.']
  transaction_id varchar [note: 'Unique transaction identifier for the retroactive adjustment in the billing system, used for audit trail and reconciliation.']

  Note: 'Adjustments applied retroactively to prior billing periods due to rate changes, corrections, or policy amendments.'
}

Table billing.payment_method {
  payment_method_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the payment method record. Primary key for the payment method entity.']
  billing_rule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to billing.billing_rule. Business justification: Payment methods are governed by billing rules that define processing fees, transaction limits, and other payment-related business logic. This FK links payment methods to their governing rules.']

  subsidy_eligibility_status varchar [note: 'Status of member eligibility for premium subsidies at the time of billing.']
  subsidy_type varchar [note: 'Type of subsidy applied, such as Advanced Premium Tax Credit (APTC), Cost Sharing Reduction (CSR), state subsidy, employer contribution, or none.']
  system_error_code varchar [note: 'System-generated error code associated with the exception, if applicable.']
  system_error_message varchar [note: 'System-generated error message providing details about the exception.']
  tobacco_rating_factor decimal(5,3) [note: 'Tobacco use rating factor applied in premium calculation.']
  type_code varchar [note: 'Code representing the type of billing exception encountered, such as Coordination of Benefits (COB) conflict, eligibility lapse, rate mismatch, premium calculation error, retroactive adjustment, grace period violation, payment reversal, capitation error, commission discrepancy, Administrative Services Only (ASO) billing error, duplicate billing, missing enrollment, invalid group, coverage gap, subsidy mismatch, age rating error, tier assignment error, dependent eligibility issue, Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) billing error, or late enrollment penalty.']
  variance_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Calculated difference between expected and actual amounts (variance = actual - expected).']

  Note: 'Exception types for billing anomalies (e.g., coordination of benefits conflict, eligibility lapse, rate mismatch).'
}

Table billing.grace_period {
  grace_period_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the grace period configuration record.']
  applies_to_new_enrollments boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this grace period applies to newly enrolled members or only to existing members with established payment history.']
  applies_to_renewals boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this grace period applies to policy renewals or only to initial enrollment periods.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'Approval workflow status for this grace period configuration, indicating whether it is in draft, pending review, approved for use, or rejected.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'User identifier or name of the person who approved this grace period configuration for production use.']
  approved_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this grace period configuration was approved for production use.']
  aptc_liability_month_1 boolean [note: 'For marketplace plans with APTC, indicates whether the insurer is liable for claims incurred during the first month of the 90-day grace period.']
  aptc_liability_month_2_3 boolean [note: 'For marketplace plans with APTC, indicates whether the insurer is liable for claims incurred during the second and third months of the 90-day grace period, or if providers are responsible for collection.']
  aptc_recipient_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this grace period configuration applies specifically to members receiving Advance Premium Tax Credits through the health insurance marketplace, who are subject to special 90-day grace period rules.']
  auto_termination_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether coverage is automatically terminated by the system at the end of the grace period if payment is not received, or if manual review is required.']
  claims_pended_during_grace boolean [note: 'Indicates whether claims incurred during the grace period are pended (held) pending premium payment resolution, or processed normally.']
  cobra_continuation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this grace period configuration applies to Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) continuation coverage.']
  coverage_continues_during_grace boolean [note: 'Indicates whether health coverage remains active and claims are paid during the grace period, or if coverage is suspended pending payment.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this grace period configuration record was created in the system.']
  duration_days varchar [note: 'Number of days allowed for premium payment after the due date before late fees, penalties, or coverage termination actions are initiated.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when this grace period configuration becomes effective and applicable to premium billing cycles.']
  employer_group_size_max varchar [note: 'Maximum employer group size (number of employees) for which this grace period configuration applies.']
  employer_group_size_min varchar [note: 'Minimum employer group size (number of employees) for which this grace period configuration applies, as grace periods may differ for small vs. large groups.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date when this grace period configuration expires and is no longer applicable, allowing for time-bound grace period rules.']
  extension_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the grace period can be extended under special circumstances such as natural disasters, military deployment, or other hardship situations.']
  extension_max_days varchar [note: 'Maximum number of additional days that the grace period can be extended under approved circumstances.']
  funding_arrangement varchar [note: 'Funding arrangement for the plan, such as fully insured, Administrative Services Only (ASO), level funded, or self-funded, which may affect grace period terms.']
  hardship_exemption_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether members in this plan type are eligible for hardship exemptions that may affect grace period terms or termination procedures.']
  late_fee_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Fixed dollar amount charged as a late fee if premium payment is not received within the grace period.']
  late_fee_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the outstanding premium amount charged as a late fee if payment is not received within the grace period.']
  lob varchar [note: 'Line of business category for the grace period, indicating whether it applies to commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, dual eligible, or exchange products.']
  marketplace_duration_days varchar [note: 'Specific grace period duration for Qualified Health Plans (QHP) sold through federally facilitated or state-based marketplaces, typically 90 days per ACA requirements for members receiving advance premium tax credits.']
  medicare_secondary_payer_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Medicare Secondary Payer rules apply during the grace period, affecting coordination of benefits and claims processing.']
  minimum_payment_required decimal(10,2) [note: 'Minimum payment amount that must be received during the grace period to avoid termination, which may be less than the full premium due.']

  notification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the insurer is required to notify the member when they enter a grace period due to non-payment of premium.']
  notification_timing_days varchar [note: 'Number of days before or after the grace period begins that the member must be notified of their grace period status.']

  premium_payment_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which premiums are billed and due, which may affect grace period application and duration.']
  product_code varchar [note: 'Internal product code identifying the specific insurance product or plan design to which this grace period applies.']
  product_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the insurance product or plan to which this grace period configuration applies.']
  provider_notification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether providers must be notified when a member is in grace period status, particularly relevant for marketplace plans where provider liability may apply.']
  regulatory_reference varchar [note: 'Citation or reference to the specific state or federal regulation that mandates or governs this grace period configuration.']
  reinstatement_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a member whose coverage was terminated due to non-payment can have their coverage reinstated if they pay outstanding premiums within a specified timeframe.']
  reinstatement_period_days varchar [note: 'Number of days after termination during which a member can reinstate coverage by paying outstanding premiums and any applicable fees.']
  retroactive_termination_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether coverage can be retroactively terminated to the end of the last paid period if premium is not received by the end of the grace period.']
  retroactive_termination_date date [note: 'Specific date to which coverage is retroactively terminated if premium payment is not received within the grace period, typically the last day of the last paid coverage period.']
  special_enrollment_period_impact boolean [note: 'Indicates whether grace period rules are modified for members who enrolled during a Special Enrollment Period rather than open enrollment.']
  state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter state code indicating the jurisdiction whose regulations govern this grace period configuration, as grace period requirements vary by state.']

  Note: 'Definition of grace period lengths and conditions for premium payments before late fees apply.'

  unapplied_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The portion of the payment that could not be matched to an invoice and remains unapplied, requiring further investigation or manual intervention.']
  underpayment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The amount by which the payment falls short of the invoice balance, resulting in a remaining balance due.']
  write_off_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The monetary amount of the invoice balance that was written off as uncollectible during the reconciliation process.']
  write_off_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether any portion of the invoice balance was written off as uncollectible during reconciliation.']
  write_off_reason_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code indicating the reason for writing off the balance, such as bankruptcy, deceased member, or small balance adjustment.']

  Note: 'Records matching payments to invoices, handling unapplied amounts, and posting reconciliation results.'
}

  aca_essential_health_benefit boolean [note: 'Indicates whether services in this care setting are considered part of the ACA Essential Health Benefits package for qualified health plans.']
  acuity_level varchar [note: 'General acuity or intensity level of care typically associated with this care setting.']
  allows_auto_approval boolean [note: 'Indicates whether authorization requests for this care setting can be auto-approved based on predefined criteria without manual clinical review.']
  allows_retrospective_review boolean [note: 'Indicates whether retrospective review (post-service review) is permitted for services delivered in this care setting, typically for emergency or urgent situations.']
  appeals_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether members or providers can appeal adverse authorization decisions for this care setting.']
  applicable_lob varchar [note: 'Pipe-separated list of lines of business where this care setting code is applicable (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Exchange).']
  authorization_urgency_level varchar [note: 'Default urgency level for prior authorization requests associated with this care setting, determining review timeframes per regulatory requirements.']
  case_management_trigger boolean [note: 'Indicates whether authorizations in this care setting automatically trigger case management or care coordination outreach.']
  category varchar [note: 'High-level categorization of the care setting for grouping and reporting purposes.']
  clinical_guideline_set varchar [note: 'Primary clinical decision support guideline set used for medical necessity determinations for this care setting (e.g., InterQual, MCG, internal criteria).']
  code varchar [note: 'Standardized code representing the care setting type where healthcare services are delivered. Used in prior authorization requests and claims processing.']
  commercial_covered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this care setting is typically covered under commercial health insurance products.']
  concurrent_review_frequency_days varchar [note: 'Standard frequency in days for conducting concurrent reviews for authorizations in this care setting.']
  cost_sharing_applies boolean [note: 'Indicates whether member cost sharing (copay, coinsurance, deductible) typically applies to services in this care setting.']
  default_authorization_units varchar [note: 'Standard unit of measure for authorizations in this care setting (e.g., days for inpatient, visits for outpatient, hours for home health).']
  description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the care setting, including the types of services typically delivered in this setting and clinical context.']
  discharge_planning_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether formal discharge planning is required for members receiving care in this setting to ensure appropriate transitions of care.']
  display_order varchar [note: 'Numeric value controlling the display sequence of care setting codes in user interfaces and selection lists.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when this care setting code became effective and available for use in authorization requests.']
  emergency_services_classification varchar [note: 'Classification of whether this care setting is considered emergency, urgent, or non-urgent for purposes of coverage and authorization requirements.']
  expedited_review_timeframe_hours varchar [note: 'Maximum number of hours allowed for expedited prior authorization review for this care setting when member\'s health could be seriously jeopardized.']
  external_code_mapping varchar [note: 'Mapping to external standard code sets or partner system codes for interoperability and data exchange.']
  external_review_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether adverse determinations for this care setting are eligible for independent external review by an independent review organization.']
  hedis_reportable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether utilization in this care setting is tracked for HEDIS quality measure reporting.']
  is_default boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this care setting should be used as the default selection in authorization workflows when no specific setting is specified.']
  is_facility_based boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this care setting represents a facility-based location (hospital, SNF) versus non-facility (office, home).']
  is_institutional boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this care setting is considered institutional for billing purposes, requiring UB-04 claim forms rather than CMS-1500.']
  last_updated_date date [note: 'Date when this care setting record was last modified or updated.']
  max_initial_authorization_units varchar [note: 'Maximum number of units that can be authorized in an initial authorization request for this care setting before requiring extension or continuation review.']
  medicaid_covered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this care setting is covered under Medicaid managed care plans.']
  medicare_covered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this care setting is covered under Medicare Advantage plans.']
  name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the care setting (e.g., Inpatient Hospital, Outpatient Clinic, Emergency Department, Home Health).']
  network_adequacy_category varchar [note: 'Network adequacy category for this care setting used in network access and availability reporting to regulators.']
  no_surprises_act_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the No Surprises Act protections against balance billing apply to services in this care setting.']
  notification_required_timeframe_hours varchar [note: 'Number of hours within which the health plan must be notified of services in this care setting (e.g., 24-hour notification for emergency admissions).']
  out_of_network_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether services in this care setting can be authorized and covered when delivered by out-of-network providers.']
  pos_code varchar [note: 'Two-digit CMS Place of Service code that identifies the location where healthcare services are provided. Used in claims adjudication and prior authorization.']
  requires_concurrent_review boolean [note: 'Indicates whether ongoing concurrent review is required during the course of care in this setting to monitor continued medical necessity and appropriate level of care.']
  requires_facility_certification boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the facility providing services in this care setting must hold specific certifications or accreditations for coverage.']
  requires_medical_necessity_review boolean [note: 'Indicates whether services in this care setting require formal medical necessity review using clinical criteria.']
  requires_peer_to_peer_review boolean [note: 'Indicates whether adverse determinations for this care setting require a peer-to-peer discussion between the reviewing medical director and requesting provider before final denial.']
  requires_physician_order boolean [note: 'Indicates whether services in this care setting require a physician order or referral as part of the authorization process.']
  requires_prior_authorization boolean [note: 'Indicates whether services delivered in this care setting typically require prior authorization approval before services are rendered.']
  revenue_code varchar [note: 'Four-digit revenue code used on institutional claims (UB-04) to identify specific accommodation, ancillary service, or billing calculation related to the care setting.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Name of the source system or reference data repository from which this care setting code originates (e.g., Facets, QNXT, Pegasystems).']
  standard_review_timeframe_hours varchar [note: 'Maximum number of hours allowed for standard prior authorization review for this care setting, per regulatory requirements.']
  stars_rating_impact boolean [note: 'Indicates whether utilization management performance for this care setting impacts Medicare Advantage Stars ratings.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of this care setting code in the authorization system.']
  supports_telehealth boolean [note: 'Indicates whether telehealth or telemedicine services can be delivered in this care setting per regulatory and coverage policies.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when this care setting code was terminated or deprecated and is no longer valid for new authorization requests.']
  transition_of_care_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this care setting is eligible for transition of care protocols when members move between care settings or providers.']
  type_of_bill_code varchar [note: 'Three-digit code on institutional claims indicating the type of facility, care type, and billing frequency. First digit indicates facility type, second indicates care type, third indicates sequence.']
  typical_cost_sharing_type varchar [note: 'Most common type of member cost sharing applied to services in this care setting.']
  typical_length_of_stay_days varchar [note: 'Average or typical length of stay in days for this care setting, used for authorization duration planning and utilization benchmarking.']

  Note: 'Codes indicating the care setting (inpatient, outpatient, ED, home health) for which authorization is sought.'
}

Table authorization.priority_level {
  priority_level_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the priority level record. Primary key for the priority level entity.']
  notification_template_id varchar [note: 'Identifier for the communication template used for member and provider notifications at this priority level.']

  applies_to_behavioral_health boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this priority level applies to behavioral health and mental health service authorizations.']
  applies_to_commercial boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this priority level applies to commercial health insurance authorization requests.']
  applies_to_dme boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this priority level applies to durable medical equipment authorization requests.']

  applies_to_outpatient boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this priority level applies to outpatient procedures and services.']
  applies_to_pharmacy boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this priority level applies to pharmacy benefit prior authorizations.']

  category varchar [note: 'High-level category classifying the priority level by business context (clinical urgency, administrative processing, operational workflow).']
  clinical_review_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether authorization requests at this priority level must undergo clinical review by a licensed healthcare professional.']

  code varchar [note: 'Short alphanumeric code representing the priority level (e.g., ROUTINE, URGENT, STAT, EMERGENCY). Used for system processing and integration.']
  concurrent_review_interval_hours decimal(10,2) [note: 'Frequency in hours at which concurrent review must be performed for ongoing services authorized at this priority level.']
  created_date date [note: 'Date when this priority level record was originally created in the system.']
  description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the priority level, including clinical scenarios and use cases where this priority applies.']
  display_color_code varchar [note: 'Hexadecimal color code used for visual display of this priority level in user interfaces (e.g., red for urgent, yellow for routine).']
  display_icon varchar [note: 'Icon identifier or name used for visual representation of this priority level in user interfaces.']
  display_order varchar [note: 'Numeric order in which this priority level should be displayed in dropdown lists and user interfaces.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'Date after which this priority level definition is no longer active and cannot be assigned to new authorization requests.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'Date from which this priority level definition becomes active and available for use in authorization workflows.']
  escalation_threshold_hours decimal(10,2) [note: 'Number of hours before SLA breach at which automatic escalation is triggered for this priority level.']
  expedited_appeal_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether denials at this priority level are eligible for expedited appeal processes due to urgency.']
  external_review_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether denials at this priority level are eligible for independent external review processes.']
  holiday_processing boolean [note: 'Indicates whether authorization requests at this priority level are processed on company holidays.']
  interqual_mapping_code varchar [note: 'Code used to map this priority level to InterQual clinical decision support criteria and urgency classifications.']
  last_modified_date date [note: 'Date when this priority level record was last updated or modified.']
  mcg_mapping_code varchar [note: 'Code used to map this priority level to MCG clinical guidelines and urgency classifications.']
  medical_director_review_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether authorization requests at this priority level require review and approval by a medical director.']
  name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the priority level (e.g., Routine, Urgent, Stat, Emergency). Human-readable display value.']
  ncqa_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this priority level definition meets NCQA utilization management accreditation standards.']
  notification_frequency_hours decimal(10,2) [note: 'Frequency in hours at which status notifications are sent to stakeholders for authorization requests at this priority level.']
  peer_to_peer_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether providers can request peer-to-peer clinical discussions for authorization requests at this priority level.']
  regulatory_timeframe_days varchar [note: 'Regulatory maximum number of days allowed for authorization decision at this priority level, as mandated by CMS or state regulations.']
  requires_immediate_review boolean [note: 'Indicates whether authorization requests at this priority level require immediate clinical review without queuing delays.']
  retirement_date date [note: 'Date when this priority level definition was retired or deprecated from active use.']
  retrospective_review_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether retrospective review is permitted for services at this priority level, or if prospective authorization is mandatory.']
  severity_rank varchar [note: 'Numeric ranking indicating the relative urgency or severity of this priority level. Lower numbers indicate higher urgency (e.g., 1=most urgent).']
  sla_business_days varchar [note: 'Target number of business days for authorization decision completion at this priority level, excluding weekends and holidays.']
  sla_decision_hours decimal(10,2) [note: 'Target number of hours within which a final authorization decision must be rendered for requests at this priority level.']
  sla_response_hours decimal(10,2) [note: 'Target number of hours within which an initial response must be provided for authorization requests at this priority level.']
  state_regulatory_code varchar [note: 'State-specific regulatory code or classification for this priority level, supporting compliance with state insurance department requirements.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the priority level definition (active, inactive, deprecated, pending approval).']
  urac_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this priority level definition meets URAC utilization review accreditation standards.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier for this priority level definition, supporting change tracking and configuration management.']
  weekend_processing boolean [note: 'Indicates whether authorization requests at this priority level are processed on weekends.']
  workflow_routing_rule varchar [note: 'Business rule or logic identifier that determines how authorization requests at this priority level are routed to review queues and staff.']

  Note: 'Priority categories (routine, urgent, stat) that drive SLA calculations.'
}

  clinical_guideline_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to authorization.clinical_guideline. Business justification: Overrides reference clinical guidelines that were overridden for medical director review and audit purposes.']

Medical directors reference exception ID when o']

  member_profile_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the health plan member for whom the authorization was requested.']

  line_of_business varchar [note: 'Health plan product line under which the member is enrolled and the authorization applies.']
  member_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the health plan member for whom the authorization was requested.']
  member_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the health plan member associated with the authorization override.']
  mlr_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the override has material impact on the plan\'s Medical Loss Ratio calculation.']
  network_status varchar [note: 'Network participation status of the provider at the time of the authorization override.']
  notification_method varchar [note: 'Method used to communicate the override decision to relevant parties.']
  notification_sent_date date [note: 'Date when notification of the override decision was sent to the provider and member.']
  off_label_use_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the override approved off-label use of a medication or device.']
  original_decision varchar [note: 'The initial determination made by the standard authorization process before override.']
  original_decision_date date [note: 'Date when the initial authorization decision was made prior to override.']
  override_decision varchar [note: 'Final determination after the override was applied to the authorization request.']

  override_decision_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the override decision was recorded in the system.']

  override_expiration_date date [note: 'Date when the override authorization expires and standard rules resume.']

  requesting_provider_npi varchar [note: 'Ten-digit National Provider Identifier of the provider who requested the authorization.']
  revocation_date date [note: 'Date when the override was revoked or rescinded, if applicable.']
  revocation_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation for why the override was revoked or rescinded after initial approval.']

  Note: 'Documented overrides granted by senior clinical staff, capturing justification and approver.'
