Table care.risk_score_type {
  risk_score_type_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the risk score type. Primary key for the risk score type reference table.']
  assessment_data_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether health risk assessment (HRA) or member survey data is required as input for calculating risk scores of this type. Common for care management and population health risk scores.']
  audit_risk_level varchar [note: 'Level of audit scrutiny or regulatory oversight associated with this risk score type. High or critical levels indicate scores subject to frequent CMS audits, RADV (Risk Adjustment Data Validation) reviews, or fraud/waste/abuse investigations.']
  average_score decimal(8,4) [note: 'Average or mean risk score value across the applicable population for this score type. Used as a benchmark for comparison and population health analytics.']
  calculation_frequency varchar [note: 'How often risk scores of this type are calculated or updated (e.g., annual for CMS-HCC, quarterly for care management programs, real-time for predictive models).']
  care_management_use_case varchar [note: 'Specific care management or disease management program use cases for this risk score type (e.g., chronic condition identification, high-risk member stratification, care gap closure, transitional care management, preventive care outreach).']
  category varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the risk score type based on the domain or data source used for calculation (e.g., clinical conditions, pharmacy utilization, behavioral health, social determinants of health, composite scores, predictive models).']
  cms_model_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this risk score type is an official CMS-published risk adjustment model (e.g., CMS-HCC, RxHCC) versus a proprietary or custom model developed internally or by a third party.']
  code varchar [note: 'Short alphanumeric code representing the risk score type. Used as a business key for system integration and reporting (e.g., HCC, CMS-HCC-V24, CMS-HCC-V28, RxHCC, VBP).']
  coding_system varchar [note: 'Medical coding system or classification standard used as input for risk score calculation (e.g., ICD-10-CM for diagnoses, HCPCS for procedures, NDC for pharmacy, RxNorm, SNOMED CT, LOINC for lab results).']
  coefficient_count varchar [note: 'Number of coefficients, condition categories, or variables included in the risk score calculation model. Indicates model complexity and granularity.']
  data_source varchar [note: 'Primary data source used to calculate risk scores of this type (e.g., claims, encounters, EHR data, pharmacy claims, lab results, health risk assessments, member surveys, administrative data).']
  demographic_factors_included boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether demographic factors (age, gender, Medicaid/disability status, institutional status) are incorporated into the risk score calculation for this score type.']
  description varchar [note: 'Detailed explanation of the risk score type, including its purpose, calculation methodology, and use cases within care management and value-based care programs.']
  diagnosis_year varchar [note: 'Calendar year from which diagnosis data is collected and used to calculate risk scores of this type. Typically one year prior to payment year for prospective models.']
  documentation_requirements varchar [note: 'Summary of clinical documentation standards and requirements needed to support risk scores of this type (e.g., face-to-face encounter requirements, diagnosis specificity, medical record documentation standards). Critical for RADV audit compliance.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when this risk score type became active and available for use in risk adjustment calculations and care management programs.']
  end_date date [note: 'Date when this risk score type was retired or superseded by a newer version. Null if currently active.']
  external_vendor varchar [note: 'Name of external vendor or third-party organization that developed or maintains this risk score type, if applicable (e.g., Optum, Milliman, Johns Hopkins ACG System). Null for internally developed or CMS-published models.']
  hcc_model_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this risk score type is based on the CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk adjustment model. True for CMS-HCC, RxHCC, and HHS-HCC models.']
  hedis_measure_alignment varchar [note: 'HEDIS quality measures or domains that this risk score type supports or aligns with (e.g., Comprehensive Diabetes Care, Controlling High Blood Pressure, Care for Older Adults). Used to link risk stratification with quality improvement initiatives.']
  hierarchical_logic_applied boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether hierarchical logic is applied in the risk score calculation, where more severe conditions supersede less severe conditions within the same disease category (e.g., severe diabetes supersedes uncomplicated diabetes in HCC models).']
  implementation_date date [note: 'Date when this risk score type was first implemented in production systems at UnitedHealthcare. Used for tracking model adoption and version history.']
  interaction_terms_included boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the risk score model includes interaction terms that account for the combined effect of multiple conditions or demographic factors (e.g., diabetes + congestive heart failure interaction in CMS-HCC models).']
  lab_data_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether laboratory test results or clinical measurements are required as input for calculating risk scores of this type. Applicable for clinical risk scores and predictive models.']
  last_updated_date date [note: 'Date when the risk score type reference record was last modified or updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.']
  license_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether a commercial license or subscription is required to use this risk score type. True for proprietary vendor models, false for CMS-published public domain models.']
  maximum_score decimal(8,4) [note: 'Maximum allowable risk score value for this score type. Used for validation and to identify data quality issues or outliers.']
  minimum_score decimal(8,4) [note: 'Minimum allowable risk score value for this score type. Used for validation and to identify data quality issues or outliers.']
  model_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier for the risk adjustment model or scoring algorithm (e.g., V24, V28 for CMS-HCC models, or year-based versions like 2024). Critical for ensuring correct risk score calculation and CMS compliance.']
  name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the risk score type. Human-readable label used in reports and user interfaces.']
  normalization_factor decimal(10,6) [note: 'Numeric factor used to normalize or calibrate risk scores to a standard baseline (typically 1.0 represents average population risk). Applied by CMS annually to ensure budget neutrality.']
  owner_department varchar [note: 'Business department or functional area responsible for maintaining and governing this risk score type (e.g., Care Management, Actuarial, Quality, Medicare Operations). Used for data stewardship and accountability.']
  payment_year varchar [note: 'Calendar year for which risk scores of this type are used to determine capitated payments or reimbursement rates. Critical for Medicare Advantage and Medicaid managed care payment reconciliation.']
  pharmacy_data_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether pharmacy claims or prescription drug data is required as input for calculating risk scores of this type (e.g., true for RxHCC models, false for medical-only HCC models).']
  population_segment varchar [note: 'Member population segment for which this risk score type is designed (e.g., community, institutional, new enrollee, continuing enrollee, aged, disabled, ESRD, dual eligible). Used to ensure appropriate risk adjustment model application.']
  predictive_model_type varchar [note: 'Type of predictive modeling or statistical methodology used to generate risk scores of this type (e.g., regression analysis, machine learning, actuarial methods, clinical algorithms, hybrid approaches). Applicable for predictive risk scores.']
  program_type varchar [note: 'Health insurance program or line of business (LOB) for which this risk score type is applicable (e.g., Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial, ACA Marketplace, Dual Eligible Special Needs Plans, ESRD, PACE, Value-Based Care programs).']
  prospective_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this risk score type is used for prospective (forward-looking) risk adjustment and payment calculations, as opposed to concurrent or retrospective scoring.']
  recapture_eligible boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether diagnoses contributing to this risk score type must be recaptured annually through face-to-face encounters to remain valid for payment year risk adjustment. True for CMS-HCC prospective models.']
  regulatory_submission_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether risk scores of this type must be submitted to regulatory agencies (e.g., CMS RAPS/EDPS submissions for Medicare Advantage, state Medicaid agencies for managed care). Critical for compliance and payment reconciliation.']
  risk_stratification_tiers varchar [note: 'Number of risk stratification tiers or levels defined for this risk score type (e.g., 3 tiers: low/medium/high, or 5 tiers: very low/low/moderate/high/very high). Used for care management program assignment and resource allocation.']
  star_rating_impact varchar [note: 'Indicates whether this risk score type directly or indirectly impacts CMS Star Ratings for Medicare Advantage plans. Direct impact means the score is used in Star Rating calculations; indirect means it supports quality measures that affect ratings.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the risk score type. Indicates whether the score type is actively used in production systems, deprecated, or pending implementation.']
  technical_documentation_url varchar [note: 'URL or hyperlink to detailed technical documentation, model specifications, or reference materials for this risk score type. Supports user self-service and knowledge management.']
  vbc_program_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this risk score type is used in value-based care programs, alternative payment models (APMs), or quality-based reimbursement arrangements.']

  Note: 'Reference list of risk score categories (HCC, CMS-HCC, VBP risk), with codes and description.'
}

Table care.cohort_membership {
  cohort_membership_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the cohort_membership association']
  cohort_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the cohort definition that the member is assigned to']
  member_profile_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the member profile record representing the individual enrolled in the cohort']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this cohort membership record was created.']
  enrollment_date date [note: 'Date when the member was assigned to this cohort based on meeting inclusion criteria. This date is specific to each member-cohort pairing and represents when the relationship began.']
  enrollment_reason varchar [note: 'Reason code or description explaining why the member was assigned to this cohort. Examples: criteria_met, manual_assignment, program_referral, risk_score_threshold, clinical_trigger.']
  exit_date date [note: 'Date when the member exited or was removed from this cohort, either by no longer meeting criteria or through program completion. Null if membership is currently active.']
  risk_score_at_entry decimal(5,2) [note: 'The member\'s calculated risk score at the time they were enrolled in this cohort. This score is frozen at enrollment and used for baseline comparison and program effectiveness measurement.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of the member\'s participation in this cohort. Values: active, inactive, graduated, withdrawn, suspended. This status is specific to each member-cohort relationship.']
  updated_by varchar [note: 'User or system process that last updated this cohort membership record.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this cohort membership record was last modified.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User or system process that created this cohort membership record.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the enrollment of a member into a population health cohort for targeted care management programs. It captures the member\'s entry into and exit from cohorts, their risk stratification at the time of enrollment, and the current status of their participation. Each record links one member_profile to one cohort with temporal and clinical attributes that exist only in the context of this membership relationship.. Existence Justification: In UnitedHealthcare\'s population health management operations, members are routinely assigned to multiple cohorts simultaneously based on their clinical conditions, risk profiles, and program eligibility (e.g., a member can be in both a \'diabetic\' cohort and a \'high-risk\' cohort at the same time). Each cohort contains thousands of members who meet the defined inclusion criteria. The business actively manages these memberships through care management teams who track when members enter cohorts, their risk scores at entry, enrollment reasons, and current participation status for program effectiveness reporting and targeted interventions.'
}

  plan_type varchar [note: 'Type of health insurance plan (e.g., HMO, PPO, Medicare Advantage) under which the prior authorization is requested.']
  prescriber_fax varchar [note: 'Fax number for the prescribing physician or provider office for communication regarding the prior authorization.']
  prescriber_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the prescribing physician or healthcare provider.']
  prescriber_npi varchar [note: '10-digit National Provider Identifier of the prescribing physician or healthcare provider.']
  prescriber_phone varchar [note: 'Contact phone number for the prescribing physician or provider office.']
  prescriber_specialty varchar [note: 'Medical specialty of the prescribing physician (e.g., cardiology, oncology, endocrinology).']
  previous_treatments varchar [note: 'Description of previous medications or treatments attempted before requesting this medication, often required for step therapy protocols.']
  quantity_limit_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether quantity limits apply to the requested medication under the health plan\'s pharmacy benefit.']

  quantity_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the quantity requested (e.g., tablets, milliliters, units).']
  refills_requested varchar [note: 'Number of refills requested for the medication as part of the prior authorization.']

  request_type varchar [note: 'Type of prior authorization request indicating whether it is an initial request, reconsideration, appeal, or expedited review.']

  reviewer_name varchar [note: 'Name of the clinical reviewer or utilization management staff member who reviewed the prior authorization request.']
  sla_met boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the prior authorization decision was made within the required service level agreement timeframe.']
  specialty_drug_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the requested medication is classified as a specialty drug requiring special handling and distribution.']
  specialty_pharmacy_required boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the medication must be dispensed through a specialty pharmacy network.']

  step_therapy_required boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether step therapy protocol must be followed before the requested medication can be approved.']
  submission_method varchar [note: 'Method by which the prior authorization request was submitted (e.g., provider portal, fax, phone, EDI).']

  therapeutic_class varchar [note: 'Therapeutic classification of the medication indicating its primary clinical use (e.g., antihypertensive, antibiotic, antidiabetic).']
  transition_fill_provided boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether a temporary transition fill was provided while the prior authorization is being processed.']
  treatment_failure_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation of why previous treatments were ineffective or inappropriate, supporting the need for the requested medication.']
  turnaround_time_hours varchar [note: 'Number of hours elapsed between request submission and decision, used for service level agreement monitoring.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of a prior‑authorization request for a medication, including request date, drug, clinical justification, and member.'
}

Table pharmacy.drug {
  drug_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system identifier for the drug record in the enterprise data warehouse.']
  formulary_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to shared.formulary. Business justification: Each drug must be assigned to a formulary for coverage determination. Pharmacy benefits teams use this daily for eligibility checks, prior authorization decisions, and member cost-share calculations.']
  manufacturer_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to pharmacy.manufacturer. Business justification: Drug records should reference the manufacturer entity rather than storing free‑text name, enabling consistent manufacturer data and removal of redundant column.']
  active_ingredient varchar [note: 'The chemical substance in the drug responsible for its therapeutic effect.']
  ahfs_code varchar [note: 'The AHFS therapeutic classification code used to categorize drugs by pharmacological and therapeutic properties.']
  alcohol_interaction_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has contraindications or warnings for concurrent alcohol use.']
  atc_code varchar [note: 'The WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification code used internationally to classify drugs by organ system and therapeutic properties.']
  awp decimal(12,2) [note: 'The average wholesale price of the drug, commonly used as a benchmark for pharmacy reimbursement calculations. Expressed in US dollars.']
  beers_criteria_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is listed in the American Geriatrics Society Beers Criteria as potentially inappropriate for older adults.']
  billing_unit varchar [note: 'The standardized unit used for pharmacy claims billing and reimbursement (e.g., each, milliliter, gram).']
  biosimilar_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is a biosimilar product approved as highly similar to an FDA-approved reference biologic.']
  black_box_warning_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has an FDA-mandated black box warning for serious or life-threatening risks.']
  blood_product_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is derived from human blood or plasma.']
  class varchar [note: 'The therapeutic or pharmacological classification of the drug (e.g., antihypertensive, antibiotic, analgesic).']
  compound_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is a compounded medication prepared by combining multiple ingredients.']
  daw_code varchar [note: 'The NCPDP Dispense As Written code indicating the reason for dispensing a brand drug when a generic is available (0=no product selection indicated, 1=substitution not allowed by prescriber, etc.).']
  days_supply_limit varchar [note: 'The maximum number of days supply that can be dispensed per prescription fill.']
  dea_schedule varchar [note: 'The DEA controlled substance schedule classification indicating the drug\'s potential for abuse and accepted medical use (Schedule I through V, or Non-Controlled).']
  discontinuation_date date [note: 'The date the drug was discontinued from the market by the manufacturer.']
  dosage_form varchar [note: 'The physical form in which the drug is administered (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, solution, cream, inhaler).']
  dye_free_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug formulation is free of artificial dyes and colorants.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date when this drug record became effective in the enterprise system.']
  exclusivity_expiration_date date [note: 'The date when the drug\'s FDA-granted market exclusivity period expires.']
  fda_approval_date date [note: 'The date the drug received FDA approval for marketing in the United States.']
  food_interaction_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has clinically significant interactions with food or beverages.']
  formulary_status varchar [note: 'The drug\'s status on the health plan formulary indicating coverage level and restrictions.']
  generic_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is a generic formulation (true) or brand-name product (false).']
  geriatric_use_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has specific considerations or warnings for geriatric use.']
  gluten_free_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug formulation is certified gluten-free.']
  gpi varchar [note: 'The 14-digit Medispan Generic Product Identifier used to group drugs by therapeutic class and chemical composition.']
  gpi_description varchar [note: 'The human-readable description of the GPI classification.']
  halal_certified_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has halal certification.']
  hazardous_drug_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is classified as hazardous requiring special handling and disposal procedures.']
  hepatic_dosing_adjustment_required boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug requires dose adjustment for patients with hepatic impairment.']
  high_alert_medication boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is classified as a high-alert medication with heightened risk of causing significant patient harm when used in error.']
  inactive_ingredients varchar [note: 'The non-therapeutic components of the drug formulation (e.g., binders, fillers, preservatives, colorants).']
  interaction_severity varchar [note: 'The highest severity level of known drug-drug interactions for this medication.']
  interchangeable_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the biosimilar is designated as interchangeable with its reference biologic, allowing pharmacy-level substitution.']
  kosher_certified_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has kosher certification.']
  labeler_code varchar [note: 'The first segment of the NDC identifying the manufacturer or labeler of the drug product.']
  labeler_name varchar [note: 'The name of the entity responsible for labeling and distributing the drug, which may differ from the manufacturer.']
  lactation_risk_category varchar [note: 'The classification of risk for use during breastfeeding.']
  last_updated_date date [note: 'The date when this drug record was last updated with new information from source systems.']
  latex_free_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug packaging and delivery devices are latex-free.']
  look_alike_sound_alike boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has been identified as having look-alike or sound-alike name confusion risks.']
  mac_price decimal(12,2) [note: 'The maximum reimbursement amount established by the payer for multi-source generic drugs. Expressed in US dollars.']
  mail_order_eligible boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug can be dispensed through mail order pharmacy services.']
  maintenance_drug_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is used for chronic condition management and eligible for mail order or extended supply.']
  market_status varchar [note: 'The current market availability status of the drug product.']
  multi_source_code varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the drug has generic equivalents available: Y (multi-source, generics available), N (single source, no generics), O (originator brand with generics available).']
  narrow_therapeutic_index boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has a narrow therapeutic index requiring careful dosing and monitoring.']
  ndc varchar [note: 'The FDA-assigned 11-digit National Drug Code that uniquely identifies the drug product, including labeler, product, and package size. This is the primary industry standard identifier for drugs in the United States.']
  ndc_format varchar [note: 'The segment format of the NDC indicating the labeler-product-package configuration (e.g., 5-4-2, 5-3-2, 4-4-2).']
  non_proprietary_name varchar [note: 'The generic or non-proprietary name of the drug, typically the active ingredient name (e.g., atorvastatin, ibuprofen).']
  orange_book_code varchar [note: 'The FDA Orange Book code indicating therapeutic equivalence rating (e.g., AB, AA, BX) for generic drugs compared to brand reference products.']
  package_code varchar [note: 'The third segment of the NDC identifying the package size and type.']
  package_quantity decimal(10,2) [note: 'The numeric quantity of dosage units in the package.']
  package_size varchar [note: 'The quantity of drug units contained in the package (e.g., 30 tablets, 100 mL, 1 vial).']
  package_unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The unit of measure for the package quantity (e.g., tablet, capsule, mL, gram, vial).']
  patent_expiration_date date [note: 'The date when the drug\'s patent protection expires, allowing generic competition.']
  pediatric_use_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is approved for use in pediatric populations.']
  pregnancy_category varchar [note: 'The FDA pregnancy category indicating potential risks to fetus (A=safest, X=contraindicated, N=not classified). Note: FDA replaced this with pregnancy and lactation labeling in 2015.']
  preservative_free_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug formulation is preservative-free.']
  prior_authorization_required boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug requires prior authorization approval before dispensing.']
  product_code varchar [note: 'The second segment of the NDC identifying the specific drug product (strength, dosage form, formulation).']
  proprietary_name varchar [note: 'The brand or trade name of the drug as marketed by the manufacturer (e.g., Lipitor, Advil).']
  quantity_limit decimal(10,2) [note: 'The maximum quantity of the drug that can be dispensed per prescription or time period under plan coverage rules.']
  quantity_limit_period varchar [note: 'The time period over which the quantity limit applies (e.g., per fill, per 30 days, per year).']
  recall_status varchar [note: 'The FDA recall classification if the drug is subject to a recall (Class I=most serious, Class III=least serious).']
  reference_biologic_ndc varchar [note: 'The NDC of the reference biologic product for which this drug is a biosimilar.']
  refrigeration_required boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug requires refrigerated storage conditions.']
  rems_required boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug requires participation in an FDA Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy program.']
  renal_dosing_adjustment_required boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug requires dose adjustment for patients with renal impairment.']
  repackaged_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug has been repackaged from bulk containers into smaller units by a repackager.']
  route_of_administration varchar [note: 'The path by which the drug is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, intravenous, topical, subcutaneous, inhalation).']
  rx_otc_indicator varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the drug requires a prescription (Rx) or is available over-the-counter (OTC).']
  shortage_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is currently experiencing a supply shortage.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The name of the operational system from which this drug record was sourced (e.g., Optum Pharmacy Solutions, First DataBank, Medispan).']
  specialty_drug_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is classified as a specialty medication requiring special handling, administration, or monitoring.']
  step_therapy_required boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug requires trial of alternative medications before approval.']
  strength varchar [note: 'The amount of active ingredient per dosage unit (e.g., 10mg, 500mg/5mL, 0.5%).']
  sugar_free_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug formulation is sugar-free, relevant for diabetic patients.']
  termination_date date [note: 'The date when this drug record was terminated or became inactive in the enterprise system.']
  therapeutic_category varchar [note: 'The broad therapeutic category indicating the primary medical use of the drug (e.g., cardiovascular, anti-infective, central nervous system).']
  therapeutic_duplication_class varchar [note: 'A classification code used to identify drugs with similar therapeutic effects for detecting therapeutic duplication in drug regimens.']
  therapeutic_equivalent_group varchar [note: 'A grouping identifier for drugs that are therapeutically equivalent and may be substituted for one another.']
  tier_level varchar [note: 'The formulary tier assignment determining member cost-sharing (copay/coinsurance) levels.']
  unit_dose_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is packaged in unit-dose format for institutional use.']
  unit_price decimal(12,4) [note: 'The price per individual unit of the drug (e.g., per tablet, per milliliter). Expressed in US dollars.']
  vaccine_indicator boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the drug is a vaccine product.']
  wac decimal(12,2) [note: 'The manufacturer\'s list price for the drug to wholesalers or direct purchasers, excluding discounts or rebates. Expressed in US dollars.']

  Note: 'Authoritative catalog of all drugs identified by NDC, including name, strength, dosage form, and manufacturer.'
}

  fee_schedule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to shared.fee_schedule. Business justification: Drug reimbursement pricing follows contracted fee schedules (AWP, MAC lists).   biosimilar_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the drug is a biosimilar product approved as highly similar to an FDA-approved reference biologic.']
  compound_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the drug is a compounded medication prepared by combining multiple ingredients.']

  drug_class varchar [note: 'The therapeutic classification of the drug based on its pharmacological action and clinical use.']

  effective_date date [note: 'The date on which this drug price becomes effective and valid for use in claims adjudication and reimbursement.']
  end_date date [note: 'The date on which this drug price is no longer valid or has been superseded by a new price. Null indicates the price is currently active.']
  formulary_status varchar [note: 'The placement of the drug on the health plan\'s formulary, indicating coverage tier and member cost-sharing level.']
  generic_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the drug is a generic formulation (true) or a brand/innovator product (false).']
  generic_name varchar [note: 'The non-proprietary or generic name of the drug based on its active pharmaceutical ingredient.']
  gpi varchar [note: 'The 14-digit Generic Product Identifier that classifies drugs by therapeutic class and chemical structure, used for drug grouping and analysis.']
  ingredient_cost decimal(15,4) [note: 'The cost of the drug ingredient itself, excluding dispensing fees and other charges.']
  labeler_name varchar [note: 'The name of the company that manufactures or distributes the drug product.']
  mac decimal(15,4) [note: 'The maximum allowable cost established by the payer for reimbursing a generic drug, typically used to control costs for multi-source generic medications.']
  mail_order_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the drug is eligible for dispensing through mail order pharmacy programs.']
  maintenance_drug_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the drug is classified as a maintenance medication typically used for chronic conditions requiring ongoing therapy.']
  market_entry_date date [note: 'The date on which the drug first became available in the market.']
  member_coinsurance_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of drug cost that the member is responsible for paying as coinsurance.']
  member_copay_tier_1 decimal(10,2) [note: 'The member copayment amount for tier 1 (typically generic) drugs under standard benefit design.']
  member_copay_tier_2 decimal(10,2) [note: 'The member copayment amount for tier 2 (typically preferred brand) drugs under standard benefit design.']
  member_copay_tier_3 decimal(10,2) [note: 'The member copayment amount for tier 3 (typically non-preferred brand) drugs under standard benefit design.']
  multi_source_code varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the drug is available from a single source (brand only) or multiple sources (generic available).']
  nadac decimal(15,4) [note: 'The national average drug acquisition cost based on invoice prices paid by retail community pharmacies, published by CMS for Medicaid reimbursement.']
  ndc varchar [note: 'The 11-digit National Drug Code that uniquely identifies the drug product, package size, and manufacturer. Standard format is 5-4-2 (labeler-product-package).']
  orange_book_code varchar [note: 'The therapeutic equivalence code from the FDA Orange Book indicating whether generic drugs are therapeutically equivalent to brand-name drugs.']
  otc_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the drug is available over-the-counter without a prescription (true) or requires a prescription (false).']
  package_size varchar [note: 'The quantity and unit of measure for the drug package (e.g., 30 tablets, 100 ml).']
  patent_expiration_date date [note: 'The date on which the drug\'s patent protection expires, potentially allowing generic competition.']
  previous_price decimal(15,4) [note: 'The price value from the immediately preceding price record for the same drug and price type, used for trend analysis.']
  price_change_indicator varchar [note: 'Indicates whether this price represents an increase, decrease, or no change from the previous price for the same drug.']
  price_change_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'The percentage change in price compared to the previous price record for the same drug. Positive values indicate increases, negative values indicate decreases.']
  price_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or comments regarding this price record, such as special pricing conditions or data quality issues.']
  price_source varchar [note: 'The source or vendor from which the pricing data was obtained (e.g., First DataBank, Medi-Span, CMS, internal contract).']
  price_source_file_date date [note: 'The date of the source pricing file from which this price record was extracted.']
  price_status varchar [note: 'The current status of this price record indicating whether it is active, inactive, pending implementation, or historical.']
  price_type varchar [note: 'The type or category of pricing represented in this record (e.g., AWP, MAC, WAC, NADAC, contract price).']
  price_update_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this price record was created or last updated in the system.']
  price_verification_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether this price has been verified for accuracy against source data or requires review.']
  pricing_region varchar [note: 'The geographic region or market to which this pricing applies, as drug prices may vary by region.']
  prior_authorization_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether prior authorization is required before the drug can be dispensed and covered by the health plan.']
  quantity_limit varchar [note: 'The maximum quantity of the drug that can be dispensed per prescription or time period under plan coverage rules.']
  quantity_limit_period_days varchar [note: 'The number of days over which the quantity limit applies (e.g., 30 days, 90 days).']
  rebate_amount decimal(15,4) [note: 'The negotiated rebate amount per unit that the manufacturer pays back to the PBM or health plan.']
  rebate_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the drug is eligible for manufacturer rebates negotiated by the PBM or health plan.']
  rebate_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'The negotiated rebate as a percentage of the drug\'s price that the manufacturer pays back to the PBM or health plan.']
  reference_biologic_ndc varchar [note: 'The NDC of the reference biologic product for which this drug is a biosimilar, if applicable.']
  reimbursement_basis varchar [note: 'The methodology used to calculate pharmacy reimbursement for this drug (e.g., AWP minus percentage, MAC, WAC plus).']
  reimbursement_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'The percentage applied to the pricing basis for calculating pharmacy reimbursement (e.g., AWP minus 15% would be stored as -15.0000).']
  route_of_administration varchar [note: 'The path by which the drug is administered into the body.']
  shortage_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the drug is currently experiencing a supply shortage as reported by the FDA or manufacturer.']
  shortage_reason varchar [note: 'The reason for the drug shortage if applicable (e.g., manufacturing issue, increased demand, raw material shortage).']
  specialty_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the drug is classified as a specialty medication requiring special handling, administration, or monitoring.']
  step_therapy_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether step therapy protocols must be followed, requiring trial of alternative medications before this drug is covered.']
  strength varchar [note: 'The amount of active ingredient per dosage unit (e.g., 500mg, 10mg/ml).']
  therapeutic_alternative_ndc varchar [note: 'The NDC of a therapeutically equivalent alternative drug that can be substituted if this drug is unavailable or not covered.']
  unit_price decimal(15,4) [note: 'The price per individual unit of the drug (e.g., per tablet, per ml), calculated from the package price.']
  vaccine_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the drug is a vaccine product used for immunization.']
  wac decimal(15,4) [note: 'The manufacturer\'s list price for the drug to wholesalers or direct purchasers, excluding discounts and rebates.']

  Note: 'Historical record of drug price values (AWP, MAC) over time for audit and trend analysis.'
}

  payment_term_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the payment term record. Primary key for the payment term lookup table.']
  finance_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.finance_account. Business justification: Contract payment terms must specify the GL account for posting payments. Contract setup team configures this so payments automatically post to correct accounts per accounting policy.']
  reimbursement_method_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to contract.reimbursement_method. Business justification: Payment terms define payment cycles and discount structures that are tied to specific reimbursement methodologies (DRG, APC, fee-for-service, capitation).   late_fee_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which late fees are assessed for overdue payments. Determines whether fees compound or are assessed once.']
  late_fee_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of outstanding balance charged as a late fee. Used when late_fee_type is percentage. Subject to state usury laws.']
  late_fee_type varchar [note: 'Type of late fee structure applied when payment is not received within the net days plus grace period. Supports fixed fees, percentage-based fees, or tiered structures.']
  line_of_business_applicability varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of lines of business where this payment term applies. Examples: commercial, medicare_advantage, medicaid, exchange, ASO.']

  minimum_payment_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Minimum dollar amount required for a partial payment to be accepted. Applicable when partial payments are allowed.']
  minimum_payment_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum percentage of total invoice amount required for a partial payment. Alternative to fixed minimum amount.']
  name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the payment term. Examples: Net 30 Days, Net 60 Days, Due on Receipt, 2/10 Net 30.']
  net_days varchar [note: 'Number of days from invoice date or service date within which full payment is due without discount. Standard values include 15, 30, 45, 60, 90 days.']
  partial_payment_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether partial payments are accepted under this payment term or if full payment is required.']

  payment_method_restrictions varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of allowed or restricted payment methods for this term. Examples: ACH only, wire transfer required, no credit cards.']
  prepayment_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether prepayment or early payment is allowed under this payment term without penalty.']
  prepayment_discount_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Additional discount percentage offered for prepayment beyond the standard early payment discount. Used in value-based contracts.']
  priority_ranking varchar [note: 'Numeric ranking indicating the priority or preference order for this payment term when multiple terms are available. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.']
  provider_type_applicability varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of provider types eligible for this payment term. Examples: hospital, physician, ancillary, pharmacy, behavioral_health, DME.']
  quality_incentive_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this payment term includes eligibility for quality-based incentive payments tied to HEDIS or other quality metrics.']
  reconciliation_period_months varchar [note: 'Number of months in the reconciliation period for settlement calculations. Common values are 3, 6, or 12 months.']
  reconciliation_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether periodic reconciliation of payments against actual utilization or performance is required under this payment term.']
  regulatory_approval_date date [note: 'Date when regulatory approval was obtained for this payment term. Required for terms subject to state or federal oversight. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.']
  regulatory_approval_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this payment term requires state insurance department or CMS approval before use in contracts.']
  regulatory_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'Two-letter state code or federal jurisdiction where this payment term is approved for use. Examples: CA, TX, NY, FED.']
  service_category_applicability varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of service categories where this payment term applies. Examples: inpatient, outpatient, professional, pharmacy, behavioral_health.']
  settlement_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which final settlement or reconciliation occurs for capitation, risk-sharing, or value-based payment arrangements.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the payment term. Active terms are available for use in contracts; deprecated terms are phased out.']
  stop_loss_threshold_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Dollar amount threshold above which stop-loss protection applies in risk-sharing arrangements. Protects providers from catastrophic claims.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version number of this payment term record. Incremented with each modification to support version control and audit history.']
  withhold_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of payment withheld for quality performance, risk pool, or other contractual purposes. Common in capitation and value-based contracts.']
  withhold_release_criteria varchar [note: 'Description of criteria that must be met for withheld amounts to be released to the provider. May include quality metrics, utilization targets, or financial performance.']

  Note: 'Lookup table defining payment cycles, due dates, discount structures, and late fee rules for contracts.'
}

Table contract.change_request {
  change_request_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the contract change request record.']
  approval_workflow_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to contract.approval_workflow. Business justification: Change requests follow defined approval workflows that specify approval sequence, required approvers, and SLA timelines. Links change request instance to its governing workflow definition.']
  case_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to shared.case. Business justification: Contract change requests are managed as cases for approval workflow. Contract administration tracks amendments, rate changes, and term modifications through case management.']
  contract_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the provider contract subject to the change request.']
  affected_lines_of_business varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of health plan lines of business impacted by the contract change, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or Exchange.']
  affected_member_count varchar [note: 'Estimated number of health plan members who may be impacted by the contract change.']
  affected_provider_count varchar [note: 'Number of healthcare providers impacted by the proposed contract change.']
  affected_service_categories varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of healthcare service categories impacted by the contract change, such as inpatient, outpatient, professional services, pharmacy, or behavioral health.']
  amendment_execution_date date [note: 'Date when the contract amendment was formally executed and signed by all parties.']
  approval_comments varchar [note: 'Comments and rationale provided by the approver explaining the approval or rejection decision.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date when the final approval or rejection decision was made for the change request.']
  approval_level varchar [note: 'Organizational level required to approve the change request based on financial impact, scope, and risk.']
  approval_outcome varchar [note: 'Final decision outcome from the approval process indicating whether the change request was approved, rejected, or conditionally approved.']
  approval_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether formal approval is required for this change request based on business rules and thresholds.']
  approval_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the approval or rejection decision was recorded in the system.']
  approver_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the individual who provided final approval or rejection decision for the change request.']
  approver_title varchar [note: 'Job title of the individual who approved or rejected the change request.']
  audit_trail varchar [note: 'Comprehensive log of all actions, status changes, and decisions made throughout the change request lifecycle for compliance and accountability.']
  business_impact_description varchar [note: 'Description of the anticipated business impact if the change request is approved, including financial, operational, and strategic considerations.']
  compliance_review_comments varchar [note: 'Comments and findings provided by compliance department during their review of the change request.']
  compliance_review_date date [note: 'Date when compliance department completed their review of the change request.']
  compliance_review_outcome varchar [note: 'Result of the compliance department review indicating whether the change meets regulatory and policy requirements.']
  compliance_review_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether compliance department review is required to ensure the change meets regulatory requirements.']
  compliance_reviewer_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the compliance department representative who reviewed the change request.']
  conditions_of_approval varchar [note: 'Specific conditions, requirements, or modifications that must be met for conditional approval to become final approval.']
  contract_amendment_number varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the formal contract amendment document generated from the approved change request.']
  current_contract_terms varchar [note: 'Summary of the existing contract terms that are subject to the proposed change, providing context for the modification.']
  escalation_date date [note: 'Date when the change request was escalated to higher management or specialized review teams.']
  escalation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the change request has been escalated to higher management levels due to complexity, risk, or approval delays.']
  escalation_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation of why the change request required escalation beyond standard approval workflows.']
  estimated_financial_impact_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Projected financial impact of the contract change in dollars, positive for cost savings or revenue increase, negative for cost increase or revenue decrease.']
  financial_impact_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the financial impact direction resulting from the contract change.']
  implementation_date date [note: 'Actual date when the approved contract change was implemented and became effective.']
  implementation_notes varchar [note: 'Detailed notes documenting the implementation process, including any issues encountered or deviations from the plan.']
  implementation_status varchar [note: 'Current status of implementing the approved contract change into operational systems and processes.']
  justification varchar [note: 'Detailed business rationale and justification for the requested contract modification, including supporting evidence and business case.']
  last_modified_by varchar [note: 'Username or identifier of the individual who last modified the change request record.']
  last_modified_date date [note: 'Date when the change request record was last updated or modified.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the change request record was last updated in the system.']
  legal_review_comments varchar [note: 'Comments and recommendations provided by legal counsel during their review of the change request.']
  legal_review_date date [note: 'Date when legal department completed their review of the change request.']
  legal_review_outcome varchar [note: 'Result of the legal department review indicating approval status and any legal concerns.']
  legal_review_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether legal department review is required for this change request based on contract terms and risk assessment.']
  legal_reviewer_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the legal department representative who reviewed the change request.']
  mlr_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the contract change is expected to materially impact the health plan\'s Medical Loss Ratio calculations and reporting.']
  mlr_impact_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Estimated percentage point impact on the Medical Loss Ratio resulting from the contract change.']
  network_adequacy_assessment varchar [note: 'Assessment of how the contract change impacts network adequacy standards including provider availability, geographic access, and specialty coverage.']
  network_adequacy_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the contract change affects the health plan\'s ability to meet network adequacy requirements.']
  priority varchar [note: 'Business priority level assigned to the change request indicating urgency and importance.']
  proposed_change_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the specific contract terms, clauses, or provisions being proposed for modification.']
  proposed_contract_terms varchar [note: 'Summary of the new contract terms being proposed to replace or modify the current terms.']
  provider_acknowledgment_received_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether required provider acknowledgments have been received for the contract change.']
  provider_acknowledgment_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether providers must formally acknowledge receipt and acceptance of the contract change.']
  provider_notification_date date [note: 'Date when affected providers were formally notified of the approved contract change.']
  quality_measure_description varchar [note: 'Description of how the contract change impacts quality measurement, reporting, or performance incentives.']
  quality_measure_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the contract change affects quality measurement programs such as HEDIS, CAHPS, or Star Ratings.']
  regulatory_impact_description varchar [note: 'Description of how the contract change affects compliance with CMS, state insurance department, or other regulatory requirements.']
  regulatory_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the contract change has implications for regulatory compliance or reporting requirements.']
  reimbursement_methodology varchar [note: 'Payment methodology affected by or proposed in the change request, such as fee-for-service, DRG, APC, capitation, or value-based arrangements.']
  rejection_reason varchar [note: 'Detailed explanation of why the change request was rejected, including specific concerns or deficiencies.']
  related_change_request_ids varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of related change request IDs that are dependent on or related to this change request.']
  request_date date [note: 'Date when the change request was formally submitted for review.']
  request_number varchar [note: 'Human-readable unique reference number for the change request, typically formatted as CR-YYYYMMDD or similar.']
  request_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the change request in the approval workflow.']
  request_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the change request was submitted into the system.']
  request_type varchar [note: 'Category of contract modification being requested, such as rate adjustment, term extension, scope modification, termination, provider changes, reimbursement methodology changes, or value-based arrangement modifications.']
  requested_effective_date date [note: 'Date when the requester proposes the contract change should take effect.']
  requester_department varchar [note: 'Organizational department or business unit of the requester.']
  requester_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the individual who submitted the change request.']
  requester_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the individual who initiated the contract change request.']
  requester_phone varchar [note: 'Contact phone number for the individual who submitted the change request.']
  review_comments varchar [note: 'Detailed comments and feedback provided by reviewers during the evaluation process.']
  review_completion_date date [note: 'Date when the review process for the change request was completed.']
  review_start_date date [note: 'Date when formal review of the change request began.']
  reviewer_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the primary individual responsible for reviewing the change request.']
  reviewer_role varchar [note: 'Job title or functional role of the individual reviewing the change request.']
  risk_assessment_score varchar [note: 'Numerical risk score assigned to the change request based on financial exposure, operational complexity, and regulatory implications, typically on a scale of 1-10.']
  risk_category varchar [note: 'Categorical risk classification of the change request based on potential adverse impacts to the organization.']
  risk_mitigation_plan varchar [note: 'Description of strategies and actions planned to mitigate identified risks associated with the contract change.']
  sla_due_date date [note: 'Target date by which the change request should be reviewed and decided based on internal service level agreements.']
  sla_met_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the change request was processed within the defined service level agreement timeframe.']
  supporting_document_count varchar [note: 'Number of supporting documents attached to the change request, such as financial analyses, provider correspondence, or regulatory guidance.']
  supporting_document_references varchar [note: 'List of document identifiers or file paths for supporting documentation attached to the change request.']
  system_update_completion_date date [note: 'Date when all required system updates to implement the contract change were completed and validated.']
  system_update_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the contract change requires updates to claims processing, provider network, or other operational systems.']
  turnaround_time_days varchar [note: 'Number of calendar days from request submission to final decision, measuring processing efficiency.']
  value_based_arrangement_type varchar [note: 'Type of value-based care arrangement if the change request involves alternative payment models or quality-based reimbursement.']
  withdrawal_date date [note: 'Date when the change request was withdrawn by the requester before completion of the approval process.']
  withdrawal_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation provided by the requester for withdrawing the change request.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of requests to modify contract terms, including requester, justification, and approval outcome.'
}

Each version record must reference the master agreement it versions. Critical f']

Table contract.party {
  party_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the contract party entity. Primary key for the contract party master table.']
  caqh_provider_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier assigned by CAQH ProView for provider credentialing data exchange.']
  clearinghouse_id varchar [note: 'Identifier for the EDI clearinghouse used by the provider for electronic transaction submission.']
  edi_payer_id varchar [note: 'Unique payer identifier used in ANSI X12 EDI transactions for electronic claims submission and eligibility verification.']
  accepting_new_patients_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the provider is currently accepting new patient assignments and referrals.']
  accessibility_features varchar [note: 'Description of accessibility accommodations available at the provider location (e.g., wheelchair access, hearing loop, sign language).']
  aco_participant_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the provider participates in an Accountable Care Organization arrangement.']
  address_line_1 varchar [note: 'Primary street address line for the contract party\'s principal business location.']
  address_line_2 varchar [note: 'Secondary address line for suite, floor, building, or other location details.']
  bank_account_number varchar [note: 'Bank account number for Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) claims payment.']
  bank_name varchar [note: 'Name of the financial institution holding the provider\'s payment account.']
  bank_routing_number varchar [note: 'Nine-digit ABA routing number for the provider\'s bank account used for EFT payments.']
  board_certification_specialty varchar [note: 'Medical specialty in which the provider holds board certification.']
  board_certification_status varchar [note: 'Indicator of whether the provider is board certified in their specialty by a recognized medical board.']
  city varchar [note: 'City name for the contract party\'s principal business location.']
  contract_administrator_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the internal contract administrator for operational coordination.']
  contract_administrator_name varchar [note: 'Name of the internal staff member responsible for managing the contract party relationship.']
  country_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO country code for the contract party\'s principal business location.']
  county_code varchar [note: 'County or parish code for the contract party\'s location, used for network adequacy and geographic analysis.']
  credentialing_date date [note: 'Date when the provider successfully completed initial credentialing and was approved to join the network.']
  credentialing_status varchar [note: 'Current state of the provider credentialing process indicating verification of qualifications, licenses, and malpractice coverage.']

  dba_name varchar [note: 'Trade name or fictitious business name under which the party operates, if different from legal name.']
  dea_number varchar [note: 'DEA registration number for providers authorized to prescribe controlled substances.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when the contract party relationship becomes active and eligible for network participation and claims payment.']
  email_address varchar [note: 'Primary email address for electronic correspondence and notifications with the contract party.']
  fax_number varchar [note: 'Facsimile number for document transmission and prior authorization communications.']

  graduation_year varchar [note: 'Year the provider graduated from medical school or professional training program.']
  hedis_reporting_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the provider is required to submit HEDIS quality measure data.']
  hospital_affiliation varchar [note: 'Name of the hospital or hospital system with which the provider has admitting privileges or organizational affiliation.']
  language_codes varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of ISO language codes for languages spoken by the provider or available at the facility.']
  last_name varchar [note: 'Last name or surname of the individual provider or primary contact person for individual practitioners.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the contract party record, used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.']
  legal_business_name varchar [note: 'Official registered legal name of the contract party as filed with state and federal authorities. Must match IRS and state registration records.']
  legal_entity_type varchar [note: 'Legal structure of the contract party organization (e.g., corporation, LLC, partnership, individual practitioner).']
  mailing_address_line_1 varchar [note: 'Primary street address line for correspondence and payment remittance if different from physical location.']
  mailing_address_line_2 varchar [note: 'Secondary mailing address line for suite, PO Box, or other mailing details.']
  mailing_city varchar [note: 'City name for the contract party\'s mailing address.']
  mailing_country_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO country code for the contract party\'s mailing address.']
  mailing_state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter state code for the contract party\'s mailing address.']
  mailing_zip_code varchar [note: 'ZIP code for the contract party\'s mailing address.']
  malpractice_coverage_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Dollar amount of professional liability insurance coverage per occurrence, typically required minimum of $1M/$3M.']
  malpractice_expiration_date date [note: 'Expiration date of the provider\'s professional liability insurance policy, monitored for continuous coverage.']
  malpractice_insurance_carrier varchar [note: 'Name of the insurance company providing professional liability coverage for the provider.']
  malpractice_policy_number varchar [note: 'Policy number for the provider\'s professional liability insurance coverage.']
  medicaid_participating_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the provider participates in state Medicaid programs.']
  medical_group_name varchar [note: 'Name of the medical group, IPA, or physician organization to which the provider belongs.']
  medical_school varchar [note: 'Name of the medical school or professional training institution from which the provider graduated.']
  medicare_participating_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the provider participates in Original Medicare and accepts Medicare assignment.']
  middle_name varchar [note: 'Middle name or initial of the individual provider or primary contact person.']
  name_suffix varchar [note: 'Suffix or professional designation following the individual\'s name (e.g., Jr., Sr., MD, DO).']
  network_tier varchar [note: 'Tiered network classification indicating member cost-sharing level and provider performance or efficiency rating.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or historical context about the contract party.']
  npi varchar [note: 'Ten-digit unique identification number issued by CMS to healthcare providers. Type 1 for individual providers, Type 2 for organizational providers.']
  npi_type varchar [note: 'Classification of NPI: Type 1 for individual healthcare providers, Type 2 for organizational healthcare providers.']
  organization_name varchar [note: 'Common name or brand name by which the contract party is known in the market and used for operational purposes.']
  par_status varchar [note: 'Indicator of whether the provider is a participating (in-network) or non-participating (out-of-network) provider.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'Preferred method for claims payment disbursement (e.g., Electronic Funds Transfer, check, virtual card).']
  pcmh_recognized_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the provider practice has achieved PCMH recognition from NCQA or similar body.']
  pcp_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the provider is eligible to serve as a Primary Care Physician for member assignment in HMO and POS plans.']
  primary_phone_number varchar [note: 'Main business telephone number for contacting the contract party.']
  provider_type varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the provider\'s service category (e.g., physician, hospital, ancillary, behavioral health).']

  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the clause definition indicating whether it is available for use in new contracts.']
  summary varchar [note: 'Brief plain-language summary of the clause purpose and key provisions for business users who need to understand the clause without reading full legal text.']
  text varchar [note: 'Full legal text of the contract clause as it appears in contract documents. Contains the complete wording of terms, conditions, obligations, and rights.']
  type varchar [note: 'Categorization of the clause based on its legal or business function within the contract. Determines the nature of obligations, rights, or terms being defined.']
  usage_count varchar [note: 'Number of active contracts currently referencing this clause. Helps assess clause importance and impact of changes.']

  Note: 'Reusable clause definitions that can be referenced by multiple contracts, capturing clause type, text, and legal attributes.'

  risk_sharing_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of financial risk shared between payer and provider under this discount arrangement, applicable to risk-based contracts.']
  shared_savings_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of cost savings that is shared with the provider under value-based or accountable care discount arrangements.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the source system from which this discount arrangement data originated (e.g., Facets, QNXT, HealthRules).']

  state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter state code where this discount is applicable, supporting state-specific contract and regulatory requirements.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the discount arrangement, indicating whether it is active, pending, or inactive for operational use.']

  exclusion_criteria varchar [note: 'Criteria for excluding members or encounters from the performance measurement calculation.']

  maximum_incentive_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum dollar amount that can be paid for this incentive regardless of performance level achieved.']
  measurement_period_end_date date [note: 'End date of the performance measurement period for the incentive calculation.']
  measurement_period_start_date date [note: 'Start date of the performance measurement period for the incentive calculation.']
  measurement_steward varchar [note: 'Organization responsible for developing and maintaining the performance measure (e.g., NCQA, CMS, NQF).']
  minimum_denominator_size varchar [note: 'Minimum number of eligible members or encounters required in the denominator for the measure to be valid and the incentive to apply.']
  minimum_incentive_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Minimum dollar amount that will be paid if the threshold is met, regardless of calculation method.']
  name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the incentive or bonus program tied to the contract.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the incentive structure.']
  nqf_number varchar [note: 'National Quality Forum endorsed measure number if the performance metric is NQF-endorsed.']
  payment_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which the incentive payment is disbursed to the provider.']
  percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage rate applied to a base amount (e.g., total payments, savings) to calculate the incentive payment.']
  performance_metric_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code identifying the specific performance metric being measured (e.g., HEDIS measure code, CMS quality measure ID).']
  performance_metric_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of what the performance metric measures and how it is calculated.']
  performance_metric_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the performance metric being measured for this incentive.']
  product_applicability varchar [note: 'Specific product types to which this incentive applies (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP).']
  provider_type_applicability varchar [note: 'Types of providers eligible for this incentive (e.g., PCP, specialist, hospital, ACO, medical group).']
  quality_gate_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the provider must meet minimum quality performance thresholds to be eligible for cost-based incentives.']
  quality_gate_threshold decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum quality performance score or percentile that must be achieved to pass the quality gate and be eligible for incentive payment.']
  reconciliation_period_months varchar [note: 'Number of months after the measurement period during which reconciliation of the incentive payment may occur.']
  reconciliation_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the incentive payment requires reconciliation after final performance data is available.']
  reporting_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which performance results for this incentive are reported to the provider.']
  reporting_lag_days varchar [note: 'Number of days after the reporting period end date before performance results are made available to the provider.']
  risk_adjustment_method varchar [note: 'Method used to adjust performance results for differences in patient case mix or risk (e.g., HCC risk adjustment).']
  shared_risk_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of cost overruns or losses that the provider is responsible for in risk-sharing arrangements.']
  shared_savings_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of total cost savings that is shared with the provider as an incentive payment in shared savings arrangements.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Name of the source system from which the incentive record originated (e.g., HealthEdge, QNXT, Facets).']
  source_system_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the incentive record in the source system.']
  specialty_applicability varchar [note: 'Provider specialties to which this incentive applies (e.g., cardiology, endocrinology, primary care).']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the incentive structure.']
  stretch_target_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'Aspirational performance value beyond the standard target that may earn additional incentive payment.']
  target_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'Target performance value that represents the desired level of achievement for full incentive payment.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when the incentive structure terminates and no longer applies to provider performance.']
  threshold_type varchar [note: 'Type of performance threshold structure used to determine incentive eligibility and payment amount.']
  threshold_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measurement for the threshold value (e.g., percentage, rate per thousand, dollar amount).']
  threshold_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'Numeric value representing the performance threshold that must be met or exceeded to earn the incentive.']
  tier_level varchar [note: 'Performance tier level for tiered incentive structures, where different tiers correspond to different payment amounts.']
  tier_payment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Incentive payment amount associated with achieving performance within this tier level.']
  tier_threshold_lower decimal(18,4) [note: 'Lower boundary of the performance range for this tier level in a tiered incentive structure.']
  tier_threshold_upper decimal(18,4) [note: 'Upper boundary of the performance range for this tier level in a tiered incentive structure.']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the incentive structure based on the performance metric or objective being rewarded.']
  withhold_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of regular payments withheld from the provider that can be earned back through achievement of this incentive.']
  withhold_pool_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total dollar amount withheld in the pool that is available for distribution based on incentive achievement.']

  Note: 'Master record of incentive or bonus structures tied to contract performance thresholds.'
}

  Note: 'Transactional record of COBRA continuation enrollments, including premium rates and duration.'

Table quality.measure {
  measure_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the quality measure record.']

  age_range_minimum varchar [note: 'Minimum age in years for members to be included in the measure denominator.']
  allowable_gap_days varchar [note: 'Maximum number of days a member can have a gap in enrollment and still be considered continuously enrolled.']

  benchmark_percentile_75th decimal(5,2) [note: 'Performance rate at the 75th percentile from the benchmark population.']
  benchmark_percentile_90th decimal(5,2) [note: 'Performance rate at the 90th percentile from the benchmark population, often representing best-in-class performance.']
  benchmark_source varchar [note: 'Organization or entity providing the performance benchmark for comparison (e.g., NCQA, CMS, internal targets).']
  benefit_type_required varchar [note: 'Specific benefit coverage required for measure eligibility (e.g., medical, pharmacy, behavioral health).']
  calculation_logic_url varchar [note: 'URL or file path to detailed technical documentation describing the measure calculation algorithm and business rules.']

  cms_measure_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier assigned by CMS for measures used in Medicare and Medicaid quality programs.']
  code varchar [note: 'Standardized alphanumeric code identifying the specific HEDIS or quality measure (e.g., CBP, CDC, BCS).']
  continuous_enrollment_months varchar [note: 'Number of months of continuous enrollment required for measure eligibility.']
  continuous_enrollment_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether members must be continuously enrolled during the measurement period to be included in the measure.']
  cpt_codes varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of CPT procedure codes used in numerator, denominator, or exclusion criteria.']
  data_collection_method varchar [note: 'Primary methodology used to collect data for the measure (administrative claims, hybrid with medical record review, survey, EHR, or case management system).']
  data_source_systems varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of source systems from which data is extracted for measure calculation (e.g., claims system, EHR, pharmacy system).']
  denominator_definition varchar [note: 'Detailed specification of the eligible population for the measure (all members who should be evaluated).']
  denominator_exceptions varchar [note: 'Circumstances under which members are removed from the denominator due to medical, patient, or system reasons.']
