  inclusion_criteria varchar [note: 'Text description of conditions or circumstances that must be present for this rule to apply to a member or diagnosis.']
  interaction_hcc_codes varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of HCC codes that must co-occur for this interaction rule to apply. Interaction terms capture additional risk from multiple conditions.']
  last_review_date date [note: 'The date on which this rule definition was last reviewed and validated for accuracy and regulatory compliance.']
  lob varchar [note: 'The insurance product line to which this risk adjustment rule applies. Different LOBs may use different risk models.']
  lookback_period_months varchar [note: 'The number of months to look back for diagnosis history when evaluating this rule. Used for chronic condition validation.']
  medicaid_status varchar [note: 'The Medicaid eligibility status to which this rule applies. Dual-eligible members may have different risk factors.']
  minimum_diagnosis_count varchar [note: 'The minimum number of times a diagnosis must appear during the data collection period for this rule to apply. Used to ensure diagnosis validity.']
  model_version varchar [note: 'The CMS risk adjustment model version that this rule belongs to (e.g., V24, V28). Different model versions have different HCC structures and RAF coefficients.']
  model_year varchar [note: 'The calendar year for which this risk adjustment rule is applicable. CMS updates risk models annually.']
  name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the risk adjustment rule for business user identification and reporting purposes.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'The scheduled date for the next review and validation of this rule definition to ensure continued accuracy and compliance.']
  normalization_factor decimal(10,6) [note: 'Factor applied to normalize risk scores across different model versions or population segments to ensure budget neutrality.']
  originally_disabled_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rule applies to members who originally qualified for Medicare due to disability. Used for demographic risk factors.']
  owner_department varchar [note: 'The internal department or team responsible for maintaining and updating this risk adjustment rule definition.']
  payment_impact_category varchar [note: 'Classification of the financial impact this rule has on risk-adjusted payments. High-impact rules receive additional scrutiny.']
  payment_year varchar [note: 'The year in which risk-adjusted payments based on this rule will be made. Typically follows the data collection year.']
  population_segment varchar [note: 'The member population segment to which this rule applies. CMS uses different risk models for different population segments.']
  predecessor_rule_code varchar [note: 'The rule code of the previous version of this rule that this version replaces or supersedes. Used for historical tracking.']
  prevalence_rate decimal(5,4) [note: 'The expected prevalence rate of this condition or rule trigger in the member population, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0523 for 5.23%).']
  priority_rank varchar [note: 'Numeric ranking indicating the order in which this rule should be evaluated when multiple rules could apply. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.']
  provider_education_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rule requires special provider education due to complexity, frequent coding errors, or high audit risk.']
  quality_measure_alignment varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of HEDIS or Star Ratings measures that are related to or impacted by this risk adjustment rule.']
  radv_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether diagnoses captured under this rule are eligible for inclusion in CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation audits.']
  raf_coefficient decimal(10,6) [note: 'The numeric coefficient value applied in RAF score calculation for this rule. Represents the relative cost weight for the condition or demographic factor.']
  recapture_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether diagnoses under this rule are eligible for recapture in subsequent years if the condition persists but is not re-documented.']
  regulatory_authority varchar [note: 'The government entity or regulatory body that has authority over this risk adjustment rule.']
  service_category varchar [note: 'The category of healthcare service from which diagnoses for this rule can be captured. Some diagnoses are only valid from specific service types.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the risk adjustment rule. Only active rules are applied in production risk score calculations.']
  subject_matter_expert varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the subject matter expert responsible for clinical or technical guidance on this risk adjustment rule.']
  submission_type varchar [note: 'Indicates which CMS submission system this rule applies to. RAPS is legacy, EDPS is the current encounter-based system.']
  successor_rule_code varchar [note: 'The rule code of the next version of this rule that will replace this version. Used for transition planning.']
  superseding_hcc_codes varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of HCC codes that supersede this HCC in the diagnosis hierarchy. Used to prevent double-counting of related conditions.']
  suspecting_logic varchar [note: 'Description of the logic used to identify members who may have this condition but lack current year diagnosis documentation. Used for gap closure programs.']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the risk adjustment rule indicating its functional purpose within the risk adjustment processing workflow.']
  validation_rule_logic varchar [note: 'Detailed technical specification of the validation logic applied to determine if this rule should be triggered. May include complex conditional expressions.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version number of this rule definition. Incremented when rule logic, coefficients, or criteria are modified.']

  Note: 'Reference definition of business rules governing HCC eligibility, grouping, and RAF factor application.'
}

  error_code varchar [note: 'System-generated error code associated with the exception. Used for technical troubleshooting and error pattern analysis.']
  error_message varchar [note: 'Detailed error message describing the exception condition. Provides technical details for resolution and root cause analysis.']
  escalation_date date [note: 'Date when the exception was escalated. Used to track escalation timeliness and management involvement.']

  escalation_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation of why the exception required escalation. Documents the business justification for management review.']
  financial_impact_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Estimated dollar impact of the exception on risk-based payments. Calculated by multiplying RAF score impact by the applicable payment rate.']
  hcc_code varchar [note: 'CMS Hierarchical Condition Category code that maps from the diagnosis code. HCCs are used to calculate risk adjustment factor scores for payment.']
  hcc_description varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the HCC category. Provides clinical and business context for the condition category affected by this exception.']
  hcc_weight decimal(10,6) [note: 'Numeric weight assigned to the HCC in the CMS risk adjustment model. Represents the relative cost impact of the condition on expected healthcare expenditures.']
  line_of_business varchar [note: 'The Medicare product line associated with this exception. Identifies the specific type of Medicare plan affected by the risk adjustment exception.']
  member_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the health plan member associated with this risk exception. Links to the member whose risk score calculation was affected by this exception.']
  model_version varchar [note: 'Version of the CMS HCC risk adjustment model used for this exception. CMS updates the model periodically with new diagnosis mappings and weights.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the exception record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the exception record.']
  original_raf_score decimal(10,6) [note: 'The member\'s RAF score before the exception was applied. Baseline risk score used for comparison to measure the impact of the exception.']
  override_reason_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code indicating the reason for manual override of automated risk adjustment processing. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.']
  override_reason_description varchar [note: 'Detailed explanation of why the override was necessary. Provides business justification for exception processing decisions.']
  payment_year varchar [note: 'The calendar year for which the risk adjustment payment applies. Risk scores calculated in one year determine payments for the following year.']
  preventive_action varchar [note: 'Description of preventive measures implemented to avoid similar exceptions in the future. Documents proactive quality improvement initiatives.']
  priority_level varchar [note: 'Priority classification for exception resolution. Determines the order and urgency of exception processing in the work queue.']
  provider_name varchar [note: 'Name of the healthcare provider or facility associated with the diagnosis documentation. Used for provider-level exception tracking and reporting.']
  provider_npi varchar [note: 'Ten-digit National Provider Identifier for the healthcare provider who documented the diagnosis associated with this exception.']
  provider_specialty varchar [note: 'Medical specialty or taxonomy classification of the provider who documented the diagnosis. Used to analyze exception patterns by provider type.']
  provider_tin varchar [note: 'Federal Tax Identification Number for the provider organization. Used for provider identification and payment processing.']
  raf_score_impact decimal(10,6) [note: 'The net change in RAF score resulting from this exception. Calculated as adjusted RAF score minus original RAF score. Positive values indicate score increases.']
  recurrence_count varchar [note: 'Number of times a similar exception has occurred for the same member, provider, or diagnosis. Used to identify systemic issues.']
  recurrence_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator that this exception is a recurring issue for the same member or provider. True when similar exceptions have occurred previously.']
  resolution_action varchar [note: 'The action taken to resolve the exception. Documents how the exception was addressed in the risk adjustment workflow.']
  resolution_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes documenting the resolution process and decision rationale. Provides audit trail and context for exception handling.']
  resolved_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the exception was fully resolved and closed. Marks the completion of the exception lifecycle.']
  reviewed_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the exception was reviewed by an analyst or supervisor. Marks when the exception entered active review status.']
  root_cause_category varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the underlying cause of the exception. Used for trend analysis and process improvement initiatives.']
  root_cause_description varchar [note: 'Detailed explanation of the root cause identified through exception analysis. Documents the underlying reason for the exception occurrence.']
  service_from_date date [note: 'The start date of the medical service or encounter during which the diagnosis was documented. Used to determine the applicable service year for risk adjustment.']
  service_through_date date [note: 'The end date of the medical service or encounter during which the diagnosis was documented. For single-day services, matches the service from date.']
  service_year varchar [note: 'The calendar year in which the medical services or diagnoses associated with this exception were provided or documented.']
  severity varchar [note: 'Severity classification indicating the impact of the exception on risk score accuracy and financial implications. Critical exceptions require immediate attention.']
  sla_met_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether the exception was resolved within the defined service level agreement timeframe. True when SLA was met.']
  source varchar [note: 'The system, process, or activity that identified and generated this exception record. Indicates where in the risk adjustment workflow the exception was detected.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current processing status of the exception. Tracks the exception through its lifecycle from identification to resolution.']
  submission_date date [note: 'Date when the risk adjustment data was submitted to CMS. Used to track submission timeliness and reconciliation periods.']
  submission_type varchar [note: 'Type of risk adjustment data submission affected by this exception. RAPS (Risk Adjustment Processing System) or EDPS (Encounter Data Processing System).']
  turnaround_time_hours decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total elapsed time in hours from exception creation to resolution. Used for service level agreement monitoring and process efficiency analysis.']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the exception that affected risk score calculation. Identifies the nature of the issue requiring manual intervention or override.']
  validation_rule_description varchar [note: 'Description of the validation rule that identified this exception. Explains the business logic or compliance requirement that was violated.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of exceptions (e.g., coding overrides, data quality issues) that affect risk score calculations.'
}

Table sales.incentive_program {
  incentive_program_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the sales incentive program. Primary key for the incentive program entity.']
  budget_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Sales incentive programs require approved budgets. Finance controls spending against budget, tracks variances, and reports on incentive compensation expenses quarterly.']
  previous_version_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the incentive_program_id of the previous version of this program, if this is an updated or revised version.']
  product_catalog_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to sales.product_catalog. Business justification: Incentive_program applies to specific products. FK to product_catalog enables product-specific incentive tracking.']
  region_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to sales.sales_region. Business justification: Incentive_program needs FK to sales_region for region-specific incentive programs and geographic scope management.']
  sales_channel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to sales.sales_channel. Business justification: Incentive_program has sales_channel (STRING) but needs FK to sales_channel for channel-specific incentive programs.']
  accelerator_enabled_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the incentive program includes accelerator provisions that increase payout rates when performance exceeds defined thresholds.']
  accelerator_multiplier decimal(10,4) [note: 'The multiplier applied to the base commission rate when performance exceeds the accelerator threshold.']
  accelerator_threshold decimal(18,2) [note: 'The performance level at which accelerated commission rates begin to apply.']
  approval_date date [note: 'The date when the incentive program was officially approved by authorized management.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'The current approval status of the incentive program in the governance workflow (draft, pending approval, approved, rejected, suspended, terminated).']
  approved_by_name varchar [note: 'The name of the executive or manager who approved the incentive program.']
  base_commission_rate decimal(10,4) [note: 'The baseline commission rate or percentage applied to qualifying sales for this incentive program.']
  budget_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total budget allocated for this incentive program for the defined performance period.']
  budget_currency_code varchar [note: 'The three-letter ISO currency code for the budget amount (e.g., USD).']
  cap_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The maximum incentive payout amount per participant per performance period, if applicable.']
  cap_type varchar [note: 'The type of cap applied to incentive payouts (per performance period, per enrollment, annual, lifetime, or no cap).']
  clawback_enabled_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the incentive program includes clawback provisions that allow recovery of incentive payments under specified conditions (e.g., member cancellation, policy lapse).']
  clawback_period_months varchar [note: 'The number of months after initial payout during which clawback provisions may be applied if triggering conditions occur.']
  clawback_trigger_condition varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the conditions that trigger clawback of incentive payments (e.g., member cancellation within 90 days, policy non-payment, fraud detection).']
  commission_rate_unit varchar [note: 'The unit of measurement for the commission rate (percentage of premium, flat amount, Per Member Per Month, Per Employee Per Month, per enrollment, tiered structure).']
  communication_plan_description varchar [note: 'Description of the communication strategy and channels used to inform eligible participants about the incentive program details and requirements.']
  compliance_review_date date [note: 'The date when compliance or legal review of the incentive program was completed.']
  compliance_review_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this incentive program requires compliance or legal review before activation due to regulatory considerations.']
  compliance_reviewer_name varchar [note: 'The name of the compliance officer or legal reviewer who assessed the incentive program for regulatory adherence.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'The accounting cost center code to which incentive program expenses are charged.']
  dashboard_url varchar [note: 'The web URL where participants can access their real-time performance dashboard and incentive tracking for this program.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'The date when the incentive program expires or is scheduled to terminate.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'The date when the incentive program becomes active and eligible for participant enrollment and performance tracking.']
  eligibility_criteria varchar [note: 'Detailed criteria defining which sales personnel are eligible to participate in this incentive program, including tenure requirements, performance thresholds, territory assignments, or licensing requirements.']
  enrollment_end_date date [note: 'The last date when eligible sales personnel can enroll in the incentive program.']
  enrollment_season_type varchar [note: 'The enrollment period type this incentive program targets (Annual Enrollment Period, Open Enrollment Period, Special Enrollment Period, year-round, campaign-specific).']
  enrollment_start_date date [note: 'The date when eligible sales personnel can begin enrolling or opting into the incentive program.']
  exclusion_criteria varchar [note: 'Detailed criteria defining sales transactions or participants that are explicitly excluded from incentive eligibility (e.g., internal transfers, family members, test enrollments).']
  funding_source varchar [note: 'The organizational department or cost center providing funding for this incentive program.']
  geographic_scope varchar [note: 'The geographic scope or coverage area for which this incentive program is applicable (national, regional, state-specific, territory-based, market-specific).']
  gl_account_code varchar [note: 'The general ledger account code used for recording incentive program expenses in the financial system.']
  last_modified_by_name varchar [note: 'The name of the user or administrator who last modified the incentive program record.']
  last_modified_date date [note: 'The date when the incentive program record was last updated or modified.']
  lob varchar [note: 'The line of business this incentive program applies to, such as Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace, Dual Eligible, Individual, or Group.']
  measurement_period_type varchar [note: 'The frequency or type of performance measurement period for the incentive program (monthly, quarterly, annual, enrollment period, campaign-based, rolling).']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the incentive program administration.']
  override_commission_enabled_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether sales managers or supervisors are eligible for override commissions on their team\'s sales under this program.']
  override_commission_rate decimal(10,4) [note: 'The commission rate or percentage applied to override commissions for sales managers or supervisors.']
  participant_role varchar [note: 'The sales role or position eligible to participate in this incentive program.']
  payout_frequency varchar [note: 'The frequency at which incentive payments are disbursed to participants (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, upon achievement, deferred).']
  payout_timing_days varchar [note: 'Number of days after the performance period ends when incentive payments are processed and disbursed.']
  performance_metric varchar [note: 'The primary performance metric used to measure achievement for this incentive program (enrollment count, premium volume, member retention, new group sales, cross-sell, quality score, persistency, ASO conversion).']
  performance_period_end_date date [note: 'The date when performance measurement ends for calculating incentive payouts.']
  performance_period_start_date date [note: 'The date when performance measurement begins for calculating incentive payouts.']
  product_category varchar [note: 'The health insurance product category targeted by this incentive program (HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, Medicare Advantage, PDP, SNP, QHP, Supplemental).']
  program_code varchar [note: 'Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the incentive program for reference and reporting purposes.']
  program_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the incentive program including objectives, target behaviors, and expected outcomes.']
  program_name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the sales incentive program.']
  program_owner_email varchar [note: 'The email address of the program owner for inquiries and administration.']
  program_owner_name varchar [note: 'The name of the sales operations or compensation manager responsible for administering this incentive program.']
  program_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the incentive program structure (e.g., commission-based, bonus, special performance incentive fund, override, residual, accelerator, contest, recognition).']
  quality_assurance_criteria varchar [note: 'Description of quality assurance standards or compliance requirements that sales must meet to qualify for incentive payments (e.g., complete enrollment documentation, member satisfaction scores, audit compliance).']
  regulatory_constraint_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes documenting any regulatory constraints, limitations, or special considerations applicable to this incentive program (e.g., CMS marketing guidelines, state insurance regulations, Anti-Kickback Statute considerations).']
  reporting_frequency varchar [note: 'The frequency at which performance reports and incentive tracking updates are provided to participants (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, on-demand).']
  residual_payment_duration_months varchar [note: 'The number of months for which residual payments continue after the initial sale, if applicable.']
  residual_payment_enabled_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the incentive program includes ongoing residual payments for retained members or renewed policies beyond the initial sale period.']
  residual_payment_rate decimal(10,4) [note: 'The commission rate or percentage applied to residual payments for retained members or renewed policies.']
  split_commission_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether commission splitting among multiple sales participants is permitted under this incentive program.']
  stacking_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether participants can earn incentives from multiple programs simultaneously for the same sales transaction (stacking permitted or prohibited).']
  state_restriction_list varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of state codes where this incentive program is restricted or not applicable due to regulatory or business constraints.']
  status varchar [note: 'The current operational status of the incentive program (active, inactive, pending launch, suspended, expired, cancelled).']
  status_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation or reason for the current program status, particularly for suspended, expired, or cancelled programs.']
  terms_and_conditions_url varchar [note: 'The web URL or document repository location where the complete terms and conditions of the incentive program are published.']
  threshold_type varchar [note: 'The type of performance threshold required for incentive eligibility (minimum threshold, quota-based, stretch goal, accelerator tier, or no threshold).']
  threshold_unit varchar [note: 'The unit of measurement for the performance threshold (enrollment count, premium dollars, member months, policies, groups, percentage of quota).']
  threshold_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'The numeric value of the performance threshold that must be achieved for incentive eligibility or tier qualification.']
  training_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether participants must complete specific training or certification before becoming eligible for the incentive program.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'The version number of the incentive program document or configuration, used to track changes and updates over time.']

  Note: 'Reference table defining sales incentive programs, bonus structures, eligibility criteria, and performance periods.'
}

  owner_contact_name varchar [note: 'Name of the primary business contact or owner responsible for this lead source. Used for operational inquiries and issue resolution.']
  owner_department varchar [note: 'Department or business unit responsible for managing and optimizing this lead source. Examples include Medicare Sales, Commercial Marketing, or Broker Relations.']

Territory assignments are based on provider network availability.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the appointment relationship between insurance brokers and government program participation contracts. It captures broker certifications, appointment dates, territory assignments, and commission structures specific to each broker-program combination. Each record links one broker to one provider program participation with attributes that exist only in the context of this appointment relationship.. Existence Justification: In the health insurance payer industry, brokers are appointed to sell multiple government programs (Medicare Advantage, Part D, Medicaid), and each government program has multiple certified brokers selling it across different territories. UnitedHealthcare actively manages these broker appointments as a core business process, tracking certifications, territories, commission structures, and appointment statuses specific to each broker-program combination.'

  execution_status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the campaign execution through this channel. Tracks whether this channel is actively running the campaign, paused, or completed.']
  expected_lead_volume varchar [note: 'The target number of leads expected to be generated through this sales channel for this campaign. This channel-specific target rolls up to the overall campaign lead generation goal.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this channel-campaign execution record was last modified.']
  priority_level varchar [note: 'The priority assigned to this channel for this campaign, indicating the relative importance or focus of this channel in the overall campaign strategy. Used for resource allocation and performance monitoring.']
  start_date date [note: 'The date when this campaign begins execution through this specific sales channel. May differ from the overall campaign start date as channels may be activated at different times.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the operational execution of a marketing campaign through a specific sales channel. It captures the budget allocation, performance targets, and execution parameters that exist only when a campaign is deployed through a particular channel. Each record links one campaign to one sales channel with channel-specific execution details including budget, lead volume targets, priority, and active dates.. Existence Justification: In health insurance marketing operations, campaigns are routinely executed across multiple sales channels simultaneously (e.g., a Medicare AEP campaign runs through broker, direct enrollment, and call center channels concurrently), and each sales channel supports multiple campaigns throughout the year (e.g., the Broker Direct channel may run Commercial, Medicare, and Marketplace campaigns). Marketing teams actively manage channel-campaign execution as a distinct operational entity, allocating channel-specific budgets, setting channel-specific lead targets, and tracking performance by channel-campaign combination.'
}

Table sales.broker_program_participation {
  broker_program_participation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the broker_program_participation association']
  broker_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the broker participating in the program']
  program_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the program in which the broker is participating']
  certification_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the broker\'s certification or participation in the program. Tracks whether the broker is actively certified, pending review, or has expired/suspended status for this specific program.']
  enrollment_date date [note: 'The date when the broker enrolled in or was assigned to the program. This date is specific to each broker-program combination and represents when the participation relationship began.']
  performance_tier varchar [note: 'The performance tier or level achieved by the broker within this specific program. Used for incentive programs and preferred partner classifications where brokers are ranked based on sales volume, quality metrics, or other performance criteria.']
  program_effective_date date [note: 'The date when the broker\'s participation in the program became effective or active. May differ from enrollment_date if there is a waiting period or approval process.']
  program_end_date date [note: 'The date when the broker\'s participation in the program ended or is scheduled to end. Used to track historical participation and program expiration dates.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the participation relationship between insurance brokers and  health Care programs. It captures broker enrollment in certification programs, incentive programs, and training initiatives. Each record links one broker to one program with attributes that track certification status, performance metrics, and participation dates specific to that broker-program combination.. Existence Justification: In  health Care\'s broker management operations, brokers participate in multiple programs simultaneously (Medicare Stars certification, wellness initiative training, preferred partner tiers, AEP training programs), and each program has many participating brokers. The business actively manages these participation relationships, tracking certification status, performance tiers, and participation dates for each broker-program combination. This is an operational relationship that broker management teams create, update, and query regularly.'
}

Table service.queue {

  escalation_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether interactions can be escalated to supervisor or specialized teams based on wait time or complexity.']

  estimated_wait_time_announcement boolean [note: 'Indicates whether callers are provided with estimated wait time announcements while in queue.']
  fcr_target_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Target percentage of interactions that should be resolved on the first contact without requiring follow-up.']
  grievance_appeal_queue boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this queue handles member grievances and appeals requiring regulatory compliance tracking.']
  holiday_schedule_applied boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this queue follows organizational holiday schedules for closure or reduced hours.']
  interpreter_services_available boolean [note: 'Indicates whether professional interpreter services are available for members requiring language assistance.']
  ivr_integration_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this queue receives interactions from IVR systems with collected data passed to agents.']
  language_support varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of languages supported by agents in this queue (e.g., English, Spanish, Mandarin).']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this queue configuration record was last updated or modified.']
  lob varchar [note: 'The health insurance line of business that this queue primarily serves (Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Individual Marketplace, etc.).']
  manager_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the manager or supervisor responsible for this queue.']
  manager_name varchar [note: 'Name of the manager or supervisor responsible for this queue and its performance.']
  maximum_daily_capacity varchar [note: 'Maximum number of interactions this queue can handle per day based on staffing and operational capacity.']
  maximum_wait_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Maximum allowable wait time in seconds before an interaction is escalated, transferred, or offered callback.']
  music_on_hold_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether music or messages are played to callers while waiting in queue.']
  name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the customer service queue used for routing member and provider interactions.']
  nps_tracking_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether members are surveyed for Net Promoter Score after interactions from this queue.']
  outbound_campaign_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this queue is used for outbound calling campaigns (e.g., care management outreach, appointment reminders).']
  overflow_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether interactions can overflow to secondary queues or skill groups when capacity is exceeded.']
  overflow_threshold_count varchar [note: 'Number of interactions waiting in queue that triggers overflow routing to secondary queues.']
  overflow_threshold_seconds varchar [note: 'Wait time in seconds that triggers overflow routing to secondary queues or skill groups.']
  position_in_queue_announcement boolean [note: 'Indicates whether callers are informed of their position in the queue while waiting.']
  predictive_dialer_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether predictive dialing technology is used for outbound interactions from this queue.']
  primary_skill_group varchar [note: 'The primary skill group or competency required for agents handling interactions from this queue (e.g., Claims, Eligibility, Benefits, Appeals).']
  priority varchar [note: 'Numeric priority level assigned to the queue for routing and resource allocation (1=highest, 10=lowest).']
  quality_monitoring_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether interactions from this queue are subject to quality monitoring and scoring.']
  recording_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether interactions in this queue are recorded for quality assurance, compliance, and training purposes.']
  recording_retention_days varchar [note: 'Number of days that interaction recordings are retained before archival or deletion per compliance requirements.']
  regulatory_reporting_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether interactions from this queue must be included in regulatory reporting to CMS, state agencies, or other governing bodies.']
  routing_strategy varchar [note: 'Algorithm used to distribute interactions from this queue to available agents (longest idle, skills-based, round-robin, etc.).']
  screen_pop_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether member or provider information automatically displays (screen pop) when agents receive interactions from this queue.']
  secondary_skill_groups varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of secondary or optional skill groups that can handle overflow from this queue.']
  service_level_target_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Target percentage of interactions that should be answered within the service level target time (e.g., 80%).']
  service_level_target_seconds varchar [note: 'Target time in seconds within which a specified percentage of interactions should be answered (e.g., 80% in 20 seconds).']
  skill_group_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether agents must possess specific skill groups to receive interactions from this queue.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the queue indicating whether it is actively routing interactions.']
  survey_sample_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of interactions from this queue that are randomly selected for post-interaction surveys.']
  time_zone varchar [note: 'Time zone in which the queue operates and business hours are defined.']
  tty_tdd_support boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this queue supports TTY/TDD services for hearing-impaired members.']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the queue based on interaction direction and channel (inbound calls, outbound campaigns, blended, callback, digital channels).']
  whisper_message_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether agents receive a whisper message announcing the queue name or interaction type before connecting.']
  whisper_message_text varchar [note: 'Text content of the whisper message played to agents before connecting to the member or provider.']

  Note: 'Queue configuration used for routing interactions, including queue name, priority rules, service level targets, and associated skill groups.'
}

  reopened_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation of why the escalation was reopened, including new information or unresolved issues that emerged after initial closure.']
  reopened_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the escalation was reopened after initial closure.']
  resolution_category varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the escalation outcome for reporting and trend analysis purposes.']
  resolution_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code indicating the type of resolution or outcome for the escalated case (e.g., APPROVED, DENIED, OVERTURNED, REFERRED, WITHDRAWN).']
  resolution_description varchar [note: 'Detailed free-text explanation of how the escalated case was resolved, including actions taken and final outcome.']
  resolution_time_hours decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total elapsed time in hours from escalation timestamp to resolved timestamp, used for performance measurement and SLA tracking.']
  resolved_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the escalated case was marked as resolved with a final disposition or solution.']
  root_cause_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code identifying the underlying root cause that necessitated the escalation (e.g., SYSTEM_ERROR, POLICY_EXCEPTION, TRAINING_GAP, PROCESS_FAILURE).']
  root_cause_description varchar [note: 'Detailed explanation of the root cause analysis findings for the escalation, used for process improvement and training purposes.']
  siu_case_number varchar [note: 'Unique case number assigned by the Special Investigations Unit for tracking the fraud investigation related to the escalation.']
  siu_referral_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether the escalation was referred to the Special Investigations Unit for fraud investigation (true=referred to SIU, false=not referred).']
  sla_breach_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether the escalation resolution exceeded the committed SLA timeframe (true=breached, false=met SLA).']
  sla_breach_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation of why the SLA was breached, including root cause and contributing factors for process improvement analysis.']
  special_handling_notes varchar [note: 'Documentation of special handling requirements or considerations for the escalation due to member circumstances, vulnerabilities, or regulatory requirements.']
  target_resolution_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time by which the escalated case must be resolved according to Service Level Agreement (SLA) commitments based on priority and escalation level.']
  training_opportunity_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether the escalation identified a training need or coaching opportunity for staff development (true=training needed, false=no training needed).']
  training_topic varchar [note: 'Subject area or skill gap identified through the escalation that requires training or coaching intervention.']
  vulnerable_population_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether the member belongs to a vulnerable population requiring special handling considerations (e.g., dual eligible, LTSS recipient, behavioral health condition) (true=vulnerable population, false=general population).']

  Note: 'Record of case escalations with escalation level, target group, reason, and timestamp.'
}

  member_age varchar [note: 'The age of the member in years at the time of the NPS survey response.']
  member_gender varchar [note: 'The gender of the member as recorded in the member management system at the time of the NPS survey.']
  member_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the health plan member who provided the NPS score.']

  nps_score varchar [note: 'The numeric score provided by the respondent on a scale of 0 to 10, indicating their likelihood to recommend the health plan or service to others.']
  product_type varchar [note: 'The specific health plan product type associated with the member being surveyed, such as HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, or Medicare SNP.']
  promoter_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator set to true if the respondent is classified as a Promoter (score 9-10), false otherwise.']
  provider_npi varchar [note: 'Ten-digit National Provider Identifier for the provider being rated, if the survey pertains to provider experience.']

  response_date date [note: 'The date on which the respondent completed and submitted the NPS survey.']
  response_status varchar [note: 'Status of the survey response indicating whether it was completed in full, partially completed, abandoned, or deemed invalid.']
  response_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise timestamp when the respondent submitted the NPS survey response, including timezone offset.']
  response_validity_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator set to true if the survey response passed all quality and validity checks, false if flagged as potentially fraudulent or invalid.']

  service_team varchar [note: 'The specific service team or department responsible for the interaction that triggered the NPS survey (e.g., Claims, Enrollment, Appeals).']

  Note: 'Transactional record of NPS scores collected via surveys, including promoter score, detractor reason, and calculation date.'

  survey_completed_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the member completed the post-interaction satisfaction survey, if applicable.']

  survey_response_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether the member completed the post-interaction satisfaction survey.']
  talk_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration in seconds of active conversation time between agent and member during the interaction.']
  target_met_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether the metric outcome met or exceeded the defined target value.']
  target_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'Target or goal value for this metric type as defined by service level agreements or operational standards.']
  transfer_count varchar [note: 'Number of times the call was transferred.']
  transfer_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether the interaction was transferred to another agent or department.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the case.']
  variance_from_target decimal(18,4) [note: 'Calculated difference between actual metric value and target value, indicating performance gap.']

  Note: 'Transactional capture of metric outcomes per case or interaction (e.g., FCR flag, AHT duration, CSAT score).'
}

Table service.policy_acknowledgment {
  policy_acknowledgment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the policy_acknowledgment association']
  agent_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the service agent who acknowledged the policy']
  policy_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the compliance policy that was acknowledged']
  acknowledgment_date timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the agent formally acknowledged this compliance policy version. Critical for audit trail and compliance reporting.']
  acknowledgment_method varchar [note: 'Method by which the agent acknowledged the policy, used for audit trail and compliance verification.']
  acknowledgment_notes varchar [note: 'Optional notes or comments recorded at the time of acknowledgment, such as questions raised or clarifications provided.']
  acknowledgment_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the acknowledgment indicating whether the agent has completed the acknowledgment, is pending, overdue, or if the acknowledgment has expired requiring re-acknowledgment.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this acknowledgment record was created in the system.']
  ip_address varchar [note: 'IP address from which the acknowledgment was submitted, required for audit trail and fraud prevention.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date when this agent must re-acknowledge or review this compliance policy. Calculated based on the policy\'s attestation frequency requirements.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this acknowledgment record was last updated.']
  version_acknowledged varchar [note: 'The specific version number of the compliance policy that was acknowledged by the agent. Critical for tracking when policy updates require new acknowledgments.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the acknowledgment event between agent and compliance_policy. It captures the formal record of when each agent acknowledged each version of each compliance policy, required for regulatory audit trails and compliance tracking. Each record links one agent to one compliance_policy with attributes that exist only in the context of this acknowledgment relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, agents must acknowledge multiple compliance policies (HIPAA, Privacy, Fraud Prevention, ACA, state-specific regulations), and each policy requires acknowledgment from all agents who handle member data or perform regulated activities. The business actively manages this relationship through compliance tracking systems that monitor acknowledgment status, send reminders for overdue acknowledgments, and maintain audit trails for regulatory inspections. When policies are updated, all agents must re-acknowledge the new version, creating a historical record of acknowledgments over time.'
}

  program_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the program (Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, etc.) for which the article is applicable']

  approval_status varchar [note: 'The approval status of this article for use in this specific program context. Each program may require separate compliance review and approval, particularly for Medicare and Medicaid programs with CMS oversight requirements.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the individual who approved this article for use in this specific program, supporting audit trail requirements for regulatory compliance.']
  created_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this article-program applicability relationship was created in the system.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date when this article becomes applicable and valid for use in the context of this specific program. This is relationship-specific because the same article may have different effective dates for different programs due to regulatory or operational timing differences.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'The date when this article is no longer applicable to this specific program. Program-specific expiration allows articles to remain valid for some programs while expiring for others based on regulatory changes or program-specific policy updates.']
  last_updated_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this article-program applicability relationship was last modified.']
  version varchar [note: 'The version of the article that is approved for this specific program. Different programs may use different versions of the same article due to regulatory approval timing or program-specific content requirements.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the applicability relationship between knowledge base articles and programs. It captures which support articles, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides are applicable to which health insurance programs (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial, etc.), including version control and approval tracking for compliance purposes. Each record links one knowledge base article to one program with effective dates, version tracking, and approval status that exist only in the context of this program-specific applicability.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, knowledge base articles (FAQs, troubleshooting guides, policy explanations) must be applicable to multiple programs simultaneously because the same content often applies across Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and Commercial lines of business. Conversely, each program requires multiple knowledge articles covering different topics (enrollment, benefits, claims, appeals). The business actively manages this relationship for regulatory compliance, requiring program-specific approval, version control, and effective dating because CMS and state regulators require documented evidence that member-facing content is approved for each specific program context.'

Table credentialing.sanction_type {

  minimum_exclusion_period_months varchar [note: 'Minimum duration in months that this sanction type typically remains in effect before reinstatement can be considered (null if permanent or variable).']

  ncqa_requirement_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether screening for this sanction type is required for NCQA accreditation compliance (true) or is supplementary to NCQA standards (false).']
  network_participation_impact varchar [note: 'Standard impact of this sanction type on provider network participation status (disqualification, suspension, restriction, enhanced monitoring, or no impact).']
  notification_requirement varchar [note: 'Required timeframe for notifying relevant parties (provider, network operations, compliance, CMS) when this sanction type is identified (immediate, within 24 hours, within 5 days, within 30 days, or no specific requirement).']
  npdb_reportable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this sanction type is reportable to the National Practitioner Data Bank (true) or is not subject to NPDB reporting requirements (false).']

  provider_type_applicability varchar [note: 'Types of healthcare providers to which this sanction type applies (e.g., physicians, nurses, facilities, DME suppliers, all provider types). Pipe-separated list if multiple.']
  reinstatement_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether providers with this sanction type can apply for reinstatement or network participation after remediation (true) or the sanction is permanent (false).']
  replacement_sanction_type_code varchar [note: 'Code of the sanction type that replaces this one if this type has been deprecated or consolidated (null if not replaced).']
  risk_score varchar [note: 'Numeric risk score (0-100) assigned to this sanction type for risk stratification and prioritization in credentialing workflows (higher scores indicate greater risk).']
  screening_frequency varchar [note: 'Required frequency for screening providers against this sanction type (monthly, quarterly, annually, initial credentialing only, or continuous monitoring).']

  severity_level varchar [note: 'Severity classification indicating the impact of this sanction type on provider eligibility and credentialing decisions (critical sanctions result in automatic disqualification).']
  specialty_specific_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this sanction type applies only to specific medical specialties or professional disciplines (true) or applies broadly to all provider types (false).']
  state_reportable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this sanction type must be reported to state insurance departments or Medicaid agencies (true) or is not subject to state reporting requirements (false).']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of this sanction type reference (active for current use, inactive if temporarily disabled, deprecated if replaced by newer type, pending if awaiting approval).']
  urac_requirement_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether screening for this sanction type is required for URAC accreditation compliance (true) or is supplementary to URAC standards (false).']
  verification_method varchar [note: 'Standard method used to verify or screen for this sanction type (automated database screening, manual verification, primary source verification, provider attestation, or third-party credentialing service).']

  Note: 'Reference list of sanction categories (OIG exclusion, SAM exclusion, state sanctions).'
}

  escalation_date date [note: 'The date on which the expiration notification was escalated to credentialing management or leadership.']

  expiration_date date [note: 'The date on which the credential expires and requires renewal or re-credentialing.']
  issuing_organization varchar [note: 'The name of the organization or authority that issued the credential (e.g., California Medical Board, American Board of Internal Medicine).']
  issuing_state varchar [note: 'Two-letter state code where the credential was issued, applicable for state-specific licenses and certifications.']
  last_retry_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time of the most recent retry attempt to send the notification.']
  lob varchar [note: 'The line of business or product line for which the provider is credentialed and the notification applies (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid).']
  malpractice_coverage_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The dollar amount of malpractice insurance coverage maintained by the provider.']
  malpractice_insurance_carrier varchar [note: 'The name of the insurance carrier providing malpractice coverage for the provider.']
  malpractice_policy_number varchar [note: 'The policy number for the provider\'s malpractice insurance coverage.']
  network_status varchar [note: 'The current network participation status of the provider at the time the notification was sent (e.g., in-network, out-of-network, pending, terminated).']
  notification_body varchar [note: 'The full text content of the expiration notification message sent to the provider.']
  notification_cost decimal(10,2) [note: 'The cost incurred to send the notification, applicable for SMS, postal mail, or third-party notification services.']
  notification_language varchar [note: 'The two-letter ISO language code indicating the language in which the notification was sent (e.g., en for English, es for Spanish).']
  notification_method varchar [note: 'The method or channel used to deliver the expiration notification to the provider (e.g., email, SMS, postal mail, provider portal message).']
  notification_preference varchar [note: 'The provider\'s preferred method for receiving notifications as indicated in their profile or preferences.']
  notification_sent_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The exact date and time when the expiration notification was sent to the provider.']
  notification_source_system varchar [note: 'The name or identifier of the source system that generated and sent the expiration notification (e.g., credentialing system, notification engine).']
  notification_subject varchar [note: 'The subject line or title of the expiration notification message sent to the provider.']
  notification_type varchar [note: 'The type or sequence of the notification (e.g., initial notice, first reminder, second reminder, final notice, escalation).']
  npi varchar [note: 'The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the healthcare provider in the United States.']
  opened_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the provider opened or viewed the notification (tracked for email and portal notifications).']
  opt_out_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the provider has opted out of receiving automated expiration notifications.']
  priority_level varchar [note: 'The priority level assigned to the expiration notification based on urgency and business impact (e.g., low, medium, high, critical).']
  provider_name varchar [note: 'The full legal name of the healthcare provider receiving the expiration notification.']
  provider_specialty varchar [note: 'The medical specialty or practice area of the provider receiving the expiration notification (e.g., Internal Medicine, Cardiology, Pediatrics).']
  provider_type varchar [note: 'The type or category of healthcare provider (e.g., physician, nurse practitioner, physician assistant, dentist, facility).']
  recipient_address varchar [note: 'The postal mailing address to which the expiration notification was sent (for postal mail notifications).']
  recipient_email varchar [note: 'The email address to which the expiration notification was sent.']
  recipient_phone varchar [note: 'The phone number to which the expiration notification was sent (for SMS or phone call notifications).']
  recredentialing_due_date date [note: 'The date by which the provider must complete the re-credentialing process to maintain active network status.']
  region varchar [note: 'The geographic region or market where the provider practices and the notification applies (e.g., Northeast, Southwest, California).']
  renewal_submitted_date date [note: 'The date on which the provider submitted renewal documentation for the expiring credential.']
  renewal_submitted_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the provider has submitted renewal documentation for the expiring credential.']
  response_received_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether a response or acknowledgment was received from the provider following the notification.']
  response_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the provider responded to or acknowledged the expiration notification.']
  retry_count varchar [note: 'The number of times the system attempted to send the notification due to delivery failures or errors.']
  sanctions_screening_date date [note: 'The date on which the most recent sanctions screening was performed for the provider.']
  sanctions_screening_status varchar [note: 'The status of the provider\'s sanctions screening against OIG, SAM, and state exclusion lists (e.g., clear, flagged, pending review, excluded).']
  scheduled_send_date date [note: 'The date on which the notification was scheduled to be sent as part of the automated notification process.']
  sla_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the notification was sent within the defined service level agreement timeframe for expiration notifications.']
  sla_target_days varchar [note: 'The target number of days before expiration that the notification should be sent according to the service level agreement.']
  tin varchar [note: 'The Tax Identification Number associated with the provider or provider organization for billing and payment purposes.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the expiration notification record was last updated in the system.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of automated notifications sent for upcoming credential expirations.'
}

  Note: 'Transactional record of data exchanges with CAQH ProView, including pull date, fields retrieved, and sync status.'

  oig_exclusion_status varchar [note: 'The status of the provider\'s screening against the OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities (Clear, Excluded, Pending Review, Not Checked).']
  oig_screening_date date [note: 'The date on which the provider was screened against the OIG exclusion list.']
  panel_status varchar [note: 'The status of the provider\'s patient panel for this network (Open, Closed, Limited, Not Applicable).']
  participation_type varchar [note: 'The type of participation the provider has in the network (Par, Non-Par, Out of Network, Preferred, Tiered).']
  pcp_designation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the provider is designated as a Primary Care Physician in this network (true/false).']
  primary_source_verification_date date [note: 'The date on which primary source verification was completed for the provider.']
  primary_source_verification_status varchar [note: 'The status of primary source verification for the provider\'s credentials (Complete, Incomplete, Pending, Failed, Expired).']
  quality_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'A numerical score representing the provider\'s quality performance based on HEDIS and other quality measures.']
  quality_tier_designation varchar [note: 'The quality tier designation assigned to the provider based on quality metrics (High Quality, Standard Quality, Low Quality, Not Rated).']
  record_version varchar [note: 'The version number of the network eligibility record for tracking changes over time.']
  risk_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'A numerical score representing the risk level associated with the provider based on credentialing and quality metrics.']
  sam_exclusion_status varchar [note: 'The status of the provider\'s screening against the SAM exclusion database (Clear, Excluded, Pending Review, Not Checked).']
  sam_screening_date date [note: 'The date on which the provider was screened against the SAM exclusion database.']
  service_location_count varchar [note: 'The number of service locations where the provider is eligible to participate in this network.']
  specialist_designation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the provider is designated as a specialist in this network (true/false).']
  state_sanctions_screening_date date [note: 'The date on which the provider was screened against state sanctions databases.']
  state_sanctions_status varchar [note: 'The status of the provider\'s screening against state-level sanctions and disciplinary actions (Clear, Sanctioned, Pending Review, Not Checked).']
  telehealth_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the provider is eligible to provide telehealth services in this network (true/false).']
  termination_date date [note: 'The date on which the provider\'s network eligibility ends or was terminated.']
  termination_initiated_by varchar [note: 'The party that initiated the termination of network eligibility (Provider, Health Plan, Mutual, Regulatory Authority).']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'The reason for termination of the provider\'s network eligibility (Voluntary, Involuntary, Contract Expiration, Quality Issues, Credentialing Failure, Sanctions, Mutual Agreement, Other).']
  tier_level varchar [note: 'The tier level assigned to the provider within a tiered network structure (Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, Not Applicable).']

  Note: 'Master record indicating a provider\'s eligibility to participate in a specific health plan network based on credentialing outcome.'
}

Table credentialing.fee {
  fee_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the credentialing fee transaction record.']
  account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Provider credentialing fees are charged to specific billing accounts. Finance uses this to track provider application fee payments and outstanding balances for credentialing services.']
  caqh_integration_id varchar [note: 'The unique identifier assigned to the provider in the CAQH ProView system.']
  caqh_provider_id varchar [note: 'The unique identifier assigned to the provider in the CAQH ProView system.']

  credential_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the credentialing or re-credentialing application associated with this fee.']
  credentialing_application_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the credentialing or re-credentialing application associated with this fee.']

  billing_zip_code varchar [note: 'The ZIP code of the billing address for the credentialing fee invoice.']

Table credentialing.credentialing_network_participation {
  credentialing_network_participation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the network_participation association']
  benefit_design_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the government benefit design in which the provider is participating']
  credential_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the provider credential record that is participating in the network']
  updated_by_user_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the user or system that last updated this participation record.']
  accepting_new_patients_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the provider is currently accepting new patient enrollments from this specific benefit design. A provider may accept new patients in some networks but not others based on panel capacity.']
  contract_reference_number varchar [note: 'Reference number to the legal contract document governing this provider\'s participation in this benefit design network.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when the provider\'s participation in this specific benefit design network becomes effective. This is distinct from the credential effective date as it represents when participation in this particular government program begins.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this network participation record.']
  network_status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the provider\'s participation in this specific benefit design network. Tracks whether the provider is actively accepting members from this plan.']
  participation_tier varchar [note: 'Tiering classification for this provider within this specific benefit design network, affecting member cost-sharing and access. A provider may be Tier 1 in one plan and Tier 2 in another based on contract negotiations and quality metrics.']
  reimbursement_rate_modifier decimal(5,4) [note: 'Percentage modifier applied to standard reimbursement rates for this provider-benefit design combination. Represents negotiated rate adjustments specific to this participation agreement (e.g., 1.05 for 5% above standard, 0.95 for 5% below).']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when the provider\'s participation in this specific benefit design network ends. Allows tracking of historical participation and network changes over time.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the participation contract between a credentialed provider and a government benefit design. It captures the terms under which a provider participates in a specific government program\'s network, including tiering, reimbursement modifiers, and participation status. Each record links one credential to one benefit_design with attributes that exist only in the context of this network participation relationship.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, a credentialed provider participates in multiple government benefit designs (Medicare Advantage plans, Medicaid products, etc.) simultaneously, and each benefit design has hundreds to thousands of participating providers. Network management teams actively manage these participation relationships as distinct operational entities, tracking provider-specific tiering, reimbursement modifiers, and participation status for each credential-benefit design combination. This is a core operational process for provider directory accuracy, claims payment, and member access.'
}

Each record links one credential to one training_record with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific completion event.. Existence Justification: In health insurance payer operations, providers must complete multiple mandatory compliance trainings (HIPAA, fraud/waste/abuse, cultural competency, etc.) as part of both initial credentialing and ongoing recredentialing cycles. Each provider credential requires multiple training completions, and the same training module is completed by multiple providers. The credentialing team actively manages these training requirements as a prerequisite for credential approval and tracks completion status, scores, expiration dates, and attestations for each provider-training combination.'

Each provider-policy acknowledgment is tracked as a distinct operational record with acknowledgment date, policy version, signature, and status. Table credentialing.workflow_step_sla {

  Note: 'This association product represents the SLA assignment between credentialing workflow steps and service level agreements. Each record links one workflow step to one SLA with attributes that define the operational performance expectations for that specific combination.. Existence Justification: In UnitedHealthcare\'s credentialing operations, workflow steps can be governed by multiple SLAs simultaneously (standard processing, expedited review, regulatory compliance timeframes), and each SLA definition applies to multiple workflow steps across the credentialing process. Operations teams actively configure and manage these assignments, tracking compliance metrics, escalation thresholds, and business priorities specific to each workflow step-SLA combination. This is an operational configuration that credentialing managers create, update, and monitor as part of performance management.'

Table finance.budget {
  budget_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the budget record. Primary key for the budget entity.']
  capitation_plan_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to contract.capitation_plan. Business justification: Medical expense budgets for capitated arrangements must link to capitation plans to forecast monthly payment obligations based on contracted member counts and PMPM rates.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: budget is allocated to a specific cost center. The cost_center_code is used for lookup, but adding FK provides referential integrity and allows joining to get full cost center details.']
  finance_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.finance_account. Business justification: budget is for a specific account. The account_code is used for lookup, but adding FK to finance_account provides referential integrity and allows joining to get full account details.']
  financial_period_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: budget belongs to a specific financial period. Rather than duplicating period attributes, it should reference the authoritative financial_period master.']
  account_code varchar [note: 'The general ledger account code to which this budget amount is assigned.']
  allocation_basis varchar [note: 'The specific basis or driver used for budget allocation (e.g., member months, FTE count, square footage, transaction volume).']
  allocation_method varchar [note: 'The method used to allocate this budget amount across cost centers or business units (e.g., direct, allocated, prorated, activity-based, headcount, revenue, membership).']
  amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The planned financial amount allocated for this budget line item in the base currency.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'The approval status of the budget indicating whether it has been formally approved by authorized personnel.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'The name or identifier of the person who approved this budget.']
  approved_date date [note: 'The date on which this budget was formally approved.']
  available_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The remaining budget amount available for spending after accounting for committed and reserved amounts.']
  baseline_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The baseline or prior year budget amount used as a reference point for comparison and variance analysis.']
  business_unit_code varchar [note: 'The code identifying the business unit responsible for this budget.']
  business_unit_name varchar [note: 'The descriptive name of the business unit associated with this budget.']
  committed_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The amount of budget that has been committed through purchase orders or contracts but not yet spent.']
  contract_number varchar [note: 'The contract number associated with this budget item, if the budget is tied to a specific contractual obligation.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'The code identifying the cost center to which this budget is allocated.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'The three-letter ISO currency code for the budget amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).']
  department_code varchar [note: 'The code identifying the department to which this budget is allocated.']
  department_name varchar [note: 'The descriptive name of the department associated with this budget.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date from which this budget becomes effective and active for financial planning and control.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'The date on which this budget expires or is no longer active.']
  forecast_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The forecasted or projected amount for this budget line item based on current trends and assumptions.']
  grant_code varchar [note: 'The code identifying a grant or external funding source associated with this budget, if applicable.']
  inflation_rate_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'The assumed inflation rate percentage applied to this budget calculation.']
  is_capital_expenditure boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this budget item represents a capital expenditure (asset acquisition) rather than an operating expense.']
  is_discretionary boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this budget item is discretionary (can be adjusted or eliminated) or mandatory (required by regulation or contract).']
  is_mlr_denominator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this budget item is included in the denominator of the MLR calculation (premium revenue).']
  is_mlr_numerator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this budget item is included in the numerator of the MLR calculation (medical claims and quality improvement activities).']
  is_recurring boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this budget item is recurring (ongoing) or non-recurring (one-time).']
  last_modified_by varchar [note: 'The name or identifier of the person who last modified this budget record.']
  last_modified_date date [note: 'The date on which this budget record was last modified or updated.']
  line_of_business varchar [note: 'The line of business segment for which this budget is planned (e.g., Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Dual Eligible).']
