Table shared.audit {
  audit_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the audit record. Primary key for the audit entity.']
  contract_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to shared.contract. Business justification: Audits frequently examine specific contracts (provider reimbursement contracts, vendor contracts, sales contracts). The contract_number STRING attribute should be replaced with FK to contract table to']
  accreditation_expiration_date date [note: 'The date when the accreditation status expires and renewal or re-audit is required. Relevant for accreditation audits.']
  accreditation_level varchar [note: 'The level or tier of accreditation awarded as a result of the audit. Represents the degree of achievement in meeting accreditation standards.']
  accreditation_status varchar [note: 'The accreditation status resulting from the audit, if applicable. Relevant for NCQA, URAC, or other accreditation audits.']
  actual_end_date date [note: 'The actual date when the audit engagement was completed. Captures when audit fieldwork or activities actually concluded.']
  actual_start_date date [note: 'The actual date when the audit engagement began. Captures when audit fieldwork or activities actually commenced.']
  appeal_date date [note: 'The date when an appeal or dispute was filed in response to the audit findings. Represents the initiation of the appeal process.']
  appeal_filed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether an appeal or dispute was filed in response to the audit findings or penalties. True if an appeal was submitted.']
  appeal_resolution_date date [note: 'The date when the appeal or dispute was resolved or a final decision was issued. Represents the conclusion of the appeal process.']
  appeal_status varchar [note: 'The current status of the appeal or dispute filed in response to the audit. Tracks the progression of the appeal process.']
  auditor_name varchar [note: 'Name of the lead auditor or audit firm responsible for conducting the audit. For external audits, this is the auditing organization or individual auditor assigned.']
  auditor_organization varchar [note: 'Name of the organization or entity conducting the audit. For internal audits, this may be the internal audit department. For external audits, this is the external auditing firm or regulatory body.']
  auditor_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the auditor based on their relationship to the organization. Indicates whether the audit is conducted by internal staff, external consultants, regulatory agencies, or independent third parties.']
  business_unit varchar [note: 'The business unit, division, or department within the organization that is the subject of the audit. Identifies the organizational area being audited.']
  committee_review_date date [note: 'The date when the audit results were reviewed by the audit committee or board of directors. Represents governance oversight of audit findings.']
  compliance_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'A numerical score representing the level of compliance or conformance identified during the audit, expressed as a percentage or score. Higher scores indicate better compliance.']
  confidence_level decimal(5,2) [note: 'The statistical confidence level used in the audit sampling methodology, expressed as a percentage. Represents the degree of certainty in the audit results.']
  confidentiality_level varchar [note: 'The confidentiality or sensitivity classification of the audit report and findings. Determines who may access the audit documentation.']
  corrective_action_completion_date date [note: 'The date by which all corrective actions must be completed and verified. Represents the deadline for full remediation of audit findings.']
  corrective_action_plan_due_date date [note: 'The date by which a corrective action plan must be submitted in response to audit findings. Represents regulatory or contractual deadlines for remediation planning.']
  corrective_action_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether corrective action or remediation is required as a result of the audit findings. True if corrective action is mandated.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the audit record was initially created in the system. Represents the audit record creation event.']
  criteria varchar [note: 'The standards, regulations, policies, or benchmarks against which the audit subject was evaluated. Defines the basis for audit assessment.']
  critical_findings_count varchar [note: 'The number of critical or high-severity findings identified during the audit. Represents issues requiring immediate attention or remediation.']
  data_source varchar [note: 'The primary data source or system from which audit data was extracted. Identifies the origin of the data being audited.']
  distribution_list varchar [note: 'The list of individuals, roles, or departments to whom the audit report was distributed. Documents the recipients of audit findings.']
  error_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of errors or exceptions identified in the audit sample. Calculated as the number of errors divided by the sample size.']
  executive_summary varchar [note: 'A high-level summary of the audit findings, conclusions, and recommendations. Provides an overview for executive leadership.']
  fieldwork_end_date date [note: 'The date when on-site or detailed audit fieldwork concluded. Represents the completion of evidence gathering and testing activities.']
  fieldwork_start_date date [note: 'The date when on-site or detailed audit fieldwork began. Represents the commencement of evidence gathering and testing activities.']
  financial_impact_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The estimated or actual financial impact of audit findings, expressed in dollars. May represent overpayments, underpayments, penalties, or cost of remediation.']
  findings_count varchar [note: 'The total number of audit findings, observations, or exceptions identified during the audit. Represents the volume of issues discovered.']
  follow_up_audit_date date [note: 'The scheduled or actual date of the follow-up audit to verify remediation. Represents when re-audit activities will occur.']
  follow_up_audit_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a follow-up audit is required to verify remediation of findings. True if a subsequent audit is mandated.']
  frequency varchar [note: 'The frequency or cadence at which this type of audit is conducted. Indicates how often the audit is repeated.']
  geographic_scope varchar [note: 'The geographic area or region covered by the audit. May include specific states, regions, or national scope.']
  hedis_measure varchar [note: 'The specific HEDIS measure or set of measures being audited. Relevant for HEDIS compliance audits.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the audit record was last updated or modified. Tracks the most recent change to the audit record.']
  lead_contact_email varchar [note: 'The email address of the primary contact person or audit lead within the organization for this audit.']
  lead_contact_name varchar [note: 'The name of the primary contact person or audit lead within the organization for this audit. Identifies the internal point of contact for audit coordination.']
  lead_contact_phone varchar [note: 'The phone number of the primary contact person or audit lead within the organization for this audit.']
  lob varchar [note: 'The line of business or product line being audited. Indicates whether the audit focuses on commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, individual, group, or other product lines.']
  major_findings_count varchar [note: 'The number of major or significant findings identified during the audit. Represents issues of moderate severity requiring remediation.']
  management_response varchar [note: 'The formal response from management to the audit findings and recommendations. Documents management\'s agreement, disagreement, or planned actions.']
  management_response_date date [note: 'The date when management\'s formal response to the audit was received or submitted.']
  measurement_year varchar [note: 'The measurement year for quality metrics or HEDIS measures being audited. Represents the year for which performance is being assessed.']
  methodology varchar [note: 'Description of the methodology, framework, or approach used to conduct the audit. May reference specific audit standards, protocols, or procedures.']
  minor_findings_count varchar [note: 'The number of minor or low-severity findings identified during the audit. Represents issues of lesser significance or opportunities for improvement.']
  name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name or title of the audit engagement. Provides a human-readable identifier for the audit.']
  objective varchar [note: 'The primary objective or purpose of the audit. Describes what the audit aims to achieve, such as compliance verification, quality assessment, fraud detection, or operational improvement.']
  opinion varchar [note: 'The formal opinion or conclusion issued by the auditor regarding the subject matter. Represents the auditor\'s professional judgment.']
  overall_rating varchar [note: 'The overall rating or conclusion assigned to the audit. Represents the auditor\'s assessment of compliance, quality, or performance.']
  overpayment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total amount of overpayments identified during the audit. Represents funds paid in excess of what was due.']
  penalty_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total amount of penalties, fines, or sanctions assessed as a result of audit findings. Represents financial consequences of non-compliance.']
  period_end_date date [note: 'The end date of the period being audited. Defines the conclusion of the timeframe for which data, transactions, or activities are being reviewed.']
  period_start_date date [note: 'The start date of the period being audited. Defines the beginning of the timeframe for which data, transactions, or activities are being reviewed.']
  plan_year varchar [note: 'The plan year or benefit year being audited. Represents the coverage period under review for health plan audits.']
  population_size varchar [note: 'The total number of records, transactions, or cases in the population from which the audit sample was drawn. Represents the universe of items eligible for audit.']
  program varchar [note: 'Name of the audit program or initiative under which this audit is conducted. Examples include CMS RADV (Risk Adjustment Data Validation), HEDIS Audit, NCQA Accreditation Survey, or internal compliance audit program.']
  projected_error_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'The estimated error rate for the entire population based on the audit sample results. Represents the extrapolated error rate from sample to population.']
  record_status varchar [note: 'The current status of the audit record in the system. Indicates whether the record is active, inactive, archived, or deleted.']
  regulatory_body varchar [note: 'Name of the regulatory or governing body mandating or overseeing the audit, if applicable. Examples include CMS, state departments of insurance, NCQA, URAC, or OCR.']
  regulatory_response_date date [note: 'The date when the regulatory body provided a response or decision regarding the audit. Represents regulatory feedback or action.']
  regulatory_submission_date date [note: 'The date when the audit report or results were submitted to the regulatory body, if required. Relevant for regulatory audits.']
  report_due_date date [note: 'The date by which the audit report is required to be completed and submitted. Represents regulatory or contractual deadlines for audit reporting.']
  report_issue_date date [note: 'The date when the final audit report was issued or published. Represents the official completion and communication of audit findings.']
  report_number varchar [note: 'The unique identifier or reference number assigned to the audit report. Used for tracking and referencing audit documentation.']
  report_title varchar [note: 'The title of the audit report. Provides a descriptive name for the audit documentation.']
  risk_category varchar [note: 'The category or type of risk associated with the audit findings. Classifies risk by its nature or impact area.']
  risk_level varchar [note: 'The overall risk level or risk rating assigned to the audit area or findings. Represents the severity of risk exposure identified.']
  sample_size varchar [note: 'The number of records, transactions, or cases included in the audit sample. Represents the volume of items reviewed during the audit.']
  sampling_method varchar [note: 'The statistical or judgmental method used to select the audit sample. Describes how items were chosen for review from the population.']
  scheduled_end_date date [note: 'The planned or scheduled date for the audit engagement to be completed. Represents when audit fieldwork or activities are expected to conclude.']
  scheduled_start_date date [note: 'The planned or scheduled date for the audit engagement to begin. Represents when audit fieldwork or activities are expected to commence.']
  scope varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the scope of the audit, including the areas, processes, systems, or populations being audited. Defines the boundaries and focus of the audit engagement.']
  source varchar [note: 'The origin or trigger for the audit. Indicates what prompted the audit to be conducted.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of the audit engagement in its lifecycle. Tracks the progression from planning through completion and remediation.']
  tool varchar [note: 'The software tool, platform, or application used to conduct the audit or analyze audit data. Examples include audit management systems, data analytics tools, or specialized audit software.']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the audit based on its purpose and scope. Indicates whether the audit is internal, external, regulatory, compliance-focused, quality-focused, or specific to a functional area such as claims, pharmacy, or government programs.']
  underpayment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total amount of underpayments identified during the audit. Represents funds that should have been paid but were not.']
  year varchar [note: 'The calendar year or fiscal year for which the audit is being conducted. Represents the period under review.']

  Note: 'Consolidated audit from compliance and government domains. Original: Master record of internal and external compliance audits, with audit ID, scope, auditor, start/end d... Also includes: Record of an audit or investigation performed on a government program transaction or contract, captu... Also consolidates: quality.accreditation_audit, compliance.audit.'
}

Table shared.risk_score {
  risk_score_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the risk score record.']
  contract_id varchar [note: 'The CMS-assigned contract number for the Medicare Advantage or Part D plan.']
  enrollment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment. Business justification: Risk adjustment scores are calculated per enrolled member for CMS reimbursement and actuarial analysis. Finance and actuarial teams link risk_score to enrollment_id for accurate premium calculations.']
  member_profile_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the health plan member associated with this risk score.']
  plan_id varchar [note: 'The unique identifier for the health insurance plan under which the member is enrolled.']
  product_plan_id varchar [note: 'The unique identifier for the health insurance plan under which the member is enrolled.']
  segment_id varchar [note: 'The segment identifier within a CMS contract representing a specific benefit package or plan variation.']
  type_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to care.risk_score_type. Business justification: Risk scores (member-specific values) must reference the scoring type/model used (HCC RAF, predictive analytics). Type defines methodology; risk_score stores calculated values for each member.']
  age_group varchar [note: 'The age group category of the member used in risk score calculation.']
  attribution_method varchar [note: 'The methodology used to attribute the member to a primary care provider for risk score and quality reporting purposes.']
  audit_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this risk score record has been flagged for audit or review due to anomalies or compliance requirements.']
  base_rate decimal(15,2) [note: 'The base per-member-per-month payment rate before risk adjustment is applied.']
  benchmark_rate decimal(15,2) [note: 'The county-level benchmark payment rate established by CMS for Medicare Advantage plans.']
  calculation_date date [note: 'The date on which the risk score was calculated or computed.']
  calculation_method varchar [note: 'The methodology used to calculate the risk score (CMS standard model, proprietary algorithm, hybrid approach).']
  calculation_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time when the risk score calculation was executed.']
  chart_review_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a medical chart review is required to validate or enhance the risk score documentation.']
  chronic_condition_count varchar [note: 'The total number of distinct chronic conditions documented for the member that contribute to risk scoring.']
  coding_intensity_adjustment decimal(10,6) [note: 'The adjustment factor applied to account for differences in diagnostic coding patterns between Medicare Advantage and Fee-for-Service Medicare.']
  county_code varchar [note: 'The five-digit FIPS code for the county where the member resides, used to determine geographic payment rates.']
  data_source varchar [note: 'The primary source of diagnosis data used in the risk score calculation (claims, encounters, chart reviews, health risk assessments).']
  data_year varchar [note: 'The calendar year during which the diagnosis and utilization data used for risk score calculation was collected.']
  demographic_score decimal(10,4) [note: 'The portion of the risk score attributable to demographic factors such as age, gender, and Medicaid eligibility.']
  diagnosis_count varchar [note: 'The total number of ICD-10 diagnosis codes that contributed to the member\'s risk score calculation.']
  disability_status boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the member is entitled to Medicare due to disability rather than age.']
  disease_score decimal(10,4) [note: 'The portion of the risk score attributable to diagnosed chronic conditions and HCC categories.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date from which the risk score becomes effective for payment and utilization management purposes.']
  encounter_count varchar [note: 'The total number of healthcare encounters (claims or encounter records) that contributed diagnoses to the risk score.']
  end_date date [note: 'The date on which the risk score is no longer effective or valid.']
  esrd_status boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the member has End Stage Renal Disease, which requires a specialized risk adjustment model.']
  frailty_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the member meets criteria for frailty, which may affect risk model selection and care management.']
  gap_closure_opportunity boolean [note: 'Indicates whether there are potential diagnosis gaps or documentation opportunities that could affect the risk score.']
  gender varchar [note: 'The gender of the member as used in risk adjustment calculations.']
  hcc_count varchar [note: 'The total number of distinct HCC categories assigned to the member based on documented diagnoses.']
  hcc_list varchar [note: 'A comma-separated list of HCC codes assigned to the member (e.g., HCC18, HCC85, HCC111).']
  hcc_score decimal(10,4) [note: 'The calculated HCC risk score representing the expected cost of care for the member relative to the average Medicare beneficiary.']
  hospice_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the member was enrolled in hospice care during the risk score calculation period.']
  institutional_status boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the member resides in a long-term care or institutional setting, affecting risk model selection.']
  interaction_score decimal(10,4) [note: 'The portion of the risk score attributable to interactions between multiple chronic conditions or demographic factors.']
  last_chart_review_date date [note: 'The date of the most recent medical chart review conducted for this member\'s risk score validation.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this risk score record was last modified or updated.']
  line_of_business varchar [note: 'The insurance product line or business segment for which the risk score applies (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial, etc.).']
  low_income_subsidy_level varchar [note: 'The level of low-income subsidy assistance the member receives for Part D prescription drug costs.']
  medicaid_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the member is dually eligible for Medicare and Medicaid benefits, which affects risk score calculation.']
  member_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the health plan member associated with this risk score.']
  model_type varchar [note: 'The type of risk adjustment model applied based on member enrollment and health status (Community, Institutional, New Enrollee, ESRD, etc.).']
  months_enrolled varchar [note: 'The number of months the member was enrolled during the data collection period used for risk score calculation.']
  new_enrollee_status boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the member is a new enrollee without sufficient diagnosis history, requiring use of the new enrollee risk model.']
  normalization_factor decimal(10,6) [note: 'The factor applied to normalize risk scores to ensure budget neutrality across the Medicare Advantage program.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or comments regarding the risk score calculation, validation, or special circumstances.']
  part_d_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the member has Medicare Part D prescription drug coverage, which may affect risk adjustment.']
  payment_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The monthly capitation payment amount calculated based on the risk score and applicable payment rates.']
  payment_year varchar [note: 'The calendar year for which the risk score is used to determine capitation payments.']
  predicted_cost decimal(15,2) [note: 'The predicted annual healthcare cost for the member based on the risk score and historical cost data.']
  previous_score decimal(10,4) [note: 'The risk score from the immediately preceding calculation period for trend analysis.']
  prospective_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this is a prospective risk score used for payment in the current year based on prior year data.']
  provider_npi varchar [note: 'The 10-digit NPI of the primary care provider responsible for the member\'s care and diagnosis documentation.']
  quality_bonus_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage increase in benchmark payment based on the plan\'s Star Rating quality performance.']
  raf_score decimal(10,4) [note: 'The Risk Adjustment Factor score used to adjust capitation payments based on member health status and demographic factors.']
  rebate_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of savings between the plan bid and benchmark that is returned as member benefits or rebates.']
  reconciliation_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'The amount of payment adjustment resulting from reconciliation between prospective and retrospective risk scores.']
  region_code varchar [note: 'The CMS-defined payment region code used for rate determination.']
  retrospective_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this is a retrospective risk score calculated after the payment year for reconciliation purposes.']
  risk_tier varchar [note: 'A categorical classification of the member\'s risk level based on the calculated risk score for care management stratification.']
  rxhcc_count varchar [note: 'The total number of distinct RxHCC categories assigned to the member for Part D risk adjustment.']
  rxhcc_score decimal(10,4) [note: 'The risk score calculated using the RxHCC model for Part D prescription drug payment adjustment.']
  score_change_percentage decimal(6,2) [note: 'The percentage change in risk score compared to the previous calculation period.']
  score_percentile varchar [note: 'The percentile ranking of the member\'s risk score within the plan population (1-100).']
  star_rating decimal(2,1) [note: 'The overall Star Rating (1.0 to 5.0) assigned to the plan based on quality and performance measures.']
  state_code varchar [note: 'The two-letter state abbreviation for the member\'s residence location.']
  status varchar [note: 'The current status of the risk score record in the calculation and payment lifecycle.']
  submission_type varchar [note: 'The type of data submission used to calculate the risk score (RAPS, EDPS, Encounter Data).']
  suspect_condition_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether there are suspected conditions based on historical data that have not been documented in the current period.']
  validation_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the risk score has been validated through RADV or internal audit processes.']
  version varchar [note: 'The version number of this risk score record, incremented when recalculations or adjustments are made.']

  Note: 'Consolidated risk_score from member and care domains. Original: Calculated risk adjustment score (e.g., HCC/RAF) associated with a member for Medicare Advantage.... Also includes: Periodic HCC risk score for a member, including RAF score, calculation date, and contributing diagno... Also consolidates: risk.risk_score, member.risk_score.'
}

Table shared.fee_schedule {
  fee_schedule_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the fee schedule record. Primary key for the fee schedule entity.']
  contract_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to shared.contract. Business justification: Fee schedules are typically defined within provider contracts or network contracts. Establishing this FK enables tracking which contract governs a specific fee schedule, supporting contract compliance']
  adjustment_factor decimal(10,4) [note: 'Multiplier or percentage adjustment applied to base rates in this fee schedule for geographic or other variations.']
  age_restrictions varchar [note: 'Age range or restrictions for members to whom this fee schedule applies.']
  apc_version varchar [note: 'Version of the APC grouper system used if this fee schedule applies APC-based pricing for outpatient services.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the person or role who approved the fee schedule for use.']
  approved_date date [note: 'Date when the fee schedule was formally approved for use by authorized personnel.']
  archived_date date [note: 'Date when the fee schedule was archived and removed from active use.']
  audit_trail_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether detailed audit trails must be maintained for pricing decisions using this fee schedule.']
  authorization_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether services priced under this fee schedule require prior authorization.']
  auto_update_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether this fee schedule automatically updates based on external rate changes such as CMS updates.']
  balance_billing_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether providers can balance bill members for amounts exceeding fee schedule rates.']
  base_fee_schedule_code varchar [note: 'Reference code to a base or parent fee schedule from which this schedule may derive or inherit pricing rules.']
  bundling_rules_applicable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether procedure bundling or unbundling rules apply to this fee schedule.']
  carve_out_services varchar [note: 'List or description of specific services excluded from this fee schedule and handled under separate arrangements.']
  claims_repricing_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether claims should be automatically repriced using this fee schedule during adjudication.']
  code varchar [note: 'Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the fee schedule for system reference and lookup.']
  coinsurance_applicable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether member coinsurance applies to services priced under this fee schedule.']
  contact_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the person or team responsible for questions or issues related to this fee schedule.']
  contact_phone varchar [note: 'Phone number of the person or team responsible for questions or issues related to this fee schedule.']
  conversion_factor decimal(12,2) [note: 'Dollar amount multiplied by RVUs to calculate the payment amount for services in RVU-based fee schedules.']
  copay_applicable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether member copayments apply to services priced under this fee schedule.']
  cpt_version varchar [note: 'Version year of CPT code set applicable to this fee schedule for procedure-based pricing.']
  created_date date [note: 'Date when the fee schedule record was initially created in the system.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the fee schedule record was initially created in the system.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO currency code indicating the monetary unit used for fee schedule amounts.']
  deductible_applicable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether member deductibles apply to services priced under this fee schedule.']
  description varchar [note: 'Detailed textual description of the fee schedule including its purpose, scope, and applicability.']
  diagnosis_restrictions varchar [note: 'List of diagnosis codes or categories for which this fee schedule is applicable or restricted.']
  drg_version varchar [note: 'Version of the DRG grouper system used if this fee schedule applies DRG-based pricing.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when the fee schedule becomes active and applicable for pricing services.']
  external_reference_id varchar [note: 'Identifier used in external systems or by trading partners to reference this fee schedule.']
  gender_restrictions varchar [note: 'Gender-based restrictions or applicability for this fee schedule.']
  geographic_scope varchar [note: 'The geographic area or region where this fee schedule is applicable for pricing services.']
  hcpcs_version varchar [note: 'Version year of HCPCS code set applicable to this fee schedule for supplies and services pricing.']
  icd_version varchar [note: 'Version of ICD coding system applicable to this fee schedule for diagnosis-based pricing rules.']
  last_modified_date date [note: 'Date when the fee schedule record was last updated or modified.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the fee schedule record was last updated or modified.']
  legacy_fee_schedule_id varchar [note: 'Identifier from legacy or predecessor systems for historical tracking and data migration purposes.']
  lob varchar [note: 'The insurance product line or business segment to which this fee schedule applies.']
  maximum_payment_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'Ceiling or maximum reimbursement amount allowed for services under this fee schedule.']
  medicaid_based_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether this fee schedule is derived from or references state Medicaid fee schedules.']
  medicare_based_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether this fee schedule is derived from or references Medicare fee schedules.']
  minimum_payment_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'Floor or minimum reimbursement amount guaranteed for services under this fee schedule.']
  modifier_rules_applicable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether CPT or HCPCS modifiers affect pricing under this fee schedule.']
  name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the fee schedule used for identification and reference purposes.']
  network_tier varchar [note: 'The provider network tier or classification level associated with this fee schedule for differential reimbursement.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next review and potential update of the fee schedule.']
  oop_applicable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether out-of-pocket maximums apply to services priced under this fee schedule.']
  outlier_threshold_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'Dollar threshold above which claims are considered outliers and may receive additional payment adjustments.']
  owner_department varchar [note: 'Business department or unit responsible for maintaining and managing this fee schedule.']
  percentage_of_charges decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of provider billed charges used to calculate payment amounts in this fee schedule.']
  percentage_of_medicare decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of Medicare allowable amounts used as the basis for pricing in this fee schedule.']
  place_of_service_restrictions varchar [note: 'List of place of service codes where this fee schedule is applicable or restricted.']
  pricing_methodology varchar [note: 'The reimbursement methodology or pricing approach used by this fee schedule to calculate payment amounts.']
  provider_type_restrictions varchar [note: 'List of provider types or specialties to which this fee schedule is limited or applicable.']
  published_date date [note: 'Date when the fee schedule was published or made available to providers or internal systems.']
  referral_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether services priced under this fee schedule require a referral from a primary care physician.']
  regulatory_filing_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether this fee schedule must be filed with state insurance departments or regulatory bodies.']
  review_frequency varchar [note: 'Scheduled frequency for reviewing and updating the fee schedule rates and rules.']
  rvu_based_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether this fee schedule uses Relative Value Units as the basis for pricing calculations.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Name of the operational system from which this fee schedule record originated.']
  specialty varchar [note: 'The medical specialty or provider type for which this fee schedule is designed.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the fee schedule indicating whether it is available for use in claims adjudication.']
  stop_loss_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'Maximum payment amount or cap applied to individual claims under this fee schedule.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when the fee schedule is no longer valid or applicable for pricing services.']
  transparency_reporting_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator whether this fee schedule must be included in public transparency reporting requirements.']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the fee schedule based on the type of healthcare service or provider category it applies to.']
  version varchar [note: 'Version identifier for the fee schedule to track updates and revisions over time.']

  Note: 'Consolidated fee_schedule from contract and provider domains. Original: Master table for fee‑for‑service pricing structures referenced by contracts.... Also includes: Fee schedule entries defining reimbursement rates, RVUs, and pricing rules for services rendered by ...'
}

Table shared.formulary {
  formulary_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the formulary record. Primary key for the formulary data product.']
  age_restriction_max varchar [note: 'Maximum age in years for which the drug is covered under the formulary.']
  age_restriction_min varchar [note: 'Minimum age in years for which the drug is covered under the formulary.']
  ahfs_code varchar [note: 'Therapeutic classification code assigned by the American Society of Health-System Pharmacists.']
  awp decimal(12,2) [note: 'The average wholesale price of the drug, used as a benchmark for pricing and reimbursement calculations.']
  biosimilar_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the drug is a biosimilar product approved as highly similar to an FDA-approved biological product.']
  black_box_warning_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the drug has an FDA black box warning for serious safety concerns.']
  brand_name varchar [note: 'The proprietary or brand name under which the drug is marketed by the manufacturer.']
  clinical_criteria_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether specific clinical criteria must be met for the drug to be covered.']
  cms_formulary_id varchar [note: 'CMS-assigned identifier for Medicare Part D formulary submissions.']
  coinsurance_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the drug cost the member is responsible for paying after deductible is met.']
  compound_drug_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the drug is a compounded medication prepared by a pharmacy.']
  controlled_substance_schedule varchar [note: 'DEA classification of the drug based on its potential for abuse and accepted medical use (Schedule I-V).']
  copay_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Fixed dollar amount the member pays for the drug at the point of sale.']
  coverage_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the drug is covered under the pharmacy benefit plan.']
  daw_code varchar [note: 'Code indicating whether generic substitution is allowed or if the brand drug must be dispensed as written by the prescriber (0-9 scale).']
  days_supply_limit varchar [note: 'Maximum number of days supply that can be dispensed per prescription fill.']
  diagnosis_restriction varchar [note: 'Specific diagnosis codes (ICD-10) required for coverage of the drug.']
  dosage_form varchar [note: 'Physical form in which the drug is manufactured and dispensed (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, liquid).']
  drug_category varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the drug type (Brand, Generic, Biosimilar, Compound, OTC).']
  drug_class_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code representing the drug classification category for grouping and reporting purposes.']
  drug_interaction_level varchar [note: 'Highest level of drug interaction risk associated with this medication.']
  drug_name varchar [note: 'Brand or generic name of the prescription drug as it appears on the formulary.']
  drug_utilization_review_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether drug utilization review is required at the point of dispensing.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when the formulary entry becomes active and coverage begins.']
  exception_allowed boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether members can request a formulary exception for coverage of this drug.']
  gender_restriction varchar [note: 'Gender-specific coverage restriction for the drug if applicable (e.g., contraceptives, hormone therapies).']
  generic_name varchar [note: 'The non-proprietary or generic name of the drug, typically the active pharmaceutical ingredient name.']
  gpi_code varchar [note: '14-digit hierarchical classification code that groups drugs by therapeutic class and chemical structure.']
  interchangeable_biosimilar boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the biosimilar is designated as interchangeable with the reference product.']
  labeler_code varchar [note: 'The first 5 digits of the NDC identifying the manufacturer or labeler of the drug product.']
  lactation_risk varchar [note: 'Assessment of risk when the drug is used during breastfeeding.']
  last_updated_date date [note: 'Date when the formulary entry was last modified or reviewed.']
  lob_applicability varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of lines of business to which this formulary entry applies (e.g., Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid).']
  mac_price decimal(12,2) [note: 'The maximum amount the plan will reimburse for a generic drug, typically used for multi-source generics.']
  mail_order_eligible boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the drug can be dispensed through mail order pharmacy services.']
  maintenance_drug_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the drug is typically used for chronic conditions and taken on an ongoing basis.']
  manufacturer_name varchar [note: 'Name of the pharmaceutical company that manufactures or markets the drug.']
  multi_source_code varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the drug has generic equivalents available (Y=multi-source, N=single source, O=originator).']
  ndc varchar [note: 'Unique 11-digit identifier assigned by the FDA to each drug product, formatted as 5-4-2 or 11 continuous digits. Identifies the labeler, product, and package size.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional notes or comments regarding coverage, restrictions, or special considerations for the drug.']
  orphan_drug_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the drug is designated as an orphan drug for rare diseases.']
  otc_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the drug is available over-the-counter without a prescription.']
  package_size varchar [note: 'The quantity and unit of measure for the drug package (e.g., 30 tablets, 100mL bottle).']
  pbm_formulary_id varchar [note: 'External identifier used by the PBM system to reference this formulary entry.']
  pharmacy_network_restriction varchar [note: 'Type of pharmacy network where the drug must be obtained for coverage (e.g., specialty pharmacy only).']
  plan_type_applicability varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of plan types to which this formulary entry applies (e.g., HMO, PPO, HDHP).']
  preferred_drug_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the drug is on the preferred drug list with lower cost-sharing for members.']
  pregnancy_category varchar [note: 'FDA pregnancy risk category indicating potential risks to fetus (A=safest, X=contraindicated, N=not classified).']
  preventive_drug_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the drug is classified as preventive care under ACA requirements with zero cost-sharing.']
  prior_authorization_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether prior authorization from the health plan is required before the drug can be dispensed.']
  quantity_limit decimal(10,2) [note: 'Maximum quantity of the drug that can be dispensed per prescription fill or time period.']
  quantity_limit_period varchar [note: 'Time period over which the quantity limit applies (e.g., per fill, per month).']
  reference_product_ndc varchar [note: 'NDC of the reference or brand-name product for which this drug is a generic or biosimilar equivalent.']
  refill_limit varchar [note: 'Maximum number of refills allowed for a single prescription of this drug.']
  rems_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the drug requires a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy program for safe use.']
  route_of_administration varchar [note: 'The path by which the drug is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, intravenous, topical, inhalation).']
  specialty_drug_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the drug is classified as a specialty medication requiring special handling, administration, or monitoring.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of the drug on the formulary indicating whether it is actively covered.']
  step_therapy_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the member must try lower-cost alternative drugs before this drug will be covered.']
  strength varchar [note: 'The amount of active ingredient per dosage unit (e.g., 10mg, 500mg/5mL).']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when the formulary entry is terminated and coverage ends.']
  therapeutic_class varchar [note: 'Classification of the drug based on its therapeutic use and pharmacological action (e.g., Antihypertensives, Antidiabetics, Statins).']
  therapeutic_equivalent_code varchar [note: 'FDA Orange Book code indicating therapeutic equivalence (AB=therapeutically equivalent, BX=not equivalent).']
  tier_description varchar [note: 'Descriptive label for the formulary tier indicating the cost-sharing category (e.g., Preferred Generic, Specialty).']
  tier_level varchar [note: 'The cost-sharing tier assigned to the drug (typically 1-5), where lower tiers have lower member cost-sharing and higher tiers have higher cost-sharing.']
  vaccine_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the drug is a vaccine or immunization product.']
  version varchar [note: 'Version identifier for the formulary document or publication cycle.']
  year varchar [note: 'Calendar year for which the formulary is effective.']

  Note: 'Consolidated formulary from product and pharmacy domains. Original: List of covered prescription drugs, therapeutic classes, and associated tier levels for a pharmacy b... Also includes: Authoritative list of all drugs covered under the PBM, with NDC, therapeutic class, and inclusion/ex...'
}

Table shared.formulary_tier {
  formulary_tier_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the formulary tier classification record.']
  formulary_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to shared.formulary. Business justification: Tier belongs to a formulary, enabling hierarchy']
  aca_compliant_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this tier configuration meets ACA essential health benefits and cost-sharing requirements.']
  biosimilar_tier_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this tier is designated for biosimilar medications as an alternative to biologic drugs.']
  brand_tier_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this tier is designated for brand-name drugs.']
  catastrophic_coinsurance decimal(5,2) [note: 'Coinsurance percentage during the catastrophic coverage phase for Medicare Part D plans.']
  catastrophic_copay decimal(10,2) [note: 'Copayment amount during the catastrophic coverage phase for Medicare Part D plans.']
  cms_tier_id varchar [note: 'CMS-assigned identifier for this tier used in Medicare Part D formulary submissions and reporting.']
  coinsurance_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the drug cost the member pays for drugs in this tier under coinsurance cost-sharing structure.']
  copay_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Fixed dollar amount the member pays per prescription for drugs in this tier under copayment cost-sharing structure.']
  cost_share_type varchar [note: 'Type of cost-sharing structure applied to this tier (e.g., copay, coinsurance, hybrid, deductible only).']
  cost_share_variance_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether cost-sharing amounts for this tier can vary by employer group, plan design, or geographic region.']
  coverage_phase varchar [note: 'Medicare Part D coverage phase to which this tier cost-sharing applies (e.g., deductible, initial coverage, coverage gap, catastrophic).']
  created_date date [note: 'Date when this formulary tier record was initially created in the system.']
  deductible_applies_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the plan deductible must be met before cost-sharing for this tier applies.']
  display_order varchar [note: 'Numeric order in which this tier should be displayed in member-facing materials and systems.']
  dual_eligible_copay decimal(10,2) [note: 'Copayment amount for dual-eligible members (Medicare and Medicaid) for drugs in this tier.']
  edi_tier_code varchar [note: 'Standardized tier code used in EDI transactions (e.g., NCPDP D.0) for pharmacy claims processing.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when this formulary tier configuration becomes active and applicable to member cost-sharing.']
  employer_customizable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether employer groups can customize cost-sharing amounts for this tier in their plan designs.']
  formulary_type varchar [note: 'Type of formulary structure this tier belongs to (e.g., open, closed, tiered, restricted).']
  gap_coverage_coinsurance decimal(5,2) [note: 'Coinsurance percentage during the coverage gap (donut hole) phase for Medicare Part D plans.']
  gap_coverage_copay decimal(10,2) [note: 'Copayment amount during the coverage gap (donut hole) phase for Medicare Part D plans.']
  generic_tier_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this tier is designated for generic drugs.']
  initial_coverage_coinsurance decimal(5,2) [note: 'Coinsurance percentage during the initial coverage phase for Medicare Part D plans.']
  initial_coverage_copay decimal(10,2) [note: 'Copayment amount during the initial coverage phase for Medicare Part D plans.']
  insulin_tier_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this tier is designated specifically for insulin products, which may have special cost-sharing caps under recent legislation.']
  last_updated_date date [note: 'Date when this formulary tier record was most recently modified.']
  lob varchar [note: 'Line of business to which this tier applies (e.g., Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace).']
  low_income_subsidy_copay decimal(10,2) [note: 'Reduced copayment amount for members eligible for Medicare Low Income Subsidy (Extra Help) for drugs in this tier.']
  mail_order_coinsurance decimal(5,2) [note: 'Coinsurance percentage for drugs in this tier when obtained through mail order pharmacy.']
  mail_order_copay decimal(10,2) [note: 'Copayment amount for drugs in this tier when obtained through mail order pharmacy (typically for 90-day supply).']
  maximum_cost_share decimal(10,2) [note: 'Maximum dollar amount the member pays for drugs in this tier, serving as a cost-share cap.']
  maximum_monthly_cost_cap decimal(10,2) [note: 'Maximum total out-of-pocket amount a member pays per month for drugs in this tier, applicable to certain drug classes like insulin.']
  medicaid_compliant_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this tier configuration meets state Medicaid managed care formulary requirements.']
  medicare_compliant_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this tier configuration meets CMS Medicare Part D formulary and cost-sharing requirements.']
  member_facing_description varchar [note: 'Plain-language description of the tier for member communications, explaining what types of drugs are included and expected costs.']
  member_facing_name varchar [note: 'Simplified, member-friendly name for the tier used in member communications and benefit materials.']
  minimum_cost_share decimal(10,2) [note: 'Minimum dollar amount the member must pay for drugs in this tier, regardless of actual drug cost.']
  ncqa_tier_code varchar [note: 'NCQA-standardized tier code used for quality reporting and accreditation purposes.']
  network_type varchar [note: 'Pharmacy network type for which this tier cost-sharing applies.']
  out_of_network_copay decimal(10,2) [note: 'Copayment amount when drugs in this tier are obtained from an out-of-network pharmacy.']
  pbm_tier_code varchar [note: 'PBM system-specific tier code used for claims adjudication and pharmacy network communication.']
  plan_type varchar [note: 'Type of health plan to which this tier applies (e.g., HMO, PPO, HDHP, Medicare Advantage, PDP).']
  preferred_pharmacy_copay decimal(10,2) [note: 'Copayment amount when drugs in this tier are obtained from a preferred network pharmacy.']
  preventive_tier_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this tier is designated for preventive medications covered at no cost under ACA (Affordable Care Act) requirements.']
  prior_authorization_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether drugs in this tier typically require prior authorization before coverage is approved.']
  quantity_limit_applies_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether drugs in this tier are subject to quantity limit restrictions on the amount dispensed per fill or time period.']
  retail_30_day_copay decimal(10,2) [note: 'Copayment amount for a 30-day supply at retail pharmacy for drugs in this tier.']
  retail_90_day_copay decimal(10,2) [note: 'Copayment amount for a 90-day supply at retail pharmacy for drugs in this tier.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Name of the operational system from which this formulary tier data originated (e.g., Optum Pharmacy Solutions, QNXT, Facets).']
  source_system_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for this tier in the source operational system.']
  specialty_tier_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this tier is designated as a specialty tier for high-cost or specialty medications.']
  standard_pharmacy_copay decimal(10,2) [note: 'Copayment amount when drugs in this tier are obtained from a standard network pharmacy.']
  state_mandated_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this tier is required by state insurance regulations or mandates.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the formulary tier configuration.']
  step_therapy_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether drugs in this tier are subject to step therapy requirements, requiring trial of lower-cost alternatives first.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when this formulary tier configuration is no longer active or applicable.']
  tier_category varchar [note: 'Broad category classification of the tier indicating the type of drugs included (e.g., generic, preferred brand, specialty).']
  tier_code varchar [note: 'Short alphanumeric code representing the tier classification (e.g., T1, T2, SPEC).']
  tier_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the tier, including the types of drugs covered and member cost-sharing expectations.']
  tier_level varchar [note: 'Numeric level of the tier indicating cost-sharing hierarchy, where lower numbers typically indicate lower member cost-share (e.g., 1, 2, 3, 4, 5).']
  tier_name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the formulary tier (e.g., Tier 1 - Generic, Tier 2 - Preferred Brand, Tier 3 - Non-Preferred Brand, Tier 4 - Specialty).']
  tier_rank varchar [note: 'Relative ranking of this tier within the formulary structure, used for cost-sharing comparisons and analytics.']
  vaccine_tier_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this tier is designated for vaccines covered under pharmacy benefits.']

  Note: 'Consolidated formulary_tier from product and pharmacy domains. Original: Tier classification (e.g., Tier 1‑4, specialty) that determines patient cost‑share for each drug.... Also includes: Definition of cost‑sharing tiers (e.g., Tier 1‑generic, Tier 2‑preferred brand) linked to drugs in t...'
}

Table shared.eligibility_rule {
  eligibility_rule_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for each eligibility rule.']
  eligibility_criteria_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to product.eligibility_criteria. Business justification: System eligibility rules implement plan-specific criteria (age limits, employment status, residency). Enrollment systems validate member eligibility using these rules daily.']
  age_max varchar [note: 'Maximum member age (in years) allowed for eligibility under this rule.']
  age_min varchar [note: 'Minimum member age (in years) required for eligibility under this rule.']
  applies_to_existing_members boolean [note: 'True if the rule is evaluated during member status changes for existing members.']
  applies_to_new_members boolean [note: 'True if the rule is evaluated for newly enrolled members.']
  audit_trail varchar [note: 'Log of changes made to the rule for audit purposes.']
  cob_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the rule participates in coordination of benefits processing.']
  cob_priority varchar [note: 'Numeric priority used when multiple plans coordinate benefits.']
  compliance_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the external regulation or guideline that mandates the rule.']
  coverage_type varchar [note: 'Specific benefit category the rule governs.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date‑time when the rule record was initially created.']
  dependent_relationship varchar [note: 'Allowed relationship of a dependent for eligibility under this rule.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date on which the rule becomes active for enrollment processing.']
  eligibility_engine varchar [note: 'Name of the engine or module that evaluates the rule.']
  evaluation_order varchar [note: 'Explicit order number for rule execution within the engine.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date after which the rule is no longer applied.']
  is_mandatory boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the rule must be satisfied for enrollment.']
  last_review_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent formal review of the rule.']
  max_dependents varchar [note: 'Maximum count of dependents permitted by the rule.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the rule.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional free‑form comments or business context.']
  plan_type varchar [note: 'Type of health insurance plan to which the rule applies.']
  prior_authorization_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating if services covered by the rule require prior authorization.']
  priority varchar [note: 'Numeric priority used to order rule evaluation when multiple rules apply.']
  product_line varchar [note: 'Business line or market segment for which the rule is defined.']
  regulatory_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the rule was created to satisfy a specific regulatory requirement.']
  residency_country varchar [note: 'Three‑letter ISO country code for required member residency.']
  residency_state varchar [note: 'Two‑letter US state code indicating required member residency.']
  rule_category varchar [note: 'High‑level classification of the rule for governance purposes.']
  rule_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the business purpose and logic of the rule.']
  rule_expression varchar [note: 'Technical expression or script that implements the rule logic.']
  rule_name varchar [note: 'Human‑readable name of the eligibility rule.']
  rule_scope varchar [note: 'Business domain(s) where the rule is enforced.']
  rule_status_reason varchar [note: 'Free‑text explanation for the current status of the rule.']
  rule_type varchar [note: 'Category of the rule indicating the primary eligibility dimension it governs.']
  rule_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier used to track changes to the rule over time.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Name of the operational system where the rule originated.']
  source_system_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the rule in the originating source system.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the rule.']
  updated_by varchar [note: 'User or process identifier that performed the last update.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date‑time of the most recent modification to the rule.']
  utilization_management_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating if utilization management review is required for services under this rule.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User or process identifier that created the rule.']

  Note: 'Consolidated eligibility_rule from enrollment and eligibility domains. Original: Configuration of eligibility rules applied during enrollment processing (age, residency, plan eligib... Also includes: Rule definitions used by the eligibility engine (age, plan eligibility, dependent rules, coordinatio Also consolidates: product.eligibility_rule, eligibility.eligibility_rule.'
}

Table shared.pricing_rule {
  pricing_rule_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the pricing rule record.']
  fee_schedule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to shared.fee_schedule. Business justification: Pricing rules reference fee schedules to determine reimbursement amounts. The fee_schedule_code and fee_schedule_type STRING attributes should be replaced with FK to fee_schedule table to enable joini']
  rate_schedule_type_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to product.rate_schedule_type. Business justification: Pricing engines apply different calculation methods (age-banded, composite, tier-rated) based on rate schedule type. Quoting systems use this for premium calculations.']
  source_system_rule_id varchar [note: 'The unique identifier of the pricing rule in the source operational system.']
  superseded_by_rule_id varchar [note: 'The identifier of the pricing rule that replaces this rule when it becomes superseded or retired.']
  aca_compliant_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the pricing rule complies with Affordable Care Act requirements for rating and cost-sharing.']
  actuarial_certification_date date [note: 'The date when the pricing rule received actuarial certification.']
  actuarial_certification_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the pricing rule has been certified by a qualified actuary as actuarially sound.']
  adjustment_factor decimal(8,6) [note: 'A multiplicative factor applied to base rates to adjust for risk, geography, or other rating variables.']
  administrative_cost_percentage decimal(5,4) [note: 'The percentage of premium allocated to administrative expenses, expressed as a decimal.']
  age_band_max varchar [note: 'The maximum age in the age band range for which this pricing rule applies.']
  age_band_min varchar [note: 'The minimum age in the age band range for which this pricing rule applies.']
  allowed_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'The maximum amount the plan will pay for a covered service, based on contracted rates or fee schedules.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'The identifier or name of the user who approved the pricing rule for operational use.']
  approved_date date [note: 'The date when the pricing rule was approved for operational use by authorized business stakeholders.']
  base_rate_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'The foundational rate amount before adjustments, discounts, or surcharges are applied.']
  benefit_limit_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'The maximum dollar amount the plan will pay for a specific benefit or service category.']
  coinsurance_percentage decimal(5,4) [note: 'The percentage of allowed charges the member is responsible for paying after deductible is met, expressed as a decimal.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text comments or notes providing additional context or documentation about the pricing rule.']
  condition_criteria varchar [note: 'The specific conditions or criteria that must be met for the pricing rule to be applied to a transaction.']
  copay_amount decimal(8,2) [note: 'The fixed dollar amount the member pays for a covered service at the point of service.']
  coverage_tier varchar [note: 'The enrollment tier classification for which the pricing rule applies, such as Employee Only, Employee + Spouse, or Family.']
  created_date date [note: 'The date when the pricing rule record was initially created in the system.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'The three-letter ISO currency code for monetary amounts in the pricing rule, typically USD for United States Dollar.']
  deductible_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'The dollar amount the member must pay out-of-pocket before insurance coverage begins for certain services.']
  diagnosis_code varchar [note: 'The specific diagnosis code to which the pricing rule applies, used for condition-specific pricing adjustments.']
  diagnosis_code_type varchar [note: 'The coding system used for diagnosis codes associated with this pricing rule, such as ICD-10-CM or HCC.']
  discount_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'The fixed dollar amount discount applied to the premium or claim pricing.']
  discount_percentage decimal(5,4) [note: 'The percentage discount applied to the base rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 for 10% discount).']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date when the pricing rule becomes active and applicable to transactions.']
  employer_contribution_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'The fixed dollar amount contributed by the employer toward employee premium costs.']
  employer_contribution_percentage decimal(5,4) [note: 'The percentage of premium paid by the employer, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8000 for 80% employer contribution).']
  hipaa_compliant_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the pricing rule complies with HIPAA privacy and security requirements.']
  last_modified_by varchar [note: 'The identifier or name of the user or system that most recently modified the pricing rule record.']
  last_modified_date date [note: 'The date when the pricing rule record was most recently modified.']
  line_of_business varchar [note: 'The insurance product line to which this pricing rule applies, such as Commercial, Medicare Advantage, or Medicaid.']
  market_segment varchar [note: 'The market segment classification for which the pricing rule is designed, such as Individual, Small Group, or Large Group.']
  maximum_value decimal(12,2) [note: 'The maximum value threshold above which the pricing rule will not apply or will apply differently.']
  medical_loss_ratio_target decimal(5,4) [note: 'The target percentage of premium revenue that must be spent on medical claims and quality improvement, expressed as a decimal.']
  member_premium_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'The final premium amount payable by the member after all adjustments, subsidies, and employer contributions.']
  minimum_value decimal(12,2) [note: 'The minimum value threshold below which the pricing rule will not apply or will apply differently.']
  network_tier varchar [note: 'The network tier classification that determines the pricing and cost-sharing levels for services.']
  out_of_pocket_maximum decimal(10,2) [note: 'The maximum dollar amount a member will pay out-of-pocket for covered services in a plan year.']
  place_of_service_code varchar [note: 'The two-digit code identifying the location where services are rendered, used for location-based pricing rules.']
  plan_year varchar [note: 'The calendar year for which the pricing rule is designed and applicable.']
  priority_rank varchar [note: 'The numeric priority ranking used to determine rule precedence when multiple pricing rules could apply to the same transaction.']
  procedure_code varchar [note: 'The specific procedure or service code to which the pricing rule applies, from the specified coding system.']
  procedure_code_type varchar [note: 'The coding system used to identify procedures or services covered by this pricing rule, such as CPT, HCPCS, or DRG.']
  product_type varchar [note: 'The specific health plan product type to which the pricing rule applies, such as HMO, PPO, EPO, or Medicare SNP.']
  profit_margin_percentage decimal(5,4) [note: 'The target profit margin percentage built into the pricing rule, expressed as a decimal.']
  provider_specialty varchar [note: 'The medical specialty of the provider to which the pricing rule applies, such as Cardiology or Orthopedics.']
  rate_filing_approval_date date [note: 'The date when the regulatory authority approved the rate filing containing this pricing rule.']
  rate_filing_number varchar [note: 'The regulatory filing identification number associated with the pricing rule submission to state or federal authorities.']
  rate_per_employee_per_month decimal(12,2) [note: 'The pricing rate calculated on a per employee per month basis, used in employer group premium calculations.']
  rate_per_member_per_month decimal(12,2) [note: 'The pricing rate calculated on a per member per month basis, commonly used in capitation and premium calculations.']
  rating_area varchar [note: 'The geographic rating area code where the pricing rule applies, used for location-based premium adjustments.']
  regulatory_compliance_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the pricing rule has been validated for compliance with applicable federal and state regulations.']
  reimbursement_percentage decimal(5,4) [note: 'The percentage of billed charges or allowed amount that will be reimbursed to the provider, expressed as a decimal.']
  risk_adjustment_factor decimal(8,6) [note: 'The risk score multiplier used to adjust premium or payment rates based on member health status and HCC coding.']
  rounding_method varchar [note: 'The method used to round calculated pricing amounts, such as round up, round down, or round to nearest.']
  rounding_precision varchar [note: 'The number of decimal places to which pricing calculations should be rounded.']
  rule_category varchar [note: 'High-level category grouping pricing rules by their application domain within the business.']
  rule_code varchar [note: 'Business-assigned unique code identifying the pricing rule for operational reference.']

  reversal_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this status change was reversed, if applicable.']

  status_effective_date date [note: 'Date when the new status became effective for business purposes.']
  status_effective_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise timestamp when the status change became effective, including time zone information.']
  status_end_date date [note: 'Date when the status ceased to be effective, marking the end of this status period. Null if current status.']

Table shared.contract_quality_metric {
  contract_quality_metric_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the contract_quality_metric association']
  clinical_metric_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the clinical quality metric included in this contract\'s quality incentive program']
  contract_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the value-based contract that includes quality performance incentives']
  baseline_value decimal(5,2) [note: 'The baseline performance value for this metric at the start of the contract period, used to measure improvement and calculate incentive eligibility.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when this metric became part of the contract\'s quality incentive program and performance measurement began.']
  end_date date [note: 'Date when this metric was removed from the contract\'s quality incentive program or when measurement ended. Null if currently active.']
  incentive_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'The dollar amount of the quality incentive payment associated with achieving the performance threshold for this metric under this specific contract. Amount varies by contract negotiation and metric importance.']
  measurement_period varchar [note: 'The specific time period over which performance on this metric will be measured for this contract (e.g., annual, quarterly). May differ from the metric\'s standard measurement period based on contract terms.']
  metric_weight decimal(5,2) [note: 'The weighting factor applied to this metric within the overall quality incentive calculation for this contract. Represents the relative importance of this metric in the contract\'s total quality score.']
  payment_tier varchar [note: 'The tiered payment level or category for this metric within the contract\'s quality incentive structure (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Bronze/Silver/Gold). Indicates relative importance and payment priority.']
  performance_threshold decimal(5,2) [note: 'The contract-specific performance threshold or target value that must be achieved for this metric to trigger incentive payments (e.g., 85.00 for 85% compliance rate). This is specific to each contract-metric combination as different contracts negotiate different performance expectations.']
  reporting_frequency varchar [note: 'How often performance on this metric must be reported to the contracting party under the terms of this contract.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of this metric within the contract\'s quality program (active, suspended, completed, terminated).']
  target_value decimal(5,2) [note: 'The target performance value negotiated in the contract for this metric. May differ from performance_threshold if tiered incentives exist.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the quality-based performance arrangement between clinical quality metrics and value-based contracts. It captures the specific performance thresholds, incentive payment structures, and measurement parameters that apply when a particular clinical metric is included in a contract\'s quality incentive program. Each record links one clinical metric to one contract with the contract-specific performance targets and payment terms.. Existence Justification: In value-based care contracting, UnitedHealth Care negotiates quality incentive programs where multiple clinical quality metrics (HbA1c control, readmission rates, etc.) are included in a single provider or broker contract, and each metric appears across multiple contracts with different performance thresholds and payment amounts. The business actively manages these contract-metric arrangements as operational entities, tracking contract-specific performance targets, incentive payments, measurement periods, and payment tiers for each metric-contract combination.'
}

  implementation_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes describing program-specific implementation details, exceptions, or special considerations for applying this policy to this program.']
  last_modified_by varchar [note: 'User or system identifier that last modified this policy-program association.']
  last_modified_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this policy-program association was last modified.']
  review_frequency varchar [note: 'Number of months between reviews of this policy for this specific program. May differ from the policy\'s global review_frequency_months due to program-specific regulatory or operational requirements.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of this policy\'s application to this program (Active, Inactive, Pending, Superseded). Tracks the lifecycle of the policy-program relationship independently from the policy\'s global status.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User or system identifier that created this policy-program association.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the application of compliance policies to specific health insurance programs. It captures program-specific compliance requirements, implementation timelines, and attestation rules. Each record links one compliance policy to one program with attributes that reflect how that policy is implemented and enforced within the context of that specific program.. Existence Justification: In health insurance operations, compliance policies must be applied across multiple programs (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial), and each program is subject to multiple compliance policies. The relationship is actively managed by compliance teams who track program-specific implementation dates, scope variations, attestation requirements, and review frequencies. This is an operational relationship where the business creates, updates, and monitors policy-program associations with relationship-specific data.'
}
